中文原文

北宋初在此建孙氏万春园，明代改为清机园，清代先后成为季园和寄园，1930年更名中山公园。

其中以寄园最知名，位于今公园东部，有假山、地沼、亭榭，廊壁上嵌有清人所作寄园诗文，较有文献价值的是王先谦的《重修寄园记》。

寄园东北角为铁佛寺旧址，今为心经碑殿，内供心经碑，原为唐代高僧道松所书，明万历间毁，清嘉庆三年（1798年）据拓本重刻，1982年列为省保单位。殿中另有赵孟頫《乾明广福禅寺重建观音殿记》。

寄园外部西侧为六角忠邦亭，纪念明末江阴抗清英雄阎应元。亭子周围是由宋代千年紫藤攀附而成的环廊。忠邦亭西北，南北中轴线北端，是建于1925年的孙中山先生纪念塔。

纪念塔西北为明代聚奎亭，俗称状元亭，明万历三十八年（1610年）知县许达道建，勉励邑人刻苦攻读。此亭原在启圣祠东南，后移置园内。这是一座四角亭，下为须弥石座，上立青石柱、梁，以榫口相接，并刻有精美浮雕，造型、结构独具一格。

· · · · ·
English

In the early Northern Song, the Sun Family Wanchun Garden was built here; in the Ming it was changed to the Qingji Garden; in the Qing it successively became the Jiyuan and Jiyuan (Send Garden); in 1930 it was renamed Dr.

Sun Yat-sen Park.

Among them, the Jiyuan (Send Garden) is the most famous, located in the eastern part of today's park, with rockery, ponds, pavilions and terraces; the corridor walls are embedded with poems and essays about the Jiyuan written by Qing people, with the more documentarily valuable being Wang Xianqian's "Record of Rebuilding the Jiyuan.

" The northeast corner of the Jiyuan is the former site of the Iron Buddha Temple, today the Heart Sutra Stele Hall, containing the Heart Sutra stele, originally written by the eminent Tang monk Daosong, destroyed during the Wanli reign of the Ming, re-carved from a rubbing in the 3rd year of Jiaqing of the Qing (1798), designated a provincial protected site in 1982.

In the hall there is also Zhao Mengfu's "Record of Rebuilding the Guanyin Hall of the Qianming Guangfu Chan Temple.

" West of the outside of the Jiyuan is the hexagonal Zhongbang (Loyal to the State) Pavilion, commemorating Yan Yingyuan, the late-Ming Jiangyin hero who resisted the Qing.

Around the pavilion is a circular corridor formed by a thousand-year-old wisteria from the Song climbing.

Northwest of the Zhongbang Pavilion, at the north end of the north-south central axis, is the Dr.Sun Yat-sen Memorial Tower built in 1925.

Northwest of the memorial tower is the Ming Juqui (Gathering Excellence) Pavilion, commonly called the Zhuangyuan (Top Scholar) Pavilion, built by magistrate Xu Dadao in the 38th year of Wanli of the Ming (1610), encouraging local people to study hard.

This pavilion was originally southeast of the Qisheng Shrine, later moved into the park.

It is a four-corner pavilion, with a Sumeru stone base below, and bluestone columns and beams above, joined by mortise-and-tenon joints, with exquisite relief carvings—unique in shape and structure.

建筑要点 / Key Features
北宋初在此建孙氏万春园明代改为清机园清代先后成为季园和寄园1930年更名中山公园其中以寄园最知名位于今公园东部有假山地沼亭榭廊壁上嵌有清人所作寄园诗文较有文献价值的是王先谦的重修寄园记寄园东北角为铁佛寺旧址今为心经碑殿内供心经碑原为唐代高僧道松所书明万历间毁清嘉庆三年1798年据拓本重刻1982年列为省保单位殿中另有赵孟頫乾明广福禅寺重建观音殿记寄园外部西侧为六角忠邦亭纪念明末江阴抗清英雄阎应元亭子周围是由宋代千年紫藤攀附而成的环廊忠邦亭西北南北中轴线北端是建于1925年的孙中山先生纪念塔纪念塔西北为明代聚奎亭俗称状元亭明万历三十八年1610年知县许达道建勉励邑人刻苦攻读此亭原在启圣祠东南后移置园内这是一座四角亭下为须弥石座上立青石柱梁以榫口相接并刻有精美浮雕造型结构独具一格
24 适园
Shiyuan Garden
清
级别 Level
第七批全国重点文物保护单位（2013年）
地址 Address
澄江镇南街234号小区内
类型 Type
古典园林
门票 Ticket
免费参观
中文原文

清咸丰四年（1854年）书画家陈式金（1817—1867）急人之用，用双倍价钱购下邻家宅基，他运用书画理论，亲自指挥开池堆山、筑房构屋，由于是"无意为园而适成之"，取名适园。太平天国时期适园被太平军占为王府，得以保存，收复后其子陈曦唐主持重修。陈氏父子皆擅长书画，兼工诗词，适园营造颇得诗情画意。

"文革"时期，适园作为印刷厂工人宿舍而幸免于难，是江阴现存最好的古典园林。适园西侧为陈氏住宅，近年修复，园门在靠近住宅一侧。园林以南部镜湖和北部假山为主体，南、东、北三侧环绕湖、山布置亭堂轩馆等建筑。北部假山用土堆成，三面皆有路可以登山，路旁立黄石峰，山顶为超然台，设有石桌石凳，供人休憩眺远。

假山北部是得蝶绕云山馆，原为陈家祭祖厅堂，向南隔着水池与主堂水流云在轩相对。这一馆一轩都含有"云"字，喻指北部这座假山。古代将石比作云，得蝶绕云山馆处在山林间，为"蝶绕云山"；水流云在轩前临水池，含"水流心不竞，云在意俱迟"之意。水流云在轩西侧有"王羲之换鹅碑"、秋入湳波室和适安斋。

陈氏父子富于收藏，曾收名人书画碑帖500余种，当年便藏在适安斋中。轩东经香廊通向池东的响秋书房，书房东侧紧贴园墙，北为黄石假山，南为湖石假山，采用立体作法，其下为洞，其上为台，两山一脉通贯，气势相连。书房北部是易画轩，陈式金以画会友，来求画者需当场作诗，以诗易画，由此得名。轩北为"倪云林山水石刻"和得爽亭。

当年陈式金曾聘石匠张萃山将自己收藏中最著名的20余种名帖镌刻在廊壁上，"王羲之换鹅碑"和"倪云林山水石刻"为其中精品。

· · · · ·
English

In the 4th year of Xianfeng of the Qing (1854), calligrapher-painter Chen Shijin (1817-1867), in urgent need of space, purchased the neighbor's house foundation at double the price; using calligraphy and painting theory, he personally directed digging ponds, piling mountains, building houses and constructing rooms; because it was "not intended as a garden but became one appropriately," it was named Shiyuan (Appropriate Garden).

During the Taiping Rebellion, Shiyuan was occupied by the Taiping Army as a royal residence and thus preserved; after recovery, his son Chen Xitang directed the restoration.

The Chen father and son were both skilled in calligraphy and painting, and also excelled in poetry, so the construction of Shiyuan gained much poetic and pictorial charm.

During the Cultural Revolution, Shiyuan survived as a workers' dormitory for a printing factory, and is the best-preserved classical garden in Jiangyin.

West of Shiyuan is the Chen family residence, restored in recent years, with the garden gate near the residence side.

The garden takes the southern Jinghu (Mirror Lake) and northern rockery as the main body, with pavilions, halls, and studios arranged around the lake and mountain on the south, east, and north sides.

The northern rockery is piled with earth, with paths on three sides for climbing; yellow stone peaks stand by the paths, and at the mountain top is the Chaoran (Transcendent) Terrace, with stone tables and stools for rest and distant viewing.

North of the rockery is the Dedie Raoyun (Butterflies Circling Clouds) Mountain Hall, originally the Chen family's ancestral worship hall, facing the main hall Shuiliu Yunzai (Flowing Water and Stationary Cloud) Studio across the pond to the south.

Both this hall and studio contain the character "yun" (cloud), metaphorically referring to this northern rockery.

In ancient times, stones were compared to clouds; the Dedie Raoyun Mountain Hall is in the mountain forest, meaning "butterflies circling cloud mountains"; the Shuiliu Yunzai Studio faces the pond, containing the meaning "flowing water does not compete in the heart, stationary clouds linger in intention.

" West of the Shuiliu Yunzai Studio are the "Wang Xizhi Goose-Exchange Stele," Qiuru Nanbo Room, and Shi'an Studio.

The Chen father and son were rich in collections, once collecting over 500 kinds of famous calligraphy, paintings, and model calligraphy albums, which were stored in the Shi'an Studio in those years.

East of the studio, through the Fragrant Corridor, leads to the Xiangqiu (Autumn Sound) Study east of the pond; east of the study紧贴 the garden wall, with a yellow stone rockery to the north and a Taihu stone rockery to the south, adopting a three-dimensional method with caves below and terraces above, the two mountains connected in one vein with connected momentum.

North of the study is the Yihua (Exchange Painting) Studio; Chen Shijin made friends through painting, and those who came to request paintings had to compose poems on the spot, exchanging poems for paintings, hence the name.

North of the studio are the "Ni Yunlin Landscape Stone Carvings" and Deshuang Pavilion.

In those years, Chen Shijin hired stonemason Zhang Cuishan to carve over 20 of the most famous model calligraphy albums from his collection on the corridor walls, with the "Wang Xizhi Goose-Exchange Stele" and "Ni Yunlin Landscape Stone Carvings" being the finest among them.

建筑要点 / Key Features
清咸丰四年1854年书画家陈式金1817-1867急人之用双倍价钱购下邻家宅基他运用书画理论亲自指挥开池堆山筑房构屋由于是无意为园而适成之取名适园太平天国时期适园被太平军占为王府得以保存收复后其子陈曦唐主持重修陈氏父子皆擅长书画兼工诗词适园营造颇得诗情画意文革时期适园作为印刷厂工人宿舍而幸免于难是江阴现存最好的古典园林适园西侧为陈氏住宅近年修复园门在靠近住宅一侧园林以南部镜湖和北部假山为主体南东北三侧环绕湖山布置亭堂轩馆等建筑北部假山用土堆成三面皆有路可以登山路旁立黄石峰山顶为超然台设有石桌石凳供人休憩眺远假山北部是得蝶绕云山馆原为陈家祭祖厅堂向南隔着水池与主堂水流云在轩相对这一馆一轩都含有云字喻指北部这座假山古代将石比作云得蝶绕云山馆处在山林间为蝶绕云山水流云在轩前临水池含水流心不竞云在意俱迟之意水流云在轩西侧有王羲之换鹅碑秋入湳波室和适安斋陈氏父子富于收藏曾收名人书画碑帖500余种当年便藏在适安斋中轩东经香廊通向池东的响秋书房书房东侧紧贴园墙北为黄石假山南为湖石假山采用立体作法其下为洞其上为台两山一脉通贯气势相连书房北部是易画轩陈式金以画会友来求画者需当场作诗以诗易画由此得名轩北为

中文原文

江阴是防卫长江的要塞，市内的黄山距长江北岸最窄，岩壁陡峭，素有"江海门户""镇航要塞"之称。清康熙年间清政府就在此修筑炮台，同治、光绪年间，为防外舰入侵，再次增筑炮台，成为中外闻名的江阴要塞。

如今清理出土了7座清同治十三年（1874）的古炮和2尊"耀武大将军"万斤铁炮及弹丸。黄山炮台对面为鹅山炮台，皆可供人凭吊古战场遗迹。

· · · · ·
English

Jiangyin is a fortress defending the Yangtze River; Huangshan (Yellow Mountain) in the city is at the narrowest point from the north bank of the Yangtze, with steep rock walls, known as the "Gateway of River and Sea" and "Navigational Fortress.

" During the Kangxi reign of the Qing, the Qing government already built batteries here; during the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns, to prevent foreign warship invasion, batteries were again added, becoming the internationally famous Jiangyin Fortress.

Today, 7 ancient cannons from the 13th year of Tongzhi of the Qing (1874) and 2 "Yaowu General" ten-thousand-catty iron cannons with cannonballs have been excavated.

Opposite the Huangshan Battery is the Eshan Battery, both可供 people to pay homage to the ancient battlefield ruins.

26 徐霞客故居
Former Residence of Xu Xiake
明
级别 Level
第五批全国重点文物保护单位（2011年，含晴山堂石刻）
地址 Address
江阴市徐霞客镇（马镇）
类型 Type
名人故居
门票 Ticket
12元，35元联票含故居和博物馆

8:00 — 16:30
中文原文

徐霞客（1587—1641），名弘祖，字振之，号霞客，是明代伟大的地理学家、探险家和旅行家，足迹遍及今19个省区市，留下60余万字的《徐霞客游记》。故居始建于明代，原有三进，两侧有厢房，故居内有徐霞客塑像和生平事迹陈列。故居正厅前东侧有古罗汉松，原植于江阴君山，徐霞客曾在松下读书，后移此。

故居东南为晴山堂，始建于明万历四十八年（1620年），徐霞客为庆贺母亲大病初愈而建，取"四月清和雨乍晴，南山当户转分明"诗意，堂内嵌有元末明初84位名家撰写的95块石刻，具有很高的历史和书法艺术价值。

故居西南为徐霞客墓，1978年迁建于此，墓前立石碑，上刻"十七世霞客徐公之墓"。故居北侧为徐霞客旅游博物馆，展示徐霞客的旅行路线和探险精神。

· · · · ·
English

Xu Xiake (1587-1641), given name Hongzu, style name Zhenzhi, hao Xiake, was a great geographer, explorer, and traveler of the Ming Dynasty, with footprints spanning today's 19 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities, leaving over 600,000 characters of the "Travels of Xu Xiake.

" The former residence was first built in the Ming Dynasty, originally with three rows and wing rooms on both sides; inside the residence are a statue of Xu Xiake and an exhibition of his life and deeds.

East of the front of the main hall is an ancient Podocarpus tree, originally planted at Junshan in Jiangyin, where Xu Xiake once studied under the tree, later moved here.

Southeast of the residence is the Qingshan (Clear Mountain) Hall, first built in the 48th year of Wanli of the Ming (1620), built by Xu Xiake to celebrate his mother's recovery from a serious illness, taking the poetic meaning "April clear and mild, rain just cleared, the southern mountain facing the door turns distinct"; embedded in the hall are 95 stone carvings written by 84 famous masters from the late Yuan to early Ming, with high historical and calligraphic artistic value.

Southwest of the residence is the Tomb of Xu Xiake, relocated here in 1978, with a stone stele in front of the tomb inscribed "Tomb of Lord Xu, 17th Generation Xiake.

" North of the residence is the Xu Xiake Tourism Museum, displaying Xu Xiake's travel routes and spirit of exploration.

建筑要点 / Key Features
徐霞客1587-1641名弘祖字振之号霞客是明代伟大的地理学家探险家和旅行家足迹遍及今19个省区市留下60余万字的徐霞客游记故居始建于明代原有三进两侧有厢房故居内有徐霞客塑像和生平事迹陈列故居正厅前东侧有古罗汉松原植于江阴君山徐霞客曾在松下读书后移此故居东南为晴山堂始建于明万历四十八年1620年徐霞客为庆贺母亲大病初愈而建取四月清和雨乍晴南山当户转分明诗意堂内嵌有元末明初84位名家撰写的95块石刻具有很高的历史和书法艺术价值故居西南为徐霞客墓1978年迁建于此墓前立石碑上刻十七世霞客徐公之墓故居北侧为徐霞客旅游博物馆展示徐霞客的旅行路线和探险精神
27 周王庙
Zhouwang Temple
明—清
级别 Level
第七批全国重点文物保护单位（2013年）
地址 Address
宜城镇东庙巷9号
类型 Type
祠庙
中文原文

周王庙奉祠晋平西将军周处（242—297），始建于晋元康九年（299年），原名周孝侯庙，南宋绍兴年间赠"英烈"庙额，称周王庙，明嘉靖四十五年（1566年）重建，现存戏台、正殿和后殿共三进，并有唐至清碑刻一百余方（其中唐碑2方、宋碑8方、元碑2方、明碑64方、清民国碑23方），具有很高的历史价值和艺术价值。

周处（240—297）是阳羡（今宜兴）人，自幼膂力过人，好生事端，邻里乡亲将他与山中虎、水中蛟并称为"三害"。他后来悔过自新，斩蛟射虎，又拜陆机、陆云为师，学识大进，受到乡里称道，"周处除三害"的故事被刘义庆收入《世说新语·自新》，广为流传。后经州府推荐，周处历任多县太守及楚内史、散骑常侍、御史中丞等职。

晋元康六年（296年）氐族起兵反晋，周处被任命为建威将军，第二年在陕西六陌（今属乾县）力战而死。晋建武元年（304年）朝廷追赠他为平西将军、清流亭侯，后世称为周孝侯。周王庙第一进戏楼为1994年重建。

第二进大殿建于明嘉靖四十五年（1566年），采用前轩后殿布局，宽五间、深九架，建筑立柱用花岗岩、阳山石和青石制作，高敞宏伟。

大殿内存唐至清碑刻18通，最珍贵的是唐元和六年（811年）《平西将军周府君碑》和明重刻王羲之《晋周孝侯碑》。

第三进后殿世泽堂也建于明代，2000年增建两侧耳房，东西围墙碑廊中有唐贞义女碑、宋李曾柏生平碑、宋苏东坡楚颂碑和明净云枝法帖等80余通。

· · · · ·
English

Zhouwang Temple enshrines Zhou Chu (242-297), General Who Pacifies the West of the Jin Dynasty, first built in the 9th year of Yuankang of the Jin (299), originally named the Zhou Xiaohou (Zhou the Filial Marquis) Temple; during the Shaoxing reign of the Southern Song, it was granted the temple plaque "Yinglie" (Heroic Martyr), called Zhouwang Temple; rebuilt in the 45th year of Jiajing of the Ming (1566), today preserves three rows: stage, main hall, and rear hall, with over a hundred stele carvings from the Tang to Qing (including 2 Tang steles, 8 Song steles, 2 Yuan steles, 64 Ming steles, and 23 Qing-Republic steles), with high historical and artistic value.

Zhou Chu (240-297) was a native of Yangxian (today's Yixing); from childhood he had extraordinary physical strength and liked to cause trouble, and neighbors and villagers called him, together with the tiger in the mountains and the flood dragon in the water, the "Three Scourges.

" He later repented and reformed, killing the flood dragon and shooting the tiger, and then became a disciple of Lu Ji and Lu Yun, greatly advancing his learning, receiving praise from the village; the story of "Zhou Chu Eliminating the Three Scourges" was included by Liu Yiqing in "A New Account of the Tales of the World·Self-Renewal," widely circulated.

Later recommended by prefectural and county authorities, Zhou Chu successively served as magistrate of multiple counties, as well as Interior Minister of Chu, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, and Censorate Vice Censor-in-Chief etc.

In the 6th year of Yuankang of the Jin (296), the Di people rose up against Jin, and Zhou Chu was appointed General Who Establishes Might; the following year he died fighting at Liumo in Shaanxi (today belonging to Qianxian).

In the 1st year of Jianwu of the Jin (304), the court posthumously awarded him General Who Pacifies the West and Marquis of Qingliu Ting, later generations calling him Zhou Xiaohou.

The first row of Zhouwang Temple, the opera tower, was rebuilt in 1994.

The second row, the main hall, was built in the 45th year of Jiajing of the Ming (1566), adopting a front-veranda rear-hall layout, five bays wide and nine rafters deep, with building columns made of granite, Yangshan stone, and bluestone, tall and magnificent.

The main hall preserves 18 stele carvings from the Tang to Qing, the most precious being the "Stele of Lord Zhou's Mansion, General Who Pacifies the West" from the 6th year of Yuanhe of the Tang (811) and the Ming re-carving of Wang Xizhi's "Stele of Jin Zhou Xiaohou.

" The third row, the rear hall Shize (Inheriting Grace) Hall, was also built in the Ming; in 2000 side rooms were added on both sides, and the stele corridors on the east and west enclosure walls contain over 80 pieces including the Tang Zhenyi (Chaste Righteous) Daughter Stele, Song Li Zengbai's Life Stele, Song Su Dongpo's Chu Song Stele, and Ming Jingyunzhi Model Calligraphy Album etc.

建筑要点 / Key Features
周王庙奉祠晋平西将军周处242-297始建于晋元康九年299年原名周孝侯庙南宋绍兴年间赠英烈庙额称周王庙明嘉靖四十五年1566年重建现存戏台正殿和后殿共三进并有唐至清碑刻一百余方其中唐碑2方宋碑8方元碑2方明碑64方清民国碑23方具有很高的历史价值和艺术价值周处240-297是阳羡今宜兴人自幼膂力过人好生事端邻里乡亲将他与山中虎水中蛟并称为三害他后来悔过自新斩蛟射虎又拜陆机陆云为师学识大进受到乡里称道周处除三害的故事被刘义庆收入世说新语自新广为流传后经州府推荐周处历任多县太守及楚内史散骑常侍御史中丞等职晋元康六年296年氐族起兵反晋周处被任命为建威将军第二年在陕西六陌今属乾县力战而死晋建武元年304年朝廷追赠他为平西将军清流亭侯后世称为周孝侯周王庙第一进戏楼为1994年重建第二进大殿建于明嘉靖四十五年1566年采用前轩后殿布局宽五间深九架建筑立柱用花岗岩阳山石和青石制作高敞宏伟大殿内存唐至清碑刻18通最珍贵的是唐元和六年811年平西将军周府君碑和明重刻王羲之王晋周孝侯碑第三进后殿世泽堂也建于明代2000年增建两侧耳房东西围墙碑廊中有唐贞义女碑宋李曾柏生平碑宋苏东坡楚颂碑和明净云枝法帖等
28 瀛园
Yingyuan Garden

第七批江苏省文物保护单位（2011年）

中文原文

瀛园原为清乾隆年间谢庭扬的私宅，取潘岳《秋兴赋》"体以行和"之义命名为行园。后来行园毁于兵火，邑人将其与旁边建于清康熙年间的竹荫轩合并，改建为城隍庙花园，取"瀛洲仙境"之意称瀛园。园林以荷池为中心，北为正堂行和厅，西为望来亭和逸兴遄飞阁，南为竹荫轩，东部建有曲廊。

园中山水模拟宜兴的自然风光，山像铜官，水似西氿，池西石桥则仿善卷洞、张公洞，颇具匠心。

· · · · ·
English

Yingyuan Garden was originally the private residence of Xie Tingyang during the Qianlong reign of the Qing, taking the meaning of "the body acts in harmony" from Pan Yue's "Ode to Autumn Awakening" to name it Xingyuan (Action-Harmony Garden).

Later Xingyuan was destroyed by war fires; local people merged it with the adjacent Zhuyin (Bamboo Shade) Studio built during the Kangxi reign of the Qing, rebuilding it into the City God Temple Garden, taking the meaning of "Yingzhou Immortal Realm" to call it Yingyuan (Immortal Isle Garden).

The garden centers on the lotus pond, with the main hall Xinghe (Action-Harmony) Hall to the north, Wanglai (Welcoming Arrivals) Pavilion and Yixing Chuanfei (Leisurely Soaring) Pavilion to the west, Zhuyin Studio to the south, and a winding corridor built in the east.

The mountains and waters in the garden imitate Yixing's natural scenery: the mountains resemble Tongguan, the waters resemble West Jiu (a local lake), and the stone bridge west of the pond imitates Shanjuan Cave and Zhanggong Cave—quite ingenious.

建筑要点 / Key Features
瀛园原为清乾隆年间谢庭扬的私宅取潘岳秋兴赋体以行和之义命名为行园后来行园毁于兵火邑人将其与旁边建于清康熙年间的竹荫轩合并改建为城隍庙花园取瀛洲仙境之意称瀛园园林以荷池为中心北为正堂行和厅西为望来亭和逸兴遄飞阁南为竹荫轩东部建有曲廊园中山水模拟宜兴的自然风光山像铜官水似西氿池西石桥则仿善卷洞张公洞颇具匠心

中文原文

这处王府原为史氏私宅，太平军进驻宜兴时成为辅王杨辅清府第，后又作为忠王李秀成行辕。王府原有四进，第四进转盘楼1912年失火被烧。府中最具特色的是壁画，表现了太平天国希望构建的理想社会：第一进大门有四扇屏门，绘鲤鱼跃龙门；第二进大厅绘山亭花木等八幅壁画；第三进东西墙绘四季山水和官农劳作等四幅壁画。

· · · · ·
English

This prince's mansion was originally the private residence of the Shi family; when the Taiping Army occupied Yixing, it became the residence of Prince Fu Yang Fuqing, and later served as the field headquarters of Prince Zhong Li Xiucheng.

The mansion originally had four rows; the fourth row, the revolving tower, burned down in a fire in 1912.

The most distinctive feature of the mansion is its murals, expressing the ideal society that the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom hoped to build: the first row's main gate has four screen doors painted with carp leaping over the dragon gate; the second row's main hall is painted with eight murals including mountain pavilions, flowers and trees; the third row's east and west walls are painted with four murals including four-season landscapes and official-farmer labor.

常州

Changzhou
16
处建筑

地区概述 / Regional Overview

远古时期常州已有人类活动，在溧阳发现了旧石器时代的中华曙猿化石，金坛有新石器时代的三星村遗址等。常州保存着中国现存最古老的地面城池遗址，即距今2500多年前的淹城遗址，为中国城市史添写了精彩而独特的一笔；在今常州与无锡交界处，还有吴王阖闾修筑的阖闾城。常州最早见诸史册的名称是延陵，公元前574年季札封在此地，后世称其为延陵季子。

《左传》有"季札观乐"的故事，他在鲁国欣赏周乐，对风、雅、颂一一作出精辟的分析和点评。季札重信义，他出访列国途经徐国时，徐君爱慕他的佩剑，但不好意思开口，季札心知其意，因还要访问列国，不便相赠。待他归途再经徐国时，徐君已死，季札慨然解下佩剑悬在徐君墓旁树上，"季子挂剑"的故事传为千古美谈。

司马迁《史记》称誉季札是"慕义无穷，见微而知清浊"的仁者，"闳览博物"的君子。今常州市中心大道称延陵路，人民公园有季子亭。秦置延陵县，汉称毗陵，西晋太康二年（281年）设毗陵郡，永兴元年（305年）为避司马毗讳，改称晋陵。

隋开皇九年（589年）在常熟县置州，得名常州，后来常熟割给苏州，州治移至晋陵，随着京杭大运河的开通，常州进入迅速发展时期。唐天宝年间，常州已被称作"江左大郡"，"兵食之所资，财富之所出，公家之所给，岁以万计"（梁肃《独孤公行状》）。

在唐末的战乱中钱镠创建吴越国，使江南获得安定；南宋人口和财富的南迁，使常州成为重要的粮食产地，时有"苏常熟，天下足"的民谚。

唐宋之际是常州地位发生大转折的时期，如清人靳辅所称："江南之苏、松、常、镇，浙江之杭、嘉、湖等府，在汉唐以前不过一泽国尔，自钱镠窃据，南宋偏安，民聚而地辟，遂为财富之薮。

"此后常州与苏州、杭州、湖州等并称，成为国家财政的支柱，如康熙朝江南巡抚慕天颜所奏："江南财赋甲天下，苏、松、常、镇课额尤冠于江南。

"与财富积累相伴随的是人文的昌盛，尤以明清两代最著：常州学派、常州词派、常州画派……竞相涌现，唐顺之、洪亮吉、恽南田……名家辈出，在建筑上则体现为大批宅第和园林的建造。

唐顺之家族有唐氏八宅、陈渡草堂、半园，吴亮、吴玄兄弟有青山庄、白鹤园、嘉树园、止园、五亩园和罗浮园等，杨廷鉴有东皋园，李长祥有桃园……造园名家周秉忠、周廷策父子、计成、戈裕良都活跃在这一带，陆燕喆《张陶庵传》评价康熙朝御用造园师张然称："所假有延陵之石，有高阳之石，有安定之石……"首先提到的就是张然在常州的作品。

明清时期的常州俨然是一座"百园之城"。但现代常州园林并不知名，这与这座城市的遭遇有关。

早在南宋末年元兵南侵，常州人便奋起抵御，元《大德毗陵志》称他们为"不达时宜者，不能望风迎降，所以衣冠文物，扫荡无余"，如今常州几乎没有元代之前的建筑遗存。

经过明清两代的休养生息，到晚清太平军与清军又在常州发生激烈的巷战，巨宅名园焚烧殆尽。常州人留下的是不屈的气节，实物保存反倒很少。

尽管如此，今天仍能看到北宋的经幢，苏轼的砚池，前后北岸、青果巷的民居，近园、未园和约园等精巧的园林，让游人凭借这些劫后的遗存，联想常州曾有的辉煌。

常州于2015年6月被国务院公布为国家历史文化名城，今辖天宁区、钟楼区、戚墅堰区、新北区（市政府驻地）和武进区5个区，代管溧阳市、金坛市2个县级市，有国家级文物保护单位10处，省级文物保护单位45处，本书介绍国保建筑4处，省保建筑11处，其他建筑4处。

In ancient times, Changzhou already had human activities; fossils of Sinopithecus (Chinese Dawn Ape) from the Paleolithic Age were discovered in Liyang, and the Sanxingcun Site from the Neolithic Age exists in Jintan etc.

Changzhou preserves China's oldest existing above-ground city site—the Yancheng (Sunken City) Site from over 2500 years ago, adding a brilliant and unique chapter to Chinese urban history; at the junction of today's Changzhou and Wuxi, there is also the Helü City built by King Helü of Wu.

The earliest name of Changzhou in historical records is Yanling; in 574 BC, Jizha was enfeoffed here, and later generations called him Yanling Jizi.

The "Zuo Zhuan" has the story of "Jizha Observing Music," in which he appreciated Zhou music in the State of Lu and made incisive analyses and comments on the Feng, Ya, and Song one by one.

Jizha valued faith and righteousness; when he passed through the State of Xu on a diplomatic mission, the Lord of Xu admired his sword but was too embarrassed to ask; Jizha understood his intention but, because he still had to visit other states, could not give it away.

When he returned through Xu, the Lord of Xu had already died, so Jizha generously unfastened his sword and hung it on a tree beside the Lord of Xu's tomb—the story of "Jizi Hanging the Sword" became an eternal tale of beauty.

Sima Qian's "Records of the Grand Historian" praised Jizha as a benevolent man who "pursued righteousness endlessly, seeing the subtle and knowing the clear and turbid," and a gentleman of "broad vision and extensive knowledge.

" Today the central avenue of Changzhou is called Yanling Road, and People's Park has the Jizi Pavilion.

The Qin established Yanling County, the Han called it Piling; in the 2nd year of Taikang of the Western Jin (281), Piling Commandery was established; in the 1st year of Yongxing (305), to avoid the name taboo of Sima Pi, it was renamed Jinling.

In the 9th year of Kaihuang of the Sui (589), a prefecture was established in Changshu County, giving the name Changzhou; later Changshu was ceded to Suzhou, and the prefecture seat moved to Jinling.

With the opening of the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, Changzhou entered a period of rapid development.

During the Tianbao reign of the Tang, Changzhou was already called a "great commandery east of the Yangtze," where "military provisions are sourced, wealth produced, and public supplies given, counted in tens of thousands annually" (Liang Su, "Account of the Deeds of Dugu Gong").

During the late-Tang wars, Qian Liu founded the Wuyue Kingdom, bringing stability to Jiangnan; the southward migration of population and wealth in the Southern Song made Changzhou an important grain-producing area, with the folk saying "When Su and Chang are ripe, the world is full.

" The Tang-Song transition was a period of major转折 in Changzhou's status, as Qing person Jin Fu stated: "The Su, Song, Chang, Zhen of Jiangnan, and the Hang, Jia, Hu etc.

of Zhejiang, before the Han and Tang were merely marshlands; since Qian Liu's separatist rule and the Southern Song's partial security, people gathered and land was opened, becoming a gathering place of wealth.

" Thereafter Changzhou ranked alongside Suzhou, Hangzhou, and Huzhou etc.

, becoming a pillar of national finance, as Mu Tianyan, Governor of Jiangnan during the Kangxi reign, memorialized: "Jiangnan's taxes and finances lead the world, and the tax quotas of Su, Song, Chang, Zhen especially lead Jiangnan.

" Accompanying the accumulation of wealth was the flourishing of culture and humanities, most notably in the Ming and Qing dynasties: the Changzhou School of Classical Learning, Changzhou School of Ci Poetry, Changzhou School of Painting.

..emerged in competition; Tang Shunzhi, Hong Liangji, Yun Nantian...

famous masters appeared in abundance, reflected architecturally in the construction of large numbers of residences and gardens.

Tang Shunzhi's family had the Tang Family Eight Residences, Chen Du Thatched Hall, and Banyuan; Wu Liang and Wu Xuan brothers had Qingshan Manor, Baihe Garden, Jiashu Garden, Zhiyuan, Wumu Garden, and Luofu Garden etc.

; Yang Tingjian had Donggao Garden; Li Changxiang had Taoyuan...garden masters Zhou Bingzhong, Zhou Tingce father and son, Ji Cheng, and Ge Yuliang were all active in this area.

Lu Yanzhe's "Biography of Zhang Tao'an" evaluated Zhang Ran, the imperial garden master of the Kangxi reign: "What he borrowed included stones from Yanling, stones from Gaoyang, stones from Anding...

" The first mentioned was Zhang Ran's works in Changzhou.During the Ming and Qing, Changzhou was truly a "city of a hundred gardens.

" But modern Changzhou gardens are not well-known, related to this city's experiences.

As early as the late Southern Song, when Yuan troops invaded south, Changzhou people rose up to resist; the Yuan "Dade Piling Gazetteer" called them "people who did not understand the times, unable to surrender at the sight of the wind, so their robes, hats, cultural relics were swept away without remainder," and today Changzhou has almost no architectural remains before the Yuan Dynasty.

After recuperation during the Ming and Qing, in the late Qing the Taiping Army and Qing Army again fought fierce street battles in Changzhou, burning great mansions and famous gardens to ashes.

What Changzhou people left behind was unyielding integrity, while physical preservation was comparatively rare.

Nevertheless, today one can still see Northern Song dharani pillars, Su Shi's inkstone pool, the residences of Qianhou Beian and Qingguo Lane, and exquisite gardens such as Jinyuan, Weiyuan, and Yueyuan, allowing visitors to rely on these post-catastrophe remains to imagine Changzhou's former glory.

Changzhou was announced by the State Council as a National Historical and Cultural City in June 2015; today it administers 5 districts: Tianning, Zhonglou, Qishuyan, Xinbei (municipal government seat), and Wujin, and代管 2 county-level cities: Liyang and Jintan; it has 10 national-level cultural heritage protection units and 45 provincial-level cultural heritage protection units; this book introduces 4 national-protected buildings, 11 provincial-protected buildings, and 4 other buildings.

01 淹城遗址
Yancheng City Site
东周
级别 Level
第三批全国重点文物保护单位（1988年）
地址 Address
武进区湖塘镇
类型 Type
古城遗址
门票 Ticket
淹城遗址门票20元，淹城乐园通票160元（含淹城遗址）
开放时间 Hours
9:00 — 17:00
中文原文

淹城是中国目前保存最完整的春秋时期城市遗址。有学者认为是春秋中期吴国的都城，也有学者认为是淹国移民南迁时的都城。淹城由三重城垣和城壕组成，当地民谣形象地称作："里罗城，外罗城，中间方形紫罗城。"最内部是方形的子城，俗称紫罗城或王城，城周约500米，外绕子城河。向外是方形的内城，又称内罗城或中城，城周1500米，外绕内城河。

最外面是椭圆形的外城，东西长850米，南北宽750米，总面积约65公顷，外绕外城河。

三道城垣都用土堆成，存高3—10米，底部宽30米左右；三条护城河均深4—10米，宽30—50米，展示了中国先民筑城的形制和技艺。淹城出土了中国最古老、最巨大的独木舟，推测是当时进出淹城的交通工具，今收藏在南京博物院。

三道城墙像三条逶迤盘踞的长龙，外面环绕着三条清波荡漾的河流，掩映在茂林修竹间，漫步其中，仿佛回到了两千多年前，予人一种深沉浑厚的沧桑感。2010年在淹城北侧建成以先秦诸子为主题的淹城春秋乐园，让游人在娱乐中品味传统文化。

· · · · ·
English

Yancheng (Sunken City) Site is China's best-preserved city site from the Spring and Autumn Period.

Some scholars believe it was the capital of the State of Wu in the mid-Spring and Autumn Period, while others believe it was the capital of migrants from the State of Yan who moved south.

Yancheng consists of three layers of city walls and moats, vividly described in a local folk song: "Inner Luo City, outer Luo City, with a square purple Luo City in the middle.

" The innermost part is the square Zicheng (Child City), commonly called the Purple Luo City or King's City, with a circumference of about 500 meters, surrounded by the Zicheng River.

Outward is the square inner city, also called the Inner Luo City or Middle City, with a circumference of 1500 meters, surrounded by the Inner City River.

The outermost is the oval outer city, 850 meters east-west and 750 meters north-south, with a total area of about 65 hectares, surrounded by the Outer City River.

All three city walls are piled with earth, surviving at a height of 3-10 meters, with a base width of about 30 meters; all three moats are 4-10 meters deep and 30-50 meters wide, demonstrating the form and technique of ancient Chinese city building.

Yancheng yielded China's oldest and largest dugout canoe, presumed to be the transportation vehicle for entering and leaving Yancheng at that time, now collected in the Nanjing Museum.

The three city walls resemble three winding and coiling long dragons, surrounded by three clear-wave rivers, shaded by dense forests and bamboo groves; strolling among them, one feels as if returned to over two thousand years ago, giving a deep and profound sense of vicissitudes.

In 2010, the Yancheng Spring and Autumn Paradise, themed on pre-Qin philosophers, was built north of Yancheng, allowing visitors to savor traditional culture through entertainment.

建筑要点 / Key Features
淹城是中国目前保存最完整的春秋时期城市遗址有学者认为是春秋中期吴国的都城也有学者认为是淹国移民南迁时的都城淹城由三重城垣和城壕组成当地民谣形象地称作里罗城外罗城中间方形紫罗城最内部是方形的子城俗称紫罗城或王城城周约500米外绕子城河向外是方形的内城又称内罗城或中城城周1500米外绕内城河最外面是椭圆形的外城东西长850米南北宽750米总面积约65公顷外绕外城河三道城垣都用土堆成存高3-10米底部宽30米左右三条护城河均深4-10米宽30-50米展示了中国先民筑城的形制和技艺淹城出土了中国最古老最巨大的独木舟推测是当时进出淹城的交通工具今收藏在南京博物院三道城墙像三条逶迤盘踞的长龙外面环绕着三条清波荡漾的河流掩映在茂林修竹间漫步其中仿佛回到了两千多年前予人一种深沉浑厚的沧桑感2010年在淹城北侧建成以先秦诸子为主题的淹城春秋乐园让游人在娱乐中品味传统文化
02 近园
Jinyuan Garden
清
级别 Level
第七批全国重点文物保护单位（2013年）
地址 Address
天宁区晋陵中路418号，常州宾馆内
类型 Type
古典园林
门票 Ticket
免费
中文原文

近园原为明万历年间陕西布政使恽厥初（1572—1652）的别业，清康熙六年（1667年）杨青岩（字兆鲁）购得改筑，康熙十一年（1672年）完工，取"近乎成园"之意命名为近园。

杨兆鲁作《近园记》，邀请书画名家恽南田书石，王翚绘《近园图》，笪重光题跋，文士方邵村、龚百药、董文骥等常到园中做客，堪称一时之盛。清同治初年归福建按察使刘翊宸，光绪十一年（1885年）又归恽彦琦，因重回恽氏手中，更名复园，后又称静园，民间则呼为"恽家花园"。园林中部为水池，周遭紧贴园墙布置建筑和游廊。

池中小岛面积较大，将园林分隔为南北两区，各成一体。小岛东西两侧皆有石桥与岸相连，岛上堆叠假山，树木葱郁。今入口在容膝居北侧游廊下，原入口在园西，靠近住宅，入门站在廊内可望见岛上假山。沿游廊向北，可入秋水亭小坐，此亭位置较高，为隔池赏山佳处。出亭沿游廊北行东折，池北为主厅西野草堂，堂前平台开阔，适宜宴饮聚会。

其东南角有数级石阶通向水面，可在此登舟游泛。堂东有游廊通向容膝居，廊壁嵌名家书画碑刻，其西竹木掩映，别成幽境，适合闲步读碑。容膝居东侧出临池敞廊，题名虚舟，可倚在美人靠上欣赏假山。至此，游客已在入口、游廊、高亭、草堂和敞廊等多处或远或近地欣赏过假山，穿过虚舟南侧的小桥则可登岛入山，近距离地游览。

岛上假山用黄石叠成，分为南北两组。北山高耸，可沿蹬道登顶临眺；山下叠筑垂纶洞，又可在洞内静坐，窥望洞外风景。南山相对平缓，上立见一亭，典雅精致，可在亭内周览园景。水池南岸有天香阁和得月轩两座建筑，向北与掩映在竹林间的见一亭相对。南部的池面以清幽取胜，与北部池面的开阔形成对比。近园造园手法洗练，园景丰富，为现存江南园林中的佳作。

· · · · ·
English

Jinyuan (Near-Completion Garden) was originally the villa of Yun Juechu (1572-1652), Governor of Shaanxi during the Wanli reign of the Ming; in the 6th year of Kangxi of the Qing (1667), Yang Qingyan (style name Zhaolu) purchased and rebuilt it, completed in the 11th year of Kangxi (1672), taking the meaning of "nearly becoming a garden" to name it Jinyuan.

Yang Zhaolu wrote the "Record of Jinyuan," inviting the famous calligrapher-painter Yun Nantian to inscribe on stone, Wang Hui to paint the "Painting of Jinyuan," and Da Chongguang to write the colophon; literati Fang Shaocun, Gong Baiyao, Dong Wenji etc.

often visited the garden as guests, arguably a grand gathering of the time.

In the early Tongzhi reign of the Qing, it passed to Liu Yichen, Surveillance Commissioner of Fujian; in the 11th year of Guangxu (1885), it again passed to Yun Yanqi; because it returned to the Yun family, it was renamed Fuyuan (Restored Garden), later also called Jingyuan (Quiet Garden), while folk called it the "Yun Family Garden.

" The center of the garden is a pond, with buildings and corridors arranged around it紧贴 the garden wall.

The small island in the pond is relatively large, dividing the garden into north and south zones, each forming an integrated whole.

Both east and west sides of the island have stone bridges connecting to the banks; rockeries are piled on the island, with lush trees.

Today's entrance is under the corridor north of Rongxiju (Knees-Fit Residence); the original entrance was west of the garden, near the residence, and entering and standing in the corridor one can see the rockery on the island.

Following the corridor northward, one can sit for a while in the Qiushui (Autumn Water) Pavilion; this pavilion is relatively high, an excellent place to admire the mountain across the pond.

Exiting the pavilion and following the corridor northward then turning east, north of the pond is the main hall Xiye (West Wild Grass) Hall, with an open platform in front suitable for banquets and gatherings.

At its southeast corner are several stone steps leading to the water, where one can board a boat for a tour.

East of the hall is a corridor leading to Rongxiju, with the corridor walls embedded with famous calligraphy and painting stele carvings; west of it, shaded by bamboo and trees, forms a secluded realm suitable for leisurely strolling and reading steles.

East of Rongxiju, an open corridor facing the pond emerges, titled Xuzhou (Empty Boat), where one can lean on the beauty-rest (backrest railing) to admire the rockery.

By this point, visitors have already admired the rockery from near and far at multiple places: the entrance, corridor, high pavilion, thatched hall, and open corridor; crossing the small bridge south of Xuzhou, one can climb onto the island and enter the mountain for a close-up tour.

The rockery on the island is piled with yellow stone, divided into north and south groups.

The north mountain is tall, and one can climb along the stone path to the top for a panoramic view; at the foot of the mountain, the Chuilun (Fishing Line) Cave is built, where one can sit quietly and peek at the scenery outside the cave.

The south mountain is relatively gentle, with the Jianyi (Seeing One) Pavilion standing on it, elegant and refined, allowing a panoramic view of the garden from inside the pavilion.

On the south bank of the pond are two buildings: the Tianxiang (Heavenly Fragrance) Pavilion and the Deyue (Getting the Moon) Studio, facing north toward the Jianyi Pavilion shaded among bamboo groves.

The southern pond surface excels in serenity and seclusion, contrasting with the openness of the northern pond surface.

Jinyuan's garden-building techniques are concise and refined, with rich garden scenery, making it a fine example among existing Jiangnan gardens.

建筑要点 / Key Features
近园原为明万历年间陕西布政使恽厥初1572-1652的别业清康熙六年1667年杨青岩字兆鲁购得改筑康熙十一年1672年完工取近乎成园之意命名为近园杨兆鲁作近园记邀请书画名家恽南田书石王翚绘近园图笪重光题跋文士方邵村龚百药董文骥等常到园中做客堪称一时之盛清同治初年归福建按察使刘翊宸光绪十一年1885年又归恽彦琦因重回恽氏手中更名复园后又称静园民间则呼为恽家花园园林中部为水池周遭紧贴园墙布置建筑和游廊池中小岛面积较大将园林分隔为南北两区各成一体小岛东西两侧皆有石桥与岸相连岛上堆叠假山树木葱郁今入口在容膝居北侧游廊下原入口在园西靠近住宅入门站在廊内可望见岛上假山沿游廊向北可入秋水亭小坐此亭位置较高为隔池赏山佳处出亭沿游廊北行东折池北为主厅西野草堂堂前平台开阔适宜宴饮聚会其东南角有数级石阶通向水面可在此登舟游泛堂东有游廊通向容膝居廊壁嵌名家书画碑刻其西竹木掩映别成幽境适合闲步读碑容膝居东侧出临池敞廊题名虚舟可倚在美人靠上欣赏假山至此游客已在入口游廊高亭草堂和敞廊等多处或远或近地欣赏过假山穿过虚舟南侧的小桥则可登岛入山近距离地游览岛上假山用黄石叠成分为南北两组北山高耸可沿蹬道登顶临眺山下叠筑垂纶
03 未园
Weiyuan Garden
民国
级别 Level
第四批江苏省文物保护单位（1995年）
地址 Address
钟楼区天王堂弄少年宫内
类型 Type
近代园林
开放时间 Hours
需从少年宫进入，仅周六、周日对个人开放，其他时间只接待团体
中文原文

未园原为"钱祥丰"木行主钱遴甫（1879—1940）的宅基地，西侧曾建三座堂屋。1920年在门客许秉煜建议下决定造园，1923年建成。"一木为未"，未园喻指一名木商之园，又隐含"尚未成园"的谦逊。

园林南北长、东西宽，入口原在西侧，今改为东侧，园内有四宜厅、滴翠轩、乐鱼榭、垂虹亭、汲玉亭、挹爽亭和长春亭各景，并点缀奇石假山、清池卉木。园中太湖石和黄石皆购自苏州，耗银20余万两。其中的福、禄、寿三奇石体现了商人的审美喜好。整座园林布局精巧、幽静雅致，虽建于近代却颇得古典园林之精髓。

· · · · ·
English

Weiyuan (Not-Yet Garden) was originally the homestead of Qian Linfu (1879-1940), owner of the Qianxiangfeng Timber Merchant; three main halls were once built on the west side.

In 1920, on the suggestion of retainer Xu Bingyu, it was decided to build a garden, completed in 1923.

"One wood makes 'wei' (not yet)," so Weiyuan metaphorically means a timber merchant's garden, and also implies the humility of "not yet a completed garden.

" The garden is long north-south and wide east-west, with the entrance originally on the west side, today changed to the east side; inside the garden are the Siyi (Suitable for All) Hall, Dicui (Dripping Green) Studio, Leyu (Happy Fish) Waterside Pavilion, Chuihong (Hanging Rainbow) Pavilion, Jiyu (Drawing Jade) Pavilion, Yishuang (Embracing Refreshing Coolness) Pavilion, and Changchun (Eternal Spring) Pavilion, with exotic rockeries, clear ponds, and flowers and trees interspersed.

The Taihu stones and yellow stones in the garden were all purchased from Suzhou, costing over 200,000 taels of silver.

Among them, the three exotic stones of Fortune, Prosperity, and Longevity reflect the aesthetic preferences of merchants.

The entire garden has an exquisite layout, serene and elegant, and although built in modern times, it well captures the essence of classical gardens.

建筑要点 / Key Features
未园原为钱祥丰木行主钱遴甫1879-1940的宅基地西侧曾建三座堂屋1920年在门客许秉煜建议下决定造园1923年建成一木为未未园喻指一名木商之园又隐含尚未成园的谦逊园林南北长东西宽入口原在西侧今改为东侧园内有四宜厅滴翠轩乐鱼榭垂虹亭汲玉亭挹爽亭和长春亭各景并点缀奇石假山清池卉木园中太湖石和黄石皆购自苏州耗银20余万两其中的福禄寿三奇石体现了商人的审美喜好整座园林布局精巧幽静雅致虽建于近代却颇得古典园林之精髓

Former Residence of Qu Qiubai

中文原文

中国共产党早期领导人瞿秋白（1899—1935）出生在青果巷82—84号的天香楼，原为唐氏八宅之八桂堂后楼，清末仅存废基，由秋白叔祖瞿赓甫购得，1890年至1898年拓建为宅第。

天香楼原有五进，今存四进，自南而北依次为大门、正厅、楠木厅和经楼天香楼，瞿秋白便出生在二楼西间。今瞿秋白故居原为瞿氏宗祠，1898年瞿赓甫入京面圣后，回湖北途经常州建造宗祠。包括东、西两院，前后四进。正屋在西首，内设祖宗牌位。瞿秋白一家寓住在东首厢房内。瞿赓甫常年在湖北任官，辅佐张之洞，家眷随其同住。秋白幼年祖父早逝，家境贫寒，全家寄居在叔祖的常州宅第内。

清光绪二十九年（1903年）瞿赓甫去世，家眷返回常州，秋白一家先迁往乌衣浜，再迁城西星聚堂，颠沛流离，直到1912年迁居瞿氏宗祠才稍为安定。瞿氏宗祠是秋白在常州的最后居住地。他少年时期在常州府中学堂读书，同学张太雷、任乃讷常来宗祠聚会。

1915年，秋白因贫困辍学，次年母亲不堪贫苦煎熬自尽。1916年11月，秋白离开家乡开始为革命奔波，直到1935年6月18日英勇就义。今故居东路辟为瞿秋白纪念馆，入口瞿秋白雕像后题有他的名句"我是江南第一燕，为衔春色上云霄"，贴切地勾勒出瞿秋白的精神和品格。

English

Qu Qiubai (1899-1935), an early leader of the Communist Party of China, was born in the Tianxiang (Heavenly Fragrance) Building at Nos.

82-84 Qingguo Lane, originally the rear building of the Bagui (Eight Osmanthus) Hall, one of the Tang Family Eight Residences; at the end of the Qing only ruins remained, purchased by Qu Qiubai's great-uncle Qu Gengfu, and expanded into a residence from 1890 to 1898.

The Tianxiang Building originally had five rows, today four survive, from south to north successively the gate, main hall, nanmu hall, and scripture tower Tianxiang Building; Qu Qiubai was born in the west room on the second floor.

Today's Former Residence of Qu Qiubai was originally the Qu Family Ancestral Shrine; in 1898, after Qu Gengfu went to Beijing to meet the emperor, he built the ancestral shrine in Changzhou on his way back to Hubei.

It includes east and west courtyards, with four rows front and back.The main house is at the west end, with ancestral tablets inside.Qu Qiubai's family lived in the east wing rooms.

Qu Gengfu served as an official in Hubei all year round, assisting Zhang Zhidong, with his family living with him.

Qiubai's grandfather died early in his childhood, and the family was poor, all living in his great-uncle's Changzhou residence.

In the 29th year of Guangxu of the Qing (1903), Qu Gengfu died, and the family returned to Changzhou; Qiubai's family first moved to Wuyibang, then to Xingju Hall west of the city, wandering and displaced, until moving to the Qu Family Ancestral Shrine in 1912 when they became somewhat settled.

The Qu Family Ancestral Shrine was Qiubai's last residence in Changzhou.

During his youth he studied at Changzhou Prefecture Middle School, and classmates Zhang Tailei and Ren Naine often came to the ancestral shrine for gatherings.

In 1915, Qiubai dropped out of school due to poverty; the following year his mother, unable to bear the suffering of poverty, took her own life.

In November 1916, Qiubai left his hometown to begin struggling for the revolution, until his heroic martyrdom on June 18, 1935.

Today the east road of the former residence is opened as the Qu Qiubai Memorial Hall; behind the statue of Qu Qiubai at the entrance is inscribed his famous line "I am the first swallow of Jiangnan, to carry spring colors up to the clouds," aptly outlining Qu Qiubai's spirit and character.

建筑要点 / Key Features
中国共产党早期领导人瞿秋白1899-1935出生在青果巷82-84号的天香楼原为唐氏八宅之八桂堂后楼清末仅存废基由秋白叔祖瞿赓甫购得1890年至1898年拓建为宅第天香楼原有五进今存四进自南而北依次为大门正厅楠木厅和经楼天香楼瞿秋白便出生在二楼西间今瞿秋白故居原为瞿氏宗祠1898年瞿赓甫入京面圣后回湖北途经常州建造宗祠包括东西两院前后四进正屋在西首内设祖宗牌位瞿秋白一家寓住在东首厢房内瞿赓甫常年在湖北任官辅佐张之洞家眷随其同住秋白幼年祖父早逝家境贫寒全家寄居在叔祖的常州宅第内清光绪二十九年1903年瞿赓甫去世家眷返回常州秋白一家先迁往乌衣浜再迁城西星聚堂颠沛流离直到1912年迁居瞿氏宗祠才稍为安定瞿氏宗祠是秋白在常州的最后居住地他少年时期在常州府中学堂读书同学张太雷任乃讷常来宗祠聚会1915年秋白因贫困辍学次年母亲不堪贫苦煎熬自尽1916年11月秋白离开家乡开始为革命奔波直到1935年6月18日英勇就义今故居东路辟为瞿秋白纪念馆入口瞿秋白雕像后题有他的名句我是江南第一燕为衔春色上云霄贴切地勾勒出瞿秋白的精神和品格
05 人民公园
People's Park
宋—民国
级别 Level
含崇法寺大殿、落星亭、浩然亭、意园等市保建筑
地址 Address
钟楼区延陵西路与公园路交汇处
类型 Type
公园/历史建筑
中文原文

人民公园前身是武进县商会会馆后花园，建于1908年，1913年对公众开放，是常州首座公园，时称公花园。今园内有崇法寺大殿、季子亭、落星亭、浩然亭和意园假山等市保建筑。

崇法寺相传最初为隋司徒陈国仁后圃，宋宣和七年（1125年）赐名崇法禅院。太平天国时期寺庙毁于战火，光绪年间重建部分殿堂，当时"法会之盛，几与天宁埒"。新中国成立后建设人民公园时拆除寺庙，仅留大殿。

落星亭建于清宣统二年（1910年），用4根金山石柱支撑，内砌石栏，形式别致。浩然亭建于明正德十五年（1520年），纪念宋末抗元死难的将士，亭名取文天祥《正气歌》"浩然者，乃天地之正气"之意。

此亭原在忠义祠后，清乾隆年间移建于今址，1984年重建。意园位于后北岸4—8号，原为康熙朝状元赵熊诏私园，后来太平军英王陈玉成在此驻扎，建筑毁于战火。

清光绪十二年（1886年）史干甫在此构园，集蔡襄"以意为之"四字悬于门额，因称意园。园由粉墙隔为内外两区，墙上开漏窗互通声气。内园有花厅、四季假山及恽南田曾寓居的瓯香馆画室。

外园为赵氏方玉堂旧址，南北狭长，有延桂山房、明月廊、鱼池、亭榭等景，北侧庑楼阁为园内最高处。今园内假山被迁至人民公园东南角重建。

English

The predecessor of People's Park was the rear garden of the Wujin County Chamber of Commerce Guild Hall, built in 1908, opened to the public in 1913, Changzhou's first park, then called the Public Garden.

Today the park contains municipal protected buildings such as the Chongfa Temple Main Hall, Jizi Pavilion, Luoxing (Falling Star) Pavilion, Haoran (Noble Spirit) Pavilion, and Yiyuan rockery.

According to tradition, Chongfa Temple was originally the rear garden of Sui Situ Chen Guoren; in the 7th year of Xuanhe of the Song (1125), it was granted the name Chongfa Chan Courtyard.

During the Taiping Rebellion the temple was destroyed by war fires, and part of the halls were rebuilt during the Guangxu reign; at that time "the grandeur of its religious assemblies was almost equal to Tianning Temple.

" When building People's Park after the founding of New China, the temple was demolished, leaving only the main hall.

The Luoxing Pavilion was built in the 2nd year of Xuantong of the Qing (1910), supported by 4 Jinshan stone columns, with stone railings built inside, in a unique form.

The Haoran Pavilion was built in the 15th year of Zhengde of the Ming (1520), commemorating the soldiers who died resisting the Yuan at the end of the Song; the pavilion name takes the meaning from Wen Tianxiang's "Song of the Noble Spirit": "The noble spirit is the righteous qi of heaven and earth.

" This pavilion was originally behind the Zhongyi (Loyalty and Righteousness) Shrine, moved to today's site during the Qianlong reign of the Qing, and rebuilt in 1984.

Yiyuan (Intention Garden) is located at Nos.

4-8 Houbei'an, originally the private garden of Zhao Xiongzhao, a zhuangyuan of the Kangxi reign; later the Taiping Army's Prince Ying Chen Yucheng was stationed here, and the buildings were destroyed by war fires.

In the 12th year of Guangxu of the Qing (1886), Shi Ganfu built a garden here, collecting Cai Xiang's four characters "acting by intention" to hang on the gate lintel, hence called Yiyuan.

The garden is divided into inner and outer zones by a whitewashed wall, with lattice windows opened on the wall for communication.

The inner garden has a flower hall, four-season rockery, and the Ouxiangguan painting studio where Yun Nantian once lived.

The outer garden is the former site of the Zhao Family Fangyu Hall, long and narrow north-south, with scenes such as the Yangui (Extending Osmanthus) Mountain Room, Mingyue (Bright Moon) Corridor, fish pond, and pavilions and terraces; the wing building and pavilion on the north side are the highest point in the garden.

Today the rockery in the garden has been moved to the southeast corner of People's Park and rebuilt.

建筑要点 / Key Features
人民公园前身是武进县商会会馆后花园建于1908年1913年对公众开放是常州首座公园时称公花园今园内有崇法寺大殿季子亭落星亭浩然亭和意园假山等市保建筑崇法寺相传最初为隋司徒陈国仁后圃宋宣和七年1125年赐名崇法禅院太平天国时期寺庙毁于战火光绪年间重建部分殿堂当时法会之盛几与天宁埒新中国成立后建设人民公园时拆除寺庙仅留大殿落星亭建于清宣统二年1910年用4根金山石柱支撑内砌石栏形式别致浩然亭建于明正德十五年1520年纪念宋末抗元死难的将士亭名取文天祥正气歌浩然者乃天地之正气之意此亭原在忠义祠后清乾隆年间移建于今址1984年重建意园位于后北岸4-8号原为康熙朝状元赵熊诏私园后来太平军英王陈玉成在此驻扎建筑毁于战火清光绪十二年1886年史干甫在此构园集蔡襄以意为之四字悬于门额因称意园园由粉墙隔为内外两区墙上开漏窗互通声气园内有花厅四季假山及恽南田曾寓居的瓯香馆画室外园为赵氏方玉堂旧址南北狭长有延桂山房明月廊鱼池亭榭等景北侧庑楼阁为园内最高处今园内假山被迁至人民公园东南角重建
06 前后北岸街区
Qianhou Beian Block
宋—清
级别 Level
历史文化街区，含藤花旧馆、吕宫府、管干贞故居、赵翼故居、文庙大成殿等省保单位
地址 Address
钟楼区延陵西路前后北岸
类型 Type
历史文化街区
中文原文

前后北岸前临顾塘河（今填平为延陵西路），后依白云溪（今填平为迎春步行街），曾为一座三面环水，东面接陆的半岛。在这片三角地块上，自宋代以来走出了5名状元（霍端友、杨廷鉴、吕宫、赵熊诏、庄培因）、3名榜眼（杨述曾、庄存与、洪亮吉）、3名探花（管绍宁、汤大绅、赵翼）及大量进士，文风之盛，举世罕见。

除了风水地利，前后北岸的东端靠近文庙，很多人曾在此读书求学；西端有苏轼寓居过的藤花旧馆，文人墨客常因"贪慕东坡住顾塘"，从而使这一带名人故居毗连。今自西向东有藤花旧馆、汤润之故居、东坡书院、吕宫宰相府、管干贞总督府、赵翼探花第、挥祖贻道台府、洪亮吉故居、恽南田瓯香馆、赵熊诏故居及读书楼"魁星阁"等。

1. 藤花旧馆：位于延陵西路前北岸79—81号，又名藤花旧馆，1982年列为省保单位。北宋时为孙氏馆，建中靖国元年（1101年）贬官流放在海南儋州的苏轼遇赦北归，路过常州时寓居在孙氏馆，并终老于此。

苏轼一生到过常州11次，馆内有苏轼手植紫藤及东坡洗砚池，明中期在遗址上重建为藤花旧馆，其中的三间楠木厅保存至今。清乾隆二十二年（1757年）乾隆第二次南巡时，洗砚池被官员移至万寿行宫（今东坡公园）。2. 吕宫府：位于延陵西路前北岸64号，2011年列为省保单位。

吕宫（1603—1664）原居马山埠，清顺治四年（1647年）考中状元，深受皇帝赏识，顺治十年（1653年）12月跃升为弘文院大学士（相当于宰相），官居一品。

他曾与大学士陈名夏等联名举荐御史郝浴巡授四川，顺治十一年（1654年）陈名夏倡言"留发复衣冠，天下即太平"被处绞刑，吕宫受到株连，降二级留用。吕宫目睹官场险恶，以体病为由多次求退，顺治保留了他的大学士头衔，以示希望随时起用。吕宫回到常州后没有住在祖居，而是隐居在前北岸的一处普通民房中，闭门不出，地方官员和过访友人一概不见，以致闲居十年而无人知晓。

这处故居南北共五进，东西两侧都有前后贯通的夹弄，两侧风火山墙高低起迭，颇具徽派建筑特征。3. 管干贞故居：位于延陵西路前北岸27—28号，1995年列为省保单位。管干贞（1734—1798）先祖管绍宁为晚明探花，明代灭亡后因拒绝剃发在狱中自尽。

管干贞中清乾隆三十一年（1766年）进士，官至漕运总督（从一品），其花鸟山水得恽南田真髓，为"常州画派"代表画家。管氏故居始建于明，原有八进，后三进毁于民国初年，门厅毁于"文革"，今存四进。

第一进为门屋，第二进为三间楠木厅，梁柱用料硕大，柱下垫阴沉木柱础，较为罕见。管氏五世同堂，乾隆御赐"福"字金匾，故此厅又称"锡福堂"。第三进为五间后厅，管绍宁曾在此居住；前围以隔墙，自成院落。第四进为五间楼厅，是管干贞读书作画之处，称"读雪山房"。

4. 文庙大成殿：文庙位于延陵西路2号工人文化宫内，原为武进、阳湖两县学宫，始建于宋咸淳元年（1265年），2011年列为省保单位。

现存大成殿重建于清同治六年（1867年），歇山顶，宽五间。殿前有三间硬山顶享堂，堂前有泮池、石桥等遗物。

· · · · ·
English

Qianhou Beian (Front and Rear North Bank) Block faces the Gutang River (today filled in as West Yanling Road) to the front and backs onto Baiyun Stream (today filled in as Yingchun Pedestrian Street), once a peninsula surrounded by water on three sides and connected to land on the east.

On this triangular plot, since the Song Dynasty, 5 zhuangyuan (top scholars: Huo Duanyou, Yang Tingjian, Lü Gong, Zhao Xiongzhao, Zhuang Peiyin), 3 bangyan (second-place scholars: Yang Shuzeng, Zhuang Cunyu, Hong Liangji), 3 tanhua (third-place scholars: Guan Shaoning, Tang Dashen, Zhao Yi), and numerous jinshi have emerged—the flourishing of literary culture is rare in the world.

Besides fengshui and geographical advantages, the east end of Qianhou Beian is near the Confucian Temple, where many people once studied; the west end has the Tenghua (Wisteria Flower) Old Hall where Su Shi once lived, and literati often "coveted Dongpo's residence at Gutang," making famous-person former residences adjacent in this area.

Today from west to east are the Tenghua Old Hall, Tang Runzhi Former Residence, Dongpo Academy, Lü Gong Prime Minister's Mansion, Guan Ganzhen Governor's Mansion, Zhao Yi Tanhua Mansion, Hui Zuyi Circuit Intendant's Mansion, Hong Liangji Former Residence, Yun Nantian's Ouxiangguan, Zhao Xiongzhao Former Residence, and the reading tower "Kuixing Pavilion" etc.

1.Tenghua Old Hall: Located at Nos.79-81 Qianbei'an, West Yanling Road, also called Tenghua Old Hall, designated a provincial protected unit in 1982.

In the Northern Song it was the Sun Family Hall; in the 1st year of Jianzhong Jingguo (1101), Su Shi, who had been demoted and exiled in Danzhou, Hainan, was pardoned and returned north, staying at the Sun Family Hall when passing through Changzhou, and ended his days here.

Su Shi visited Changzhou 11 times in his life; inside the hall are a wisteria planted by Su Shi himself and Dongpo's inkstone-washing pool; in the mid-Ming it was rebuilt on the site as the Tenghua Old Hall, of which three nanmu halls survive to this day.

In the 22nd year of Qianlong of the Qing (1757), during Qianlong's second southern tour, the inkstone-washing pool was moved by officials to the Wanshou Travel Palace (today's Dongpo Park).

2.Lü Gong Mansion: Located at No.64 Qianbei'an, West Yanling Road, designated a provincial protected unit in 2011.

Lü Gong (1603-1664) originally lived at Mashanbu; in the 4th year of Shunzhi of the Qing (1647) he passed the zhuangyuan examination, deeply appreciated by the emperor; in December of the 10th year of Shunzhi (1653) he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Hongwen Academy (equivalent to prime minister), holding the highest official rank.

He once jointly recommended Censor Hao Yu to tour and administer Sichuan with Grand Secretary Chen Mingxia etc.

; in the 11th year of Shunzhi (1654), Chen Mingxia advocated "keeping hair and restoring robes and hats, then the world will be at peace" and was sentenced to death by hanging; Lü Gong was implicated and demoted two ranks but retained in office.

Witnessing the dangers of officialdom, Lü Gong repeatedly requested retirement on grounds of illness; Shunzhi retained his Grand Secretary title to indicate hope of employing him at any time.

After returning to Changzhou, Lü Gong did not live in his ancestral home but secluded himself in an ordinary folk house at Qianbei'an, closing his door and not going out, seeing neither local officials nor visiting friends, so that he lived in retirement for ten years without anyone knowing.

This former residence has five rows north-south, with through alleys front and back on both east and west sides, and the fire-break gable walls on both sides rise and fall in height, quite characteristic of Huizhou-style architecture.

3.Guan Ganzhen Former Residence: Located at Nos.27-28 Qianbei'an, West Yanling Road, designated a provincial protected unit in 1995.

Guan Ganzhen's (1734-1798) ancestor Guan Shaoning was a late-Ming tanhua; after the Ming fell, he committed suicide in prison for refusing to shave his hair.

Guan Ganzhen passed the jinshi examination in the 31st year of Qianlong of the Qing (1766), rising to Governor of Grain Transport (second rank, first class); his flower-and-bird and landscape paintings obtained the true essence of Yun Nantian, making him a representative painter of the "Changzhou School of Painting.

" The Guan family residence was first built in the Ming, originally with eight rows; the last three rows were destroyed in the early Republic, and the gate hall was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution; today four rows survive.

The first row is the gate house; the second row is a three-bay nanmu hall, with large beams and columns, and the columns rest on sunken-wood column bases, relatively rare.

The Guan family had five generations living together, and Qianlong bestowed a gold plaque with the character "Fu" (Fortune), hence this hall is also called "Xifu (Bestowing Fortune) Hall.

" The third row is a five-bay rear hall, where Guan Shaoning once lived; enclosed by a partition wall in front, forming its own courtyard.

The fourth row is a five-bay tower hall, where Guan Ganzhen read and painted, called "Duxue (Reading Snow) Mountain Room." 4.

Confucian Temple Dacheng Hall: The Confucian Temple is located inside the Workers' Cultural Palace at No.

2 West Yanling Road, originally the school palace of Wujin and Yanghu counties, first built in the 1st year of Xianchun of the Song (1265), designated a provincial protected unit in 2011.

The existing Dacheng (Great Achievement) Hall was rebuilt in the 6th year of Tongzhi of the Qing (1867), with a hip-and-gable roof and five bays wide.

In front of the hall is a three-bay offering hall with a gable roof, and in front of the hall are relics such as the Pan Pond and stone bridge.

建筑要点 / Key Features
前后北岸前临顾塘河今填平为延陵西路后依白云溪今填平为迎春步行街曾为一座三面环水东面接陆的半岛在这片三角地块上自宋代以来走出了5名状元霍端友杨廷鉴吕宫赵熊诏庄培因3名榜眼杨述曾庄存与洪亮吉3名探花管绍宁汤大绅赵翼及大量进士文风之盛举世罕见除了风水地利前后北岸的东端靠近文庙很多人曾在此读书求学西端有苏轼寓居过的藤花旧馆文人墨客常因贪慕东坡住顾塘从而使这一带名人故居毗连今自西向东有藤花旧馆汤润之故居东坡书院吕宫宰相府管干贞总督府赵翼探花第挥祖贻道台府洪亮吉故居恽南田瓯香馆赵熊诏故居及读书楼魁星阁等藤花旧馆位于延陵西路前北岸79-81号又名藤花旧馆1982年列为省保单位北宋时为孙氏馆建中靖国元年1101年贬官流放在海南儋州的苏轼遇赦北归路过常州时寓居在孙氏馆并终老于此苏轼一生到过常州11次馆内有苏轼手植紫藤及东坡洗砚池明中期在遗址上重建为藤花旧馆其中的三间楠木厅保存至今清乾隆二十二年1757年乾隆第二次南巡时洗砚池被官员移至万寿行宫今东坡公园吕宫府位于延陵西路前北岸64号2011年列为省保单位吕宫1603-1664原居马山埠清顺治四年1647年考中状元深受皇帝赏识顺治十年1653年12月跃升为
07 约园
Yueyuan Garden
清
级别 Level
第二批常州市文物保护单位（1987年）
地址 Address
兴隆巷第二人民医院内
类型 Type
古典园林
门票 Ticket
免费参观
中文原文

约园原为明代官府养鹿之地，清乾隆初年成为谢旻的别业，后归赵翼之孙赵起（1794—1860），建造约园。赵起工诗文、善书画，造园构景颇得诗情画意。他将园林分为三区："东池春华"水面开阔，置有大量湖石；"西园秋实"是一座四周环水的小岛；在东池和西园之间堆叠黄石假山，题为"南山涌翠"。

园中罗置了大量奇石，赵起一一题名，有灵岩、绉碧、独秀、玉屏、朵云、舞袖等……共成"约园十二峰"；此外还有梅坞风情、海棠春榭、小亭玩月、城角风帆等24景。太平军攻破常州时，赵起一家39口投入约园池内自尽，园林也被付之一炬。清末由赵翼玄孙媳徐小娴主持修复，并请人绘制了一幅《约园图》，是古代女性参与园林建设的重要实例。

1953年约园划归第二人民医院，大部分得以保存。

· · · · ·
English

Yueyuan (Approximate Garden) was originally a deer-raising place for the Ming government; in the early Qianlong reign of the Qing it became the villa of Xie Min, later passed to Zhao Qi (1794-1860), grandson of Zhao Yi, who built Yueyuan.

Zhao Qi was skilled in poetry and prose and good at calligraphy and painting, and his garden construction and scene arrangement gained much poetic and pictorial charm.

He divided the garden into three zones: "East Pond Spring Splendor" with open water and numerous Taihu stones; "West Garden Autumn Fruits" is a small island surrounded by water on all sides; between the east pond and west garden, a yellow stone rockery is piled, titled "South Mountain Surging Green.

" The garden is furnished with numerous exotic stones, which Zhao Qi named one by one, including Lingyan, Zhoubi, Duxiu, Yuping, Duoyun, Wuxiu etc.

—altogether forming the "Twelve Peaks of Yueyuan"; in addition there are 24 scenes such as Plum坞 Style, Begonia Spring Pavilion, Small Pavilion Admiring the Moon, and City Corner Sailing Wind etc.

When the Taiping Army captured Changzhou, Zhao Qi's family of 39 threw themselves into the pond in Yueyuan and committed suicide, and the garden was also burned to ashes.

At the end of the Qing, restoration was directed by Xu Xiaoxian, great-granddaughter-in-law of Zhao Yi, who also had someone paint a "Painting of Yueyuan"—an important example of ancient women participating in garden construction.

In 1953 Yueyuan was transferred to the Second People's Hospital, with most of it preserved.

建筑要点 / Key Features
约园原为明代官府养鹿之地清乾隆初年成为谢旻的别业后归赵翼之孙赵起1794-1860建造约园赵起工诗文善书画造园构景颇得诗情画意他将园林分为三区东池春华水面开阔置有大量湖石西园秋实是一座四周环水的小岛在东池和西园之间堆叠黄石假山题为南山涌翠园中罗置了大量奇石赵起一一题名有灵岩绉碧独秀玉屏朵云舞袖等共成约园十二峰此外还有梅坞风情海棠春榭小亭玩月城角风帆等24景太平军攻破常州时赵起一家39口投入约园池内自尽园林也被付之一炬清末由赵翼玄孙媳徐小娴主持修复并请人绘制了一幅约园图是古代女性参与园林建设的重要实例1953年约园划归第二人民医院大部分得以保存
08 青果巷
Qingguo Lane
明—清
级别 Level
第三批江苏省文物保护单位（1982年）
地址 Address
常州老城区南市河（春秋运河段）北侧，东起和平路、西至南大街，长约400米
类型 Type
历史文化街区/古巷
中文原文

青果巷是常州城内最著名的老街巷，始建于16世纪，当时靠近运河，船舶云集，是南北果品的集散地，因此称作"千果巷"，后讹为青果巷。

巷中散布着大量名人故居，如瞿秋白诞生地、汤贻汾故居、赵元任故居、恽鸿仪故居等，其中规模最大的是唐氏八宅，位于青果巷82—96号，1982年列为省保单位。

唐氏为常州明清两代的望族，最著名的人物是唐顺之（1507—1560）。

唐顺之号荆川，是明代文学流派"唐宋派"的代表人物，与王慎中、归有光并称"嘉靖三大家"；他还精通军事，曾亲率兵船击败崇明岛上的倭寇，学者尊称其为"荆川先生"。

唐氏八宅建于明弘治至万历年间，原有筠星、易书、贞和、八桂、四并、复始、松健、礼和八堂，今存五堂。最具价值的是位于86号的贞和堂，原名保合堂，1633年唐荆川玄孙唐宇昭（1602—1672）改名贞和堂。

堂内大厅仍保持明代面貌，是常州现存最大的楠木厅，木构部分全用楠木、紫檀木精做，正间大梁有彩绘。堂东廊壁上嵌有4方《保合堂记》石刻，是1617年孙慎行为祝贺唐荆川之子唐鹤征的八十大寿所撰。

贞和堂后部有座半园，清初唐宇昭建，他自号半园居士，清康熙元年（1662年）秋曾邀请王石谷、恽南田在此雅集作画。

清乾隆年间园归钱维乔，作《半园之半记》（《清代毗陵人小传》），后传钱以振。新中国成立后园中太湖石移置人民公园，池塘被填为操场，1987年拆除明式花厅。

筠星堂位于92—94号，原属唐荆川玄孙、明崇祯年间举人唐宇量，今存部分明代建筑、清代回形转楼、花厅及山石池木等。八桂堂位于82—84号，民国期间售予刘国钧，现为刘国钧故居。

松健堂位于8弄3号和12弄8号，原属唐荆川曾祖、明书法家唐世英，后归浙江兵备道挥祖贻。现存房屋四进，其中厅屋建于明代，余为清代改建。

礼和堂位于141弄和163号，原属唐荆川曾叔祖，明画家唐世宁，内有砖雕门楼。

· · · · ·
English

Qingguo Lane is the most famous old street and lane in Changzhou city, first built in the 16th century; at that time it was near the canal, with boats gathering in crowds, serving as a distribution center for north-south fruits, hence called "Qianguo (Thousand Fruits) Lane," later corrupted to Qingguo Lane.

Scattered in the lane are numerous former residences of famous people, such as the birthplace of Qu Qiubai, former residence of Tang Yifen, former residence of Zhao Yuanren, former residence of Yun Hongyi etc.

; among them the largest in scale is the Tang Family Eight Residences, located at Nos.82-96 Qingguo Lane, designated a provincial protected unit in 1982.

The Tang family was a prominent clan in Changzhou during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and the most famous figure was Tang Shunzhi (1507-1560).

Tang Shunzhi, hao Jingchuan, was a representative figure of the "Tang-Song School" literary movement of the Ming, together with Wang Shenzhong and Gui Youguang called the "Three Great Masters of Jiajing"; he was also proficient in military affairs, once personally leading warships to defeat the Japanese pirates on Chongming Island, and scholars respectfully called him "Mr.

Jingchuan.

" The Tang Family Eight Residences were built from the Hongzhi to Wanli reigns of the Ming, originally with eight halls: Yunxing, Yishu, Zhenhe, Bagui, Sibing, Fushi, Songjian, and Lihe; today five halls survive.

The most valuable is the Zhenhe Hall at No.86, originally named Baohe Hall; in 1633 Tang Yuzhao (1602-1672), great-grandson of Tang Jingchuan, renamed it Zhenhe Hall.

The main hall inside still maintains its Ming appearance, the largest surviving nanmu hall in Changzhou; the wooden structure is all exquisitely made of nanmu and red sandalwood, with painted decorations on the main beam of the central bay.

On the wall of the east corridor of the hall are embedded 4 stone carvings of the "Record of Baohe Hall," written by Sun Shenxing in 1617 to congratulate Tang Hezheng, son of Tang Jingchuan, on his 80th birthday.

Behind the Zhenhe Hall is a Banyuan (Half Garden), built by Tang Yuzhao in the early Qing; he called himself the "Half Garden Scholar," and in the autumn of the 1st year of Kangxi of the Qing (1662) once invited Wang Shigu and Yun Nantian to gather and paint here.

During the Qianlong reign of the Qing the garden passed to Qian Weiqiao, who wrote the "Record of Half of the Half Garden" ("Biographies of Qing Piling People"), later passed to Qian Yizhen.

After the founding of New China, the Taihu stones in the garden were moved to People's Park, the pond was filled in as a playground, and the Ming-style flower hall was demolished in 1987.

The Yunxing Hall is located at Nos.

92-94, originally belonging to Tang Yuliang, great-grandson of Tang Jingchuan and a juren of the Chongzhen reign of the Ming; today part of the Ming buildings, Qing zigzag turning tower, flower hall, and rocks, ponds, and trees survive.

The Bagui Hall is located at Nos.82-84, sold to Liu Guojun during the Republic, now the Former Residence of Liu Guojun.The Songjian Hall is located at No.3, Lane 8 and No.

8, Lane 12, originally belonging to Tang Shiying, great-grandfather of Tang Jingchuan and a Ming calligrapher, later passed to Hui Zuyi, Circuit Intendant of Zhejiang.

The existing house has four rows, of which the hall was built in the Ming, and the rest were rebuilt in the Qing.The Lihe Hall is located at Lane 141 and No.

163, originally belonging to Tang Shining, great-granduncle of Tang Jingchuan and a Ming painter, with a brick-carved gate tower inside.

建筑要点 / Key Features
青果巷是常州城内最著名的老街巷始建于16世纪当时靠近运河船舶云集是南北果品的集散地因此称作千果巷后讹为青果巷巷中散布着大量名人故居如瞿秋白诞生地汤贻汾故居赵元任故居恽鸿仪故居等其中规模最大的是唐氏八宅位于青果巷82-96号1982年列为省保单位唐氏为常州明清两代的望族最著名的人物是唐顺之1507-1560唐顺之号荆川是明代文学流派唐宋派的代表人物与王慎中归有光并称嘉靖三大家他还精通军事曾亲率兵船击败崇明岛上的倭寇学者尊称其为荆川先生唐氏八宅建于明弘治至万历年间原有筠星易书贞和八桂四并复始松健礼和八堂今存五堂最具价值的是位于86号的贞和堂原名保合堂1633年唐荆川玄孙唐宇昭1602-1672改名贞和堂堂内大厅仍保持明代面貌是常州现存最大的楠木厅木构部分全用楠木紫檀木精做正间大梁有彩绘堂东廊壁上嵌有4方保合堂记石刻是1617年孙慎行为祝贺唐荆川之子唐鹤征的八十大寿所撰贞和堂后部有座半园清初唐宇昭建他自号半园居士清康熙元年1662年秋曾邀请王石谷恽南田在此雅集作画清乾隆年间园归钱维乔作半园之半记清代毗陵人小传后传钱以振新中国成立后园中太湖石移置人民公园池塘被填为操场1987年拆除明式花厅筠星
09 天宁寺
Tianning Temple
清
级别 Level
第三批江苏省文物保护单位（1982年）
地址 Address
天宁区延陵东路636号
类型 Type
佛教寺院
门票 Ticket
20元
开放时间 Hours
7:00 — 16:30
中文原文

唐永徽年间（650—655）金陵（今南京）牛头山幽栖寺高僧法融禅师到常州化斋，"筑室十余楹"，是为天宁寺的前身。唐天复年间（901—904）维元和尚在此"施舍利，卜寺址"，正式建造寺院，取名广福寺。

唐末更名齐云寺，尊称维元和尚为齐云长老。北宋熙宁三年（1070年）遵诏改齐云寺为"万寿崇宁寺"。

北宋政和元年（1111年）始称天宁寺，此后屡有改动，元至元年间（1335—1340）复称"常州天宁寺"，沿用至今。

明代徐问《重修常州天宁寺记》称誉其为"东南第一丛林"，《中国佛教·清代佛教》将其与镇江金山寺、扬州高旻寺、宁波天童寺并列为"禅宗四大丛林"。

太平天国时期寺庙毁于战火，清同治四年至光绪三十年（1865—1904）重建，2008年建成的13层天宁宝塔，是世界最高佛塔。1982年天宁寺被列为省保单位，1983年成为全国佛教重点寺院，现为国家4A级旅游景区。

寺庙主体建筑位于南北中轴线上，自南向北依次为山门、天王殿、大雄宝殿、御书楼、三宝殿和天宁宝塔。东路有文殊殿、罗汉殿和观音殿等，西路有普贤殿、罗汉殿、地藏殿、达摩阁、学戒堂和放生池等。

大雄宝殿为寺内主殿，采用重檐歇山顶，内部八根铁梨木柱直径80多厘米，是珍贵木料，梁、枋等构架雕工精美，左右两壁嵌有清代雕刻的518尊罗汉石像，造型生动，为艺术精品。

· · · · ·
English

During the Yonghui reign of the Tang (650-655), the eminent monk Chan Master Farong from Youqi Temple on Niutou Mountain in Jinling (today's Nanjing) came to Changzhou to collect alms, "building over ten rooms," which was the predecessor of Tianning Temple.

During the Tianfu reign of the Tang (901-904), Monk Weiyuan "donated profits and divined a temple site" here, formally building a temple, named Guangfu Temple.

At the end of the Tang it was renamed Qiyun Temple, and Monk Weiyuan was respectfully called Elder Qiyun.

In the 3rd year of Xining of the Northern Song (1070), by imperial edict Qiyun Temple was changed to "Wanshou Chongning Temple.

" In the 1st year of Zhenghe of the Northern Song (1111) it began to be called Tianning Temple; thereafter it changed several times, and during the Zhiyuan reign of the Yuan (1335-1340) it was again called "Changzhou Tianning Temple," used to this day.

Ming Xu Wen's "Record of Rebuilding Changzhou Tianning Temple" praised it as the "Number One Monastery in the Southeast"; "Chinese Buddhism·Qing Dynasty Buddhism" lists it together with Zhenjiang Jinshan Temple, Yangzhou Gaomin Temple, and Ningbo Tiantong Temple as the "Four Great Monasteries of the Chan Sect.

" During the Taiping Rebellion the temple was destroyed by war fires; rebuilt from the 4th year of Tongzhi to the 30th year of Guangxu of the Qing (1865-1904); the 13-story Tianning Pagoda completed in 2008 is the tallest Buddhist pagoda in the world.

In 1982 Tianning Temple was designated a provincial protected unit; in 1983 it became a key national Buddhist monastery; today it is a national 4A-level tourist scenic area.

The main buildings of the temple are located on the north-south central axis, from south to north successively the mountain gate, Heavenly King Hall, Mahavira Hall, Imperial Calligraphy Building, Three Treasures Hall, and Tianning Pagoda.

The east road has the Manjushri Hall, Arhat Hall, and Guanyin Hall etc.

; the west road has the Samantabhadra Hall, Arhat Hall, Ksitigarbha Hall, Bodhidharma Pavilion, Precept Study Hall, and Life Release Pond etc.

The Mahavira Hall is the main hall of the temple, adopting a double-eave hip-and-gable roof; inside, eight ironwood columns are over 80 cm in diameter, precious timber; the beams and lintels etc.

are exquisitely carved; the left and right walls are embedded with 518 Arhat stone statues carved in the Qing, with vivid shapes, artistic masterpieces.

建筑要点 / Key Features
唐永徽年间650-655金陵今南京牛头山幽栖寺高僧法融禅师到常州化斋筑室十余楹是为天宁寺的前身唐天复年间901-904维元和尚在此施舍利卜寺址正式建造寺院取名广福寺唐末更名齐云寺尊称维元和尚为齐云长老北宋熙宁三年1070年遵诏改齐云寺为万寿崇宁寺北宋政和元年1111年始称天宁寺此后屡有改动元至元年间1335-1340复称常州天宁寺沿用至明代徐问重修常州天宁寺记称誉其为东南第一丛林中国佛教清代佛教将其与镇江金山寺扬州高旻寺宁波天童寺并列为禅宗四大丛林太平天国时期寺庙毁于战火清同治四年至光绪三十年1865-1904重建2008年建成的13层天宁宝塔是世界最高佛塔1982年天宁寺被列为省保单位1983年成为全国佛教重点寺院现为国家4A级旅游景区寺庙主体建筑位于南北中轴线上自南向北依次为山门天王殿大雄宝殿御书楼三宝殿和天宁宝塔东路有文殊殿罗汉殿和观音殿等西路有普贤殿罗汉殿地藏殿达摩阁学戒堂和放生池等大雄宝殿为寺内主殿采用重檐歇山顶内部八根铁梨木柱直径80多厘米是珍贵木料梁枋等构架雕工精美左右两壁嵌有清代雕刻的518尊罗汉石像造型生动为艺术精品
10 红梅公园
Red Plum Park
清
级别 Level
含文笔塔、红梅阁等历史建筑
地址 Address
天宁区罗汉路1号
类型 Type
公园/历史建筑
中文原文

红梅公园位于天宁寺北部，始建于1958年，是市内最大的综合公园，免费参观。园内包括三区八景：南部为文物古迹区，有红梅春晓和文笔夕照两景；西北为娱乐活动区，有雪山劲松、翠微秋霞、林园钟声、曲池风荷和青峦倒影五景；东部为科普教育区，有吴风遗韵一景。园内较重要的古建筑遗存有文笔塔、红梅阁、半山亭、袈裟塔、冰梅石、嘉贤坊、塔影山房和文笔楼等。

1. 文笔塔：位于公园东南角南1入口处，建于南齐建元年间（480—482），原属太平讲寺，后来成为常州文化的象征，与科举联系起来，被称作文峰塔。今塔建于清光绪三十年（1904年），塔身为砖木结构，八角七层，内部有楼梯可盘旋登顶，眺览城内外景致。

塔底层的花岗岩须弥座上的浮雕莲瓣为宋代遗物。2. 红梅阁：位于公园东南角南2入口处，始建于唐昭宋年间，原属水田寺。

今为清光绪二十六年（1900年）重建，坐北朝南，下有二层台基，上为两层歇山顶楼阁，庭院中遍植红梅翠竹。一层是祀师堂，祀道教祖师葛洪和张天师等；二层是祀玉室，祀斗姥和文昌等。阁前冰梅石柱为元代天庆观牌坊石柱原物，较为珍贵。

· · · · ·
English

Red Plum Park is located north of Tianning Temple, first built in 1958, the largest comprehensive park in the city, with free admission.

The park includes three zones and eight scenes: the southern part is the cultural relics and historic sites zone, with two scenes: Red Plum Spring Dawn and Wenbi Sunset Glow; the northwest is the entertainment and activity zone, with five scenes: Snow Mountain Strong Pine, Cuiwei Autumn Sunset, Forest Garden Bell Sound, Winding Pond Wind Lotus, and Green Peak Reflection; the eastern part is the science education zone, with one scene: Wu Style Remaining Charm.

The more important ancient architectural remains in the park include the Wenbi (Writing Brush) Pagoda, Red Plum Pavilion, Banshan (Half Mountain) Pavilion, Kasaya Pagoda, Ice Plum Stone, Jiaxian (Worthy Commendation) Archway, Taying (Pagoda Shadow) Mountain Room, and Wenbi Building etc.

1.

Wenbi Pagoda: Located at the South 1 entrance in the southeast corner of the park, built during the Jianyuan reign of the Southern Qi (480-482), originally belonging to Taiping Lecture Temple; later it became a symbol of Changzhou culture, linked with the imperial examinations, and was called the Wenfeng (Cultural Prosperity) Pagoda.

Today's pagoda was built in the 30th year of Guangxu of the Qing (1904), with a brick-wood structure, octagonal and seven stories, with a staircase inside allowing spiraling to the top to overlook the scenery inside and outside the city.

The relief lotus petals on the granite Sumeru base at the bottom of the pagoda are Song Dynasty relics.2.

Red Plum Pavilion: Located at the South 2 entrance in the southeast corner of the park, first built during the Zhaosong reign of the Tang, originally belonging to Shuitian Temple.

Today it was rebuilt in the 26th year of Guangxu of the Qing (1900), facing south with its back to north, with a two-story platform base below and a two-story hip-and-gable roof pavilion above; the courtyard is planted with red plums and green bamboo everywhere.

The first floor is the Master Worship Hall, enshrining Daoist patriarchs Ge Hong and Celestial Master Zhang etc.; the second floor is the Jade Worship Room, enshrining Doumu and Wenchang etc.

The Ice Plum stone columns in front of the pavilion are original objects from the Tianqing Temple archway of the Yuan Dynasty, relatively precious.

建筑要点 / Key Features
红梅公园位于天宁寺北部始建于1958年是市内最大的综合公园免费参观园内包括三区八景南部为文物古迹区有红梅春晓和文笔夕照两景西北为娱乐活动区有雪山劲松翠微秋霞林园钟声曲池风荷和青峦倒影五景东部为科普教育区有吴风遗韵一景园内较重要的古建筑遗存有文笔塔红梅阁半山亭袈裟塔冰梅石嘉贤坊塔影山房和文笔楼等文笔塔位于公园东南角南1入口处建于南齐建元年间480-482原属太平讲寺后来成为常州文化的象征与科举联系起来被称作文峰塔今塔建于清光绪三十年1904年塔身为砖木结构八角七层内部有楼梯可盘旋登顶眺览城内外景致塔底层的花岗岩须弥座上的浮雕莲瓣为宋代遗物红梅阁位于公园东南角南2入口处始建于唐昭宋年间原属水田寺今为清光绪二十六年1900年重建坐北朝南下有二层台基上为两层歇山顶楼阁庭院中遍植红梅翠竹一层是祀师堂祀道教祖师葛洪和张天师等二层是祀玉室祀斗姥和文昌等阁前冰梅石柱为元代天庆观牌坊石柱原物较为珍贵
11 太平兴国石经幢
Taiping Xingguo Stone Sutra Pillar
北宋
级别 Level
第四批江苏省文物保护单位（1995年）
地址 Address
天宁区延陵东路太平桥北
类型 Type
石经幢
中文原文

经幢为北宋太平兴国四年（979年）太平禅寺遗物，原有一对，立于禅寺山门前。

今其一保存尚好，幢高5.42米，宽2.2米，由基石、浮雕八力神、宝相花、八佛像、仰莲等须弥座及八棱形幢身、缠枝牡丹花宝盖、浮雕斗栱、宝顶八部分叠成，雕刻古朴浑厚，体现了宋代的石刻风格。

基座为八角莲瓣型，高1.5米，周身遍刻陀罗尼经，字迹已漫漶不清。另一座仅存三层须弥座残件。

· · · · ·
English

The dharani pillar is a relic of the Taiping Chan Temple from the 4th year of Taiping Xingguo of the Northern Song (979); originally there was a pair, standing in front of the temple's mountain gate.

Today one is well preserved, 5.42 meters high and 2.

2 meters wide, composed of eight parts stacked together: the base stone, relief eight strength deities, precious phase flowers, eight Buddha statues, upward-lotus Sumeru base, octagonal pillar body, interlocking peony flower canopy, relief bracket sets, and precious top.

The carvings are simple and vigorous, reflecting the stone carving style of the Song Dynasty.The base is an octagonal lotus-petal shape, 1.

5 meters high, covered with the Dharani Sutra carved all around, with the characters already blurred and illegible.The other one only retains the remnants of a three-layer Sumeru base.

建筑要点 / Key Features
经幢为北宋太平兴国四年979年太平禅寺遗物原有一对立于禅寺山门前今其一保存尚好幢高5.42米宽2.2米由基石浮雕八力神宝相花八佛像仰莲等须弥座及八棱形幢身缠枝牡丹花宝盖浮雕斗栱宝顶八部分叠成雕刻古朴浑厚体现了宋代的石刻风格基座为八角莲瓣型高1.5米周身遍刻陀罗尼经字迹已漫漶不清另一座仅存三层须弥座残件
12 东坡公园
Dongpo Park
宋—清
级别 Level
含东坡古渡、舣舟亭、东坡洗砚池、万寿行宫等古迹
地址 Address
延陵中路9号
类型 Type
公园/历史古迹
开放时间 Hours
5:00 — 21:00
中文原文

东坡公园包括三面环水的半岛和运河中的半月岛两部分，据传北宋文学家苏轼一生曾11次造访常州，乘船在此停泊，现辟为公园以作纪念。园内有东坡古渡、舣舟亭、东坡洗砚池和万寿行宫等古迹。公园西侧由飞虹桥通往西岸的海潮寺。今公园内的东坡古渡是当年苏东坡舍舟登岸处，清代乾隆南巡也是在此上岸。

古渡向东经广济桥通向半月岛，此桥建于明正德十二年（1571年），原在城西，后来拓宽城西运河时整体迁移至此。古渡西南山顶最高处为舣舟亭。

北宋熙宁六年（1073年）苏东坡路过常州时曾在此野宿，作《除夕夜宿常州城外》曰："重衾脚冷知霜重，新沐头轻感发稀。多谢残灯不嫌客，孤舟一夜许相依。"后来人们在此建亭纪念。乾隆第二次南巡到常州时，重修此亭，并御题"玉局风流"匾额。今亭为1984年重建。

舣舟亭北部山下的水池和假山一带汇集了众多古迹。池东假山后面藏有东坡洗砚池，1757年由藤花旧馆移到此处。洗砚池用白石凿成，长1米，宽半米，底部有小孔，"去其楔（塞子），水立涸。以新水盖之，容十五六石许，积水盛夏不败"。

水池南岸有御碑亭，内置六块乾隆在常州题写的诗碑。水池西岸为龙亭，乾隆曾在此召见当地文士。亭东是康熙、乾隆南巡时驻扎的万寿行宫，今仅存遗址。

· · · · ·
English

Dongpo (Su Dongpo) Park consists of two parts: a peninsula surrounded by water on three sides and the Half-Moon Island in the canal.

According to tradition, Su Shi, a writer of the Northern Song, visited Changzhou 11 times in his life, anchoring his boat here; today it has been opened as a park in commemoration.

Inside the park are historic sites such as the Dongpo Ancient Ferry, Yizhou (Tying Boat) Pavilion, Dongpo Inkstone-Washing Pool, and Wanshou (Longevity) Travel Palace.

The west side of the park connects to the Haichao Temple on the west bank via the Feihong (Flying Rainbow) Bridge.

The Dongpo Ancient Ferry in today's park is where Su Dongpo disembarked from his boat in those years; during the Qing, Qianlong's southern tour also came ashore here.

East of the ancient ferry, via the Guangji Bridge, leads to the Half-Moon Island; this bridge was built in the 12th year of Zhengde of the Ming (1571), originally west of the city, and was later moved here as a whole when widening the west city canal.

At the highest point of the mountain southwest of the ancient ferry is the Yizhou Pavilion.

In the 6th year of Xining of the Northern Song (1073), when Su Dongpo passed through Changzhou, he once slept in the open here, writing "Staying Outside Changzhou City on New Year's Eve": "Under heavy quilts my feet are cold, knowing the frost is heavy; after newly washing my hair, my head feels light, sensing my hair thinning.

Thank you to the remaining lamp for not disliking the guest, allowing the lonely boat to depend on it all night." Later people built a pavilion here in commemoration.

When Qianlong made his second southern tour to Changzhou, he rebuilt this pavilion and personally inscribed the plaque "Yuju Fengliu" (Elegant Style of the Jade Bureau).

Today's pavilion was rebuilt in 1984.The area around the pond and rockery at the foot of the mountain north of the Yizhou Pavilion gathers numerous historic sites.

Behind the rockery east of the pond hides the Dongpo Inkstone-Washing Pool, moved here from the Tenghua Old Hall in 1757.

The inkstone-washing pool is carved from white stone, 1 meter long and half a meter wide, with a small hole at the bottom; "removing its wedge (plug), the water dries up immediately.

Filling it with fresh water, it holds about fifteen or six shi of water, and the stored water does not spoil even in midsummer.

" On the south bank of the pond is the Imperial Stele Pavilion, containing six steles with poems inscribed by Qianlong in Changzhou.

On the west bank of the pond is the Dragon Pavilion, where Qianlong once summoned local literati.

East of the pavilion is the Wanshou Travel Palace where Kangxi and Qianlong stayed during their southern tours, today only ruins remain.

建筑要点 / Key Features
东坡公园包括三面环水的半岛和运河中的半月岛两部分据传北宋文学家苏轼一生曾11次造访常州乘船在此停泊现辟为公园以作纪念园内有东坡古渡舣舟亭东坡洗砚池和万寿行宫等古迹公园西侧由飞虹桥通往西岸的海潮寺今公园内的东坡古渡是当年苏东坡舍舟登岸处清代乾隆南巡也是在此上岸古渡向东经广济桥通向半月岛此桥建于明正德十二年1571年原在城西后来拓宽城西运河时整体迁移至此古渡西南山顶最高处为舣舟亭北宋熙宁六年1073年苏东坡路过常州时曾在此野宿作除夕夜宿常州城外曰重衾脚冷知霜重新沐头轻感发稀多谢残灯不嫌客孤舟一夜许相依后来人们在此建亭纪念乾隆第二次南巡到常州时重修此亭并御题玉局风流匾额今亭为1984年重建舣舟亭北部山下的水池和假山一带汇集了众多古迹池东假山后面藏有东坡洗砚池1757年由藤花旧馆移到此处洗砚池用白石凿成长1米宽半米底部有小孔去其楔塞子水立涸以新水盖之容十五六石许积水盛夏不败水池南岸有御碑亭内置六块乾隆在常州题写的诗碑水池西岸为龙亭乾隆曾在此召见当地文士亭东是康熙乾隆南巡时驻扎的万寿行宫今仅存遗址
13 张太雷旧居
Former Residence of Zhang Tailei
1918—1925
级别 Level
第六批全国重点文物保护单位（2006年）
地址 Address
天宁区和平中路子和里3号
类型 Type
名人旧居
中文原文

张太雷（1898—1927）是中国共产党早期领导人之一，广州起义的主要领导者。1918年他与陆静华在常州结婚，在此租住了七年时间。这处故居建于民国初年，仅有两进三间平屋，体现了早期革命家生活的简朴。1987年修复后对外开放，包括张太雷故居陈列和生平事迹展览两部分。

· · · · ·
English

Zhang Tailei (1898-1927) was one of the early leaders of the Communist Party of China and the main leader of the Guangzhou Uprising.

In 1918 he married Lu Jinghua in Changzhou and rented here for seven years.

This former residence was built in the early Republic of China, with only two rows and three bays of single-story houses, reflecting the simplicity of life of early revolutionaries.

After restoration in 1987, it opened to the public, including two parts: the exhibition of Zhang Tailei's former residence and the exhibition of his life and deeds.

建筑要点 / Key Features
张太雷1898-1927是中国共产党早期领导人之一广州起义的主要领导者1918年他与陆静华在常州结婚在此租住了七年时间这处故居建于民国初年仅有两进三间平屋体现了早期革命家生活的简朴1987年修复后对外开放包括张太雷故居陈列和生平事迹展览两部分
14 清凉寺
Qingliang Temple
清
级别 Level
第三批江苏省文物保护单位（1982年）
地址 Address
天宁区和平中路488号
类型 Type
佛教寺院
中文原文

北宋治平元年（1064年）常州大儒胡宿（996—1067）请额建造，原在常州城东南3里处，称报恩感慈禅院。

南宋淳祐八年（1248年）常州郡守李迪在寺内建胡文恭公祠祭祀胡宿。

元末寺、祠俱毁，明永乐元年（1403年）移建今址，始称清凉寺，后又改为端明寺（胡宿曾任端明殿学士）。

太平天国时期寺庙被毁，清末重建，复称清凉寺。今存天王殿、海镜堂、藏经楼、法堂、禅堂和大悲阁等建筑。其中禅堂和藏经楼最具特色。禅堂是一座"回"字形转楼，形制独特。

藏经楼三层七开间，藏有明代宗所赐大藏经和慈禧太后所赐大藏经（龙藏）。

· · · · ·
English

In the 1st year of Zhiping of the Northern Song (1064), Hu Su (996-1067), a great Confucian scholar of Changzhou, requested a plaque to build it, originally located 3 li southeast of Changzhou city, called the Bao'en Ganci Chan Courtyard.

In the 8th year of Chunyou of the Southern Song (1248), Li Di, Prefect of Changzhou, built the Hu Wengong Shrine inside the temple to sacrifice to Hu Su.

At the end of the Yuan, both the temple and shrine were destroyed; in the 1st year of Yongle of the Ming (1403), it was moved to today's site, beginning to be called Qingliang (Cool and Refreshing) Temple, later changed to Duanming Temple (Hu Su once served as a scholar of the Duanming Hall).

During the Taiping Rebellion the temple was destroyed; rebuilt at the end of the Qing, again called Qingliang Temple.

Today surviving buildings include the Heavenly King Hall, Haijing (Sea Mirror) Hall, Scripture Library, Dharma Hall, Chan Hall, and Great Compassion Pavilion etc.

Among them, the Chan Hall and Scripture Library are the most distinctive.The Chan Hall is a "回" (return)-shaped revolving tower, unique in form.

The Scripture Library is three stories and seven bays wide, containing the Great Canon bestowed by the Jingtai Emperor of the Ming and the Great Canon (Dragon Canon) bestowed by Empress Dowager Cixi.

建筑要点 / Key Features
北宋治平元年1064年常州大儒胡宿996-1067请额建造原在常州城东南3里处称报恩感慈禅院南宋淳祐八年1248年常州郡守李迪在寺内建胡文恭公祠祭祀胡宿元末寺祠俱毁明永乐元年1403年移建今址始称清凉寺后又改为端明寺胡宿曾任端明殿学士太平天国时期寺庙被毁清末重建复称清凉寺今存天王殿海镜堂藏经楼法堂禅堂和大悲阁等建筑其中禅堂和藏经楼最具特色禅堂是一座回字形转楼形制独特藏经楼三层七开间藏有明代宗所赐大藏经和慈禧太后所赐大藏经龙藏
15 荆川公园
Jingchuan Park
明—清
级别 Level
含陈渡草堂、唐荆川墓、唐氏宗祠（原在青果巷，2002年移建至此）
地址 Address
清潭西路与长江中路交汇处
类型 Type
公园/历史建筑
门票 Ticket
免费开放
中文原文

荆川公园是为纪念明嘉靖年间抗倭英雄和文学家唐荆川而建。公园东南北三面环水，环境清幽，内有陈渡草堂、唐荆川墓和唐氏宗祠（原在青果巷，2002年移建至此）各景，使人们缅怀这位先贤。

1. 陈渡草堂：明嘉靖八年（1529年）唐荆川中会试第一，主考官为文渊阁大学士张璁。在嘉靖初年的"大礼仪之争"中，张璁因支持嘉靖皇帝而获得迅速提升，但也因此站到众多朝臣的对立面。张璁有意提拔唐荆川，但后者虽是后生晚辈却并不领情，按部就班地到兵部任职。

明嘉靖十二年（1533年）唐荆川入翰林院参与编校《实录》，仍然不肯依附张璁，工作完成后托病辞官。

张璁开始不想批复，后来有人向他点破唐荆川一直刻意与他保持距离，"璁发怒，拟以吏部主事署罢归，永不复叙"（《明史·卷215·唐顺之传》）。唐荆川回到常州，在城外西南营建陈渡草堂，潜心读书。

其子唐鹤征《常州府志·人物志》记载他"自编氓归，贫不能给朝夕，幸存其初第时有司例给牌坊银，稍为筹划，购田一顷、民居数椽于陈渡桥之，名曰陈渡草堂，湫溢不蔽风雨，公居之裕如也"，唐荆川与门生在草堂中读书，"历以实行，不为虚谈，二十余年如一日"，直到明嘉靖三十二年（1553年）复出，与胡宗宪协同作战，令倭寇闻风丧胆。

今陈渡草堂据清人谢应芝《襄文读书处记》复建，有懒云阁、五言楼、春池馆和压溪榭等景致。2. 唐荆川墓：出陈渡草堂南门，向东为唐荆川墓，1982年列为省保单位。

明嘉靖三十九年（1560年）唐荆川在行军途中病逝，他官居四品，皇帝特诏按三品赐葬，明崇祯年间追谥襄文。整座墓园坐东朝西，西侧为一泻桥，向东是一座木质飞檐石牌坊，两侧排列石羊、石兽、石马和石翁仲。

东部有三座大土坟鼎足而立，中央是荆川夫妇合葬墓，两旁是他的玄孙唐宇亮和唐宇昭之墓。

· · · · ·
English

Jingchuan Park was built to commemorate Tang Jingchuan, the anti-Japanese pirate hero and writer of the Jiajing reign of the Ming.

The park is surrounded by water on the east, south, and north sides, with a serene environment; inside are scenes such as the Chendu Thatched Hall, Tang Jingchuan Tomb, and Tang Family Ancestral Shrine (originally at Qingguo Lane, moved here in 2002), allowing people to remember this worthy predecessor.

1.

Chendu Thatched Hall: In the 8th year of Jiajing of the Ming (1529), Tang Jingchuan ranked first in the metropolitan examination, with the chief examiner being Zhang Cong, Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion.

In the "Great Rites Controversy" of the early Jiajing reign, Zhang Cong gained rapid promotion for supporting Emperor Jiajing, but thus stood opposite many court officials.

Zhang Cong intended to promote Tang Jingchuan, but the latter, though a junior, did not appreciate it and methodically took up a post at the Ministry of War.

In the 12th year of Jiajing (1533), Tang Jingchuan entered the Hanlin Academy to participate in editing and collating the "Veritable Records," still refusing to attach himself to Zhang Cong, and after completing the work resigned on grounds of illness.

Zhang Cong initially did not want to approve, but later someone pointed out to him that Tang Jingchuan had deliberately kept his distance; "Zhang Cong became angry, planning to dismiss him as acting director of the Ministry of Personnel, never to be reappointed" ("History of Ming·Volume 215·Biography of Tang Shunzhi").

Tang Jingchuan returned to Changzhou and built the Chendu Thatched Hall southwest of the city, devoting himself to reading.

His son Tang Hezheng's "Changzhou Prefecture Gazetteer·Biographies" records that he "returned as a commoner, too poor to provide for morning and evening; fortunately, when he first passed the examination, the authorities had customarily given him archway silver, which he slightly managed to purchase a qing of farmland and several rafters of a dwelling at Chendu Bridge, named Chendu Thatched Hall; low and damp, not sheltering from wind and rain, yet he lived there comfortably.

" Tang Jingchuan and his disciples read in the thatched hall, "practicing with real action, not empty talk, for over twenty years as one day," until the 32nd year of Jiajing (1553) when he returned to office, fighting in coordination with Hu Zongxian, making the Japanese pirates flee at the news.

Today's Chendu Thatched Hall was rebuilt according to Qing person Xie Yingzhi's "Record of the Place Where Xiangwen Read," with scenes such as the Lanyun (Lazy Cloud) Pavilion, Wuyan (Five-Character) Tower, Chunchi (Spring Pond) Hall, and Yaxi (Pressing Stream) Terrace.

2.Tang Jingchuan Tomb: Exiting the south gate of Chendu Thatched Hall, eastward is the Tang Jingchuan Tomb, designated a provincial protected unit in 1982.

In the 39th year of Jiajing of the Ming (1560), Tang Jingchuan died of illness during a military march; he held the fourth rank, and the emperor specially ordered burial according to the third rank; during the Chongzhen reign of the Ming he was posthumously titled Xiangwen.

The entire tomb garden faces west with its back to east; on the west side is the Yixie (One Gush) Bridge, eastward is a wooden upturned-eave stone archway, with stone sheep, stone beasts, stone horses, and stone guardian figures lined on both sides.

In the east are three large earthen tombs standing like a tripod; in the center is the joint tomb of Jingchuan and his wife, and on both sides are the tombs of his great-grandsons Tang Yuliang and Tang Yuzhao.

建筑要点 / Key Features
荆川公园是为纪念明嘉靖年间抗倭英雄和文学家唐荆川而建公园东南北三面环水环境清幽内有陈渡草堂唐荆川墓和唐氏宗祠原在青果巷2002年移建至此各景使人们缅怀这位先贤陈渡草堂明嘉靖八年1529年唐荆川中会试第一主考官为文渊阁大学士张璁在嘉靖初年的大礼仪之争中张璁因支持嘉靖皇帝而获得迅速提升但也因此站到众多朝臣的对立面张璁有意提拔唐荆川但后者虽是后生晚辈却并不领情按部就班地到兵部任职明嘉靖十二年1533年唐荆川入翰林院参与编校实录仍然不肯依附张璁工作完成后托病辞官张璁开始不想批复后来有人向他点破唐荆川一直刻意与他保持距离璁发怒拟以吏部主事署罢归永不复叙明史卷215唐顺之传唐荆川回到常州在城外西南营建陈渡草堂潜心读书其子唐鹤征常州府志人物志记载他自编氓归贫不能给朝夕幸存其初第时有司例给牌坊银稍为筹划购田一顷民居数椽于陈渡桥之名曰陈渡草堂湫溢不蔽风雨公居之裕如也唐荆川与门生在草堂中读书历以实行不为虚谈二十余年如一日直到明嘉靖三十二年1553年复出与胡宗宪协同作战令倭寇闻风丧胆今陈渡草堂据清人谢应芝襄文读书书记处记有懒云阁五言楼春池馆和压溪榭等景致唐荆川墓出陈渡草堂南门向东为唐荆川墓1982年列为省保
16 常州古戏楼群
Ancient Theatrical Towers in Changzhou
清
级别 Level
常州地区现有6座古代戏楼，第六批全国重点文物保护单位（2006年）
地址 Address
分布于钟楼区、新北区、武进区、溧阳市
类型 Type
戏楼/古建筑群
中文原文

常州地区现有6座古代戏楼，2006年第六批列为国保单位。1. 杨氏家庭戏楼：位于钟楼区东下塘75号，紧邻青果巷。此戏楼建于清同治、光绪年间，又称杨氏雕花楼。有上下两层，一层存放乐器等，二层为舞台。除东面外三面临空，周置20扇长窗，雕刻虫鱼花鸟，工艺精细。

平时长窗关闭，自成一室；演戏时将窗撤下，露出舞台。楼前建有花园和假山。2. 阳湖县城隍庙戏楼：位于和平南路与青果巷交汇处的新坊桥小学内。

城隍庙建于清乾隆二十四年（1759年），戏台建于清同治九年（1870年），1896年重修。

戏台坐南朝北，两层歇山顶，平面呈"凸"字形，台口正对城隍庙大殿（1988年拆除）。戏台与大殿之间，两侧原有上下各9间看戏楼。

戏台东墙上嵌清光绪二十二年（1896年）所刻《阳湖县增修城隍庙记》，称："戏楼特高，春秋致祭，作乐以娱神。复取古今忠孝节义故事俾梨园子弟演之。"3. 万绥东岳庙戏楼：位于新北区孟河镇万绥东岳庙内。

东岳庙始建于唐贞观年间，清道光年间重修。戏楼附属于东岳庙，建于道光年间，坐东朝西，台口正对东岳庙大殿。戏楼平面呈"凸"字形，正台屋檐外伸，高出屋面，做成八角屋顶，内架藻井。后台宽三间，两侧设化妆间，左侧还有供乐队演奏的架子台。

台板壁上记载了清末民初来此演出的戏班、戏目和主角姓名等，具有较高的史料价值。4. 西夏墅梅村戏楼：位于新北区西夏墅镇梅林村，附属于真武庙（庙已不存）。戏楼始建于明代，1688年重建，1863年、2004年两次重修。

戏楼坐南朝北，二层歇山顶，上下各三间，平面呈"凸"字形。5. 礼嘉戏楼：位于武进区礼嘉中学内。此戏台台口向北，正对烈帝庙大殿。太平天国时期戏楼毁于战火，光绪年间重建。上下两层各三间，平面呈"凸"字形，两旁有台柱，向上支撑着拱顶飞檐，下部镇着楼板台角。建筑风格颇似香山帮建造的苏州楼台。

戏楼前有开阔的广场，可容2000多名观众。6. 顺庄戏楼：位于武进区横林镇顺庄村张家自然村西首，附属于东岳庙。戏楼建于清代，坐南朝北，二层歇山顶，平面呈"凸"字形，前台三间较窄，后台三间较宽。

· · · · ·
English

There are currently 6 ancient theatrical towers in the Changzhou area, designated national protected units in the 6th batch of 2006.1.Yang Family Theatrical Tower: Located at No.

75 Dongxiatang, Zhonglou District, adjacent to Qingguo Lane.

This theatrical tower was built during the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns of the Qing, also called the Yang Family Carved Tower.

It has two stories: the first floor stores musical instruments etc., and the second floor is the stage.

Except for the east side, it is open on three sides, with 20 long windows around, carved with insects, fish, flowers, and birds, with exquisite craftsmanship.

Normally the long windows are closed, forming a room by itself; during performances the windows are removed, exposing the stage.In front of the tower are a garden and rockery.2.

Yanghu County City God Temple Theatrical Tower: Located in Xinfangqiao Primary School at the intersection of South Heping Road and Qingguo Lane.

The City God Temple was built in the 24th year of Qianlong of the Qing (1759), the stage was built in the 9th year of Tongzhi of the Qing (1870), and rebuilt in 1896.
