中文原文

大境路古城墙是上海市内仅存的城墙遗迹。

上海在元代设县后一直未筑城墙，明代倭寇猖獗，于明嘉靖三十二年（1553年）九月倭寇退去时赶筑城墙，十一月筑成。

当时城墙为泥土版筑，周围九里，高二丈四尺，共有六座城门，一座水门，外有宽六丈、深一丈七尺的城壕。此后多次修筑，增建箭台、高台、层楼、水关和穿廊等，但城门与城墙范围一直未变。明万历年间平定倭患，先后在箭台上建丹凤楼、观音阁、真武庙和大境阁。

大境阁原为城墙北隅箭台上的关帝殿，清嘉庆十年（1815年）改建为三层高阁，清道光十六年（1836年）两江总督陈銮在东首石坊上题大千圣境四字，遂称为大境阁，后成为沪城八景之一江皋霁雪。

近代文人墨客常在阁上聚会，二楼曾开设墨海书馆和平声曲社。1912年拆除城墙，城壕下设筒瓦，作为阴沟，上筑马路，六月拆除完毕，仅留作为拆城指挥部的大境阁一段。1992年修复大境阁，1995年重新开放。

· · · · ·
English

The ancient city wall on Dajing Road is the only remaining city wall relic in Shanghai city.

After Shanghai was established as a county in the Yuan Dynasty, no city wall was built for a long time; during the Ming Dynasty, Japanese pirates were rampant, and in September of the 32nd year of Jiajing of the Ming (1553), when the Japanese pirates retreated, the city wall was hastily built, completed in November.

At that time the city wall was rammed earth, with a circumference of nine li and a height of two zhang and four chi, with a total of six city gates and one water gate, and outside there was a city moat six zhang wide and one zhang seven chi deep.

Thereafter it was repeatedly repaired, with arrow platforms, high platforms, multi-story towers, water passes, and corridors added, but the scope of the city gates and walls remained unchanged.

During the Wanli reign of the Ming, after pacifying the Japanese pirates, the Danfeng (Red Phoenix) Tower, Guanyin Pavilion, Zhenwu (True Warrior) Temple, and Dajing Pavilion were successively built on the arrow platforms.

Dajing Pavilion was originally the Guandi (Lord Guan) Hall on the arrow platform at the north corner of the city wall; in the 10th year of Jiaqing of the Qing (1815) it was converted into a three-story high pavilion, and in the 16th year of Daoguang (1836) Chen Luan, Viceroy of Liangjiang, inscribed the four characters 'Daqian Shengjing' (Great Thousand Holy Realm) on the stone paifang at the east end, hence it was called Dajing Pavilion, later becoming one of the Eight Scenes of Shanghai City: 'Jianggao Jixue' (Snow Clearing on the River Bank).

In modern times, literati and scholars often gathered on the pavilion; the second floor once housed the Mohai Library and the Pingsheng Music Society.

In 1912 the city wall was demolished, with cylindrical tiles laid under the city moat as a sewer and a road built on top; demolition was completed in June, leaving only the section of Dajing Pavilion that served as the demolition command center.

Dajing Pavilion was restored in 1992 and reopened in 1995.

建筑要点 / Key Features
大境路古城墙是上海市内仅存的城墙遗迹上海在元代设县后一直未筑城墙明代倭寇猖獗于明嘉靖三十二年1553年九月倭寇退去时赶筑城墙十一月筑成当时城墙为泥土版筑周围九里高二丈四尺共有六座城门一座水门外有宽六丈深一丈七尺的城壕此后多次修筑增建箭台高台风楼水关和穿廊等但城门与城墙范围一直未变明万历年间平定倭患先后在箭台上建丹凤楼观音阁真武庙和大境阁大境阁原为城墙北隅箭台上的关帝殿清嘉庆十年1815年改建为三层高阁清道光十六年1836年两江总督陈銮在东首石坊上题大千圣境四字遂称为大境阁后成为沪城八景之一江皋霁雪近代文人墨客常在阁上聚会二楼曾开设墨海书馆和平声曲社1912年拆除城墙城壕下设筒瓦作为阴沟上筑马路六月拆除完毕仅留作为拆城指挥部的大境阁一段1992年修复大境阁1995年重新开放
07 三山会馆
Sanshan Guild Hall
1909年
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1959年）
地址 Address
黄浦区中山南路1551号
类型 Type
古建筑/会馆
中文原文

三山会馆是上海福建水果商人兴建的集会与供奉天后之地，又名天后宫。三山是指福州城内于山、冶山、乌石山三座山，常作为福州的代称。清末上海的三山会馆有两处，一在福州路云南路口，一在南市半淞园路。

半淞园路的三山会馆原址在里仓桥，为示区别，称沪南三山会馆。清宣统元年（1909年）移至今址重建。

三山会馆是传统的闽南建筑，坐北朝南，门楼上镌刻三山会馆四字，上有装饰精丽的天后宫竖匾，左右有石刻浮雕。

入门为主要院落，北向为戏台，歇山顶，雕刻丰富，有金碧辉煌的巨大藻井，四周雕刻上海城墙模型，精美绝伦。正对戏台为三开间大殿，两侧有两层观戏楼，主体院落前后均有天井。

1927年3月21日，上海工人以此为指挥部，举行了第三次武装起义。

· · · · ·
English

Sanshan (Three Mountains) Guild Hall was built by Fujian fruit merchants in Shanghai as a place for gatherings and worshiping the Empress of Heaven (Mazu), also called the Tianhou (Empress of Heaven) Palace.

'Three Mountains' refers to the three mountains in Fuzhou city: Yu Mountain, Ye Mountain, and Wushi Mountain, often used as a代称 for Fuzhou.

At the end of the Qing, there were two Sanshan Guild Halls in Shanghai: one at the intersection of Fuzhou Road and Yunnan Road, and one on Bansongyuan Road in Nanshi.

The original site of the Sanshan Guild Hall on Bansongyuan Road was at Licangqiao; to distinguish it, it was called the Hu'nan Sanshan Guild Hall.

In the 1st year of Xuantong of the Qing (1909), it was moved to the current site and rebuilt.

Sanshan Guild Hall is a traditional Minnan (Southern Fujian) building, facing south, with the four characters 'Sanshan Guild Hall' engraved on the gate tower, with an exquisitely decorated vertical plaque of 'Tianhou Palace' above and stone relief carvings on the left and right.

Entering the gate is the main courtyard; to the north is the opera stage, with a hip-and-gable roof and rich carvings, featuring a magnificent huge caisson ceiling with models of the Shanghai city wall carved around it, exquisitely beautiful.

Facing the opera stage is a three-bay main hall, with two-story opera-viewing towers on both sides, and the main courtyard has courtyards (tianjing) both front and back.

On March 21, 1927, Shanghai workers used this as the command center to launch the third armed uprising.

建筑要点 / Key Features
三山会馆是上海福建水果商人兴建的集会与供奉天后之地又名天后宫三山是指福州城内于山冶山乌石山三座山常作为福州的代称清末上海的三山会馆有两处一在福州路云南路口一在南市半淞园路半淞园路的三山会馆原址在里仓桥为示区别称沪南三山会馆清宣统元年1909年移至今址重建三山会馆是传统的闽南建筑坐北朝南门楼上镌刻三山会馆四字上有装饰精丽的天后宫竖匾左右有石刻浮雕入门为主要院落北向为戏台歇山顶雕刻丰富有金碧辉煌的巨大藻井四周雕刻上海城墙模型精美绝伦正对戏台为三开间大殿两侧有两层观戏楼主体院落前后均有天井1927年3月21日上海工人以此为指挥部举行了第三次武装起义
08 亚细亚大楼（中国太平洋保险公司）
Asia Building (China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd.)
1916年
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
中山东一路1号
类型 Type
近代建筑/办公楼
中文原文

亚细亚大楼位于1843年上海开埠后的英黄浦滩路1号，被称为外滩第一楼。此地原为英商兆丰洋行（H. Fogg & Co.）的产业，后曾几易其主，转属旗昌洋行、轮船招商局等。

1913年麦边洋行（Messrs. George McBain Co.）购得其地，拆去旧屋建设新楼，1916年竣工，1917年被英商亚细亚火油公司收购，改名亚细亚大楼（APC Building）。

大楼由英商马海洋行设计，裕昌泰营造厂施工，楼高8层，钢筋混凝土框架结构。东南两侧立面完全相同，横向竖向各分三段，底部用花岗岩装饰，处理为基座，竖向两侧向外凸出，中段用拱形山花和柱式装饰。平面为回形，中央设天井。

· · · · ·
English

Asia Building is located at No.1 Yinghuangputan Road after Shanghai opened as a treaty port in 1843, known as the 'First Building of the Bund.

' This site was originally the property of the British firm H.Fogg & Co., later changed hands several times, transferred to Russell & Co., the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company etc.

In 1913, Messrs.George McBain Co.

purchased the land, demolished the old building and constructed a new building, completed in 1916; in 1917 it was acquired by the British Asiatic Petroleum Company and renamed Asia Building (APC Building).

The building was designed by the British firm Moorhead & Halse and constructed by Yuchangtai Construction Factory; it is 8 stories high, with a reinforced concrete frame structure.

The southeast two side facades are completely identical, divided horizontally and vertically into three sections each; the bottom is decorated with granite, treated as a base, with both vertical sides protruding outward, and the middle section decorated with arched pediments and columnar ornamentation.

The plan is square-shaped (回形), with a courtyard (tianjing) in the center.

建筑要点 / Key Features
亚细亚大楼位于1843年上海开埠后的英黄浦滩路1号被称为外滩第一楼此地原为英商兆丰洋行H Fogg Co的产业后曾几易其主转属旗昌洋行轮船招商局等1913年麦边洋行Messrs George McBain Co购得其地拆去旧屋建设新楼1916年竣工1917年被英商亚细亚火油公司收购改名亚细亚大楼APC Building大楼由英商马海洋行设计裕昌泰营造厂施工楼高8层钢筋混凝土框架结构东南两侧立面完全相同横向竖向各分三段底部用花岗岩装饰处理为基座竖向两侧向外凸出中段用拱形山花和柱式装饰平面为回形中央设天井
09 上海总会（外滩华尔道夫酒店）
Shanghai Club (Waldorf Astoria Shanghai on the Bund)
1910年
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
中山东一路2号
类型 Type
近代建筑/俱乐部
中文原文

上海总会又称英国总会、旅沪英侨俱乐部，是上海第一个外侨总会。原为3层砖木楼房，1905年决定拆除旧屋重建新楼，由马海洋行设计，1909年开工，英商聚兴营造厂施工，1910年1月完工。新楼采用钢筋混凝土框架结构，正立面为三段式构图，两侧有带巴洛克风格的塔楼。

中部有六根贯穿2、3层的仿爱奥尼式巨柱，柱子和勒脚采用花岗岩，外墙用水刷石饰面。地下室设有滚球场，底层酒吧有110英尺（34米）长的大理石酒吧柜台，号称远东第一。北侧设有德国西门子制造的三角形铁笼式轿厢电梯，至今仍在使用。

1956年成为国际海员俱乐部，1971年部分改为东风饭店。

· · · · ·
English

The Shanghai Club, also called the British Club and the British Residents' Club in Shanghai, was the first foreign residents' club in Shanghai.

Originally a 3-story brick-wood building, in 1905 it was decided to demolish the old building and reconstruct a new one, designed by Moorhead & Halse, construction started in 1909 by the British firm Juxing Construction Factory, and completed in January 1910.

The new building adopts a reinforced concrete frame structure, with the main facade in a three-part composition, with Baroque-style towers on both sides.

In the middle are six imitation Ionic giant columns贯穿 the 2nd and 3rd floors; the columns and plinth use granite, and the exterior wall is finished with brushed stone.

The basement has a bowling alley, and the ground floor bar has a 110-foot (34-meter) long marble bar counter, known as the 'First in the Far East.

' On the north side is a triangular iron-cage car elevator made by Siemens of Germany, still in use today.

In 1956 it became the International Seamen's Club, and in 1971 part was converted into the Dongfeng Hotel.

建筑要点 / Key Features
上海总会又称英国总会旅沪英侨俱乐部是上海第一个外侨总会原为3层砖木楼房1905年决定拆除旧屋重建新楼由马海洋行设计1909年开工英商聚兴营造厂施工1910年1月完工新楼采用钢筋混凝土框架结构正立面为三段式构图两侧有带巴洛克风格的塔楼中部有六根贯穿23层的仿爱奥尼式巨柱柱子和勒脚采用花岗岩外墙用水刷石饰面地下室设有滚球场底层酒吧有110英尺34米长的大理石酒吧柜台号称远东第一北侧设有德国西门子制造的三角形铁笼式轿厢电梯至今仍在使用1956年成为国际海员俱乐部1971年部分改为东风饭店
10 汇丰银行大楼（上海浦东发展银行）
HSBC Building (Shanghai Pudong Development Bank)
1923年
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
中山东一路10—12号
类型 Type
近代建筑/银行
中文原文

汇丰银行是外滩上最著名的建筑，当时号称从苏伊士运河到远东白令海峡最讲究的建筑，它是远东最大的银行建筑，在世界上排名第二。大楼由英商公和洋行设计，英商德罗·考尔洋行承建，1921年5月开工，1923年6月竣工。建筑立面采用纵分三段，横分五段的新古典主义手法，中央顶部建有高两层的钢结构巨型穹顶。

穹顶内部有彩色玻璃马赛克镶嵌画，穹顶底部八面各有壁画，描绘象征着上海、伦敦、巴黎、纽约、东京、曼谷、加尔各答和香港八个城市的女神，并分别以这些城市的建筑为背景。汇丰银行总部在香港，在其他七个城市均有支行。顶部壁画为罗马希腊神话中的神祗，配以黄道十二星座。1955年大修时天顶画被纸筋灰遮蔽，以免遭到破坏，此后作为上海市人民政府使用。

1995年市政府迁出，上海浦东发展银行入驻。

· · · · ·
English

The HSBC Building is the most famous building on the Bund, at that time known as 'the most exquisite building from the Suez Canal to the Bering Strait in the Far East'; it was the largest bank building in the Far East, ranking second in the world.

The building was designed by the British firm Palmer & Turner and constructed by the British firm Trollope & Colls, with construction starting in May 1921 and completed in June 1923.

The building facade adopts a Neoclassical approach of vertical division into three sections and horizontal division into five sections, with a two-story high steel structure giant dome at the top center.

Inside the dome are colored glass mosaic inlays, and on the eight sides at the bottom of the dome are murals depicting goddesses symbolizing eight cities: Shanghai, London, Paris, New York, Tokyo, Bangkok, Calcutta, and Hong Kong, with the architecture of these cities as backgrounds respectively.

HSBC's headquarters is in Hong Kong, with branches in the other seven cities.The top murals are deities from Roman and Greek mythology, paired with the twelve zodiac constellations.

During a major renovation in 1955, the ceiling paintings were covered with plaster to avoid damage, and thereafter it was used as the Shanghai Municipal People's Government.

In 1995 the municipal government moved out, and Shanghai Pudong Development Bank moved in.

建筑要点 / Key Features
汇丰银行是外滩上最著名的建筑当时号称从苏伊士运河到远东白令海峡最讲究的建筑它是远东最大的银行建筑在世界上排名第二大楼由英商公和洋行设计英商德罗考尔洋行承建1921年5月开工1923年6月竣工建筑立面采用纵分三段横分五段的新古典主义手法中央顶部建有高两层的钢结构巨型穹顶穹顶内部有彩色玻璃马赛克镶嵌画穹顶底部八面各有壁画描绘象征着上海伦敦巴黎纽约东京曼谷加尔各答和香港八个城市的女神并分别以这些城市的建筑为背景汇丰银行总部在香港在其他七个城市均有支行顶部壁画为罗马希腊神话中的神祗配以黄道十二星座1955年大修时天顶画被纸筋灰遮蔽以免遭到破坏此后作为上海市人民政府使用1995年市政府迁出上海浦东发展银行入驻
11 江海关大楼（上海海关）
Customs House (Shanghai Customs)

第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）

中文原文

上海海关大楼又称江海关、江海北关等，早期的建筑类似中国衙门，1891年拆除旧屋建造了砖木结构，带有五层钟楼的新大楼，由英国建筑师科里（J.M.Cory）和钱伯斯（M.J. Chambers）设计，杨瑞泰营造厂承建。

1925年又拆除新建钢框架结构的新楼，由公和洋行设计，新仁记营造厂营建，高8层（连夹层9层），上有4层高的钟楼。

钟楼内设有仿伦敦国会大厦制造的大自鸣钟，直径5.3米，中有72盏自动电灯，最大的钟摆重达2吨，为亚洲之冠，也是世界知名的大钟之一。

· · · · ·
English

The Shanghai Customs Building, also called Jianghaiguan and Jianghaibeiguan etc.

, had an early building similar to a Chinese yamen; in 1891 the old building was demolished and a new brick-wood structure building with a five-story clock tower was built, designed by British architects J.

M.Cory and M.J.Chambers, constructed by Yangruitai Construction Factory.

In 1925 it was demolished again and a new steel-frame structure building was built, designed by Palmer & Turner and constructed by Xinrenji Construction Factory, 8 stories high (9 stories including mezzanine), with a 4-story high clock tower on top.

Inside the clock tower is a large clock made in imitation of the Palace of Westminster in London, with a diameter of 5.

3 meters, 72 automatic electric lights inside, and the largest pendulum weighing 2 tons, the largest in Asia and one of the world-famous large clocks.

建筑要点 / Key Features
上海海关大楼又称江海关江海北关等早期的建筑类似中国衙门1891年拆除旧屋建造了砖木结构带有五层钟楼的新大楼由英国建筑师科里J MCory和钱伯斯M J Chambers设计杨瑞泰营造厂承建1925年又拆除新建钢框架结构的新楼由公和洋行设计新仁记营造厂营建高8层连夹层9层上有4层高的钟楼钟楼内设有仿伦敦国会大厦制造的大自鸣钟直径5.3米中有72盏自动电灯最大的钟摆重达2吨为亚洲之冠也是世界知名的大钟之一
12 汇中饭店（斯沃琪和平饭店艺术中心）
Palace Hotel (Swatch Art Peace Hotel)

中文原文

汇中饭店原为中央饭店（Central Hotel），高三层，是上海早期最豪华的西式酒店之一。1903年被汇中洋行收购，1906年拆旧楼建新楼，由英商马礼逊洋行设计，华商王发记营造厂承建，1906年完工，高6层，是当时公共租界第一座高楼。

6层屋顶上建有上海最早的屋顶花园，临江一侧原有两座巴洛克式塔亭，1914年失火烧毁，1998年复建。店内装有两台奥的斯电梯，是上海最早装备客梯的建筑之一。1909年第一次国际禁毒大会万国禁烟会在汇中饭店五楼召开。

1965年改为和平饭店南楼。

· · · · ·
English

The Palace Hotel was originally the Central Hotel, three stories high, one of the most luxurious Western-style hotels in early Shanghai.

In 1903 it was acquired by the Central Hotel Company, and in 1906 the old building was demolished to build a new one, designed by the British firm Morrison & Gratton and constructed by the Chinese firm Wangfaji Construction Factory, completed in 1906, 6 stories high, the first tall building in the International Settlement at that time.

On the 6th floor roof was built Shanghai's earliest roof garden; on the riverside side there were originally two Baroque-style pavilions, which burned down in a fire in 1914 and were rebuilt in 1998.

The hotel was equipped with two Otis elevators, one of the earliest buildings in Shanghai equipped with passenger elevators.

In 1909, the first international anti-drug conference, the International Opium Commission, was held on the fifth floor of the Palace Hotel.

In 1965 it was converted into the South Building of the Peace Hotel.

建筑要点 / Key Features
汇中饭店原为中央饭店Central Hotel高三层是上海早期最豪华的西式酒店之一1903年被汇中洋行收购1906年拆旧楼建新楼由英商马礼逊洋行设计华商王发记营造厂承建1906年完工高6层是当时公共租界第一座高楼6层屋顶上建有上海最早的屋顶花园临江一侧原有两座巴洛克式塔亭1914年失火烧毁1998年复建店内装有两台奥的斯电梯是上海最早装备客梯的建筑之一1909年第一次国际禁毒大会万国禁烟会在汇中饭店五楼召开1965年改为和平饭店南楼
13 沙逊大厦（上海和平饭店）
Sassoon House (The Peace Hotel)
1929年
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
中山东一路20号
类型 Type
近代建筑/饭店
中文原文

沙逊大厦又名华懋饭店，是英籍犹太商人维克多·沙逊（Victor Sassoon）经营的新沙逊洋行属下华懋地产股份有限公司（Cathay Land Co.,Ltd.）经营的房产。大厦1926年开工，1929年建成，由公和洋行设计，新仁记营造厂承建，采用钢框架结构。

楼高77米，地上13层，地下1层，有远东第一高楼的美誉。大楼顶层有高达19米的墨绿色金字塔屋顶，是上海外滩的地标之一，楼身采用花岗石贴面，强调竖向线条，具有强烈的装饰艺术风格。

除出租部分楼层给银行和沙逊公司自用办公外，主要用来开设旅馆。内部装修豪华，有装饰为各国风格的套房，包括中国、英国、法国、意大利、美国、德国、印度、西班牙和日本等各种式样，使各地游客皆有宾至如归之感。1952年大厦被政府接管以抵偿债务，1956年重新对外开放，改名和平饭店。

· · · · ·
English

Sassoon House, also called the Cathay Hotel, was a property operated by Cathay Land Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of the New Sassoon Company operated by the British Jewish businessman Victor Sassoon.

The building started construction in 1926 and was completed in 1929, designed by Palmer & Turner and constructed by Xinrenji Construction Factory, adopting a steel frame structure.

The building is 77 meters high, with 13 floors above ground and 1 basement floor, known as the 'Tallest Building in the Far East.

' The top of the building has a 19-meter-high dark green pyramid roof, one of the landmarks of the Shanghai Bund; the building body is clad in granite, emphasizing vertical lines, with a strong Art Deco style.

Except for renting some floors to banks and for Sassoon Company's own office use, it was mainly used to operate a hotel.

The interior is luxuriously decorated, with suites decorated in various national styles, including Chinese, British, French, Italian, American, German, Indian, Spanish, and Japanese styles etc.

, making tourists from all places feel at home.In 1952 the building was taken over by the government to offset debts, and in 1956 it was reopened to the public and renamed the Peace Hotel.

建筑要点 / Key Features
沙逊大厦又名华懋饭店是英籍犹太商人维克多沙逊Victor Sassoon经营的新沙逊洋行属下华懋地产股份有限公司Cathay Land CoLtd经营的房产大厦1926年开工1929年建成由公和洋行设计新仁记营造厂承建采用钢框架结构楼高77米地上13层地下1层有远东第一高楼的美誉大楼顶层有高达19米的墨绿色金字塔屋顶是上海外滩的地标之一楼身采用花岗石贴面强调竖向线条具有强烈的装饰艺术风格除出租部分楼层给银行和沙逊公司自用办公外主要用来开设旅馆内部装修豪华有装饰为各国风格的套房包括中国英国法国意大利美国德国印度西班牙和日本等各种式样使各地游客皆有宾至如归之感1952年大厦被政府接管以抵偿债务1956年重新对外开放改名和平饭店
14 中国银行大楼
Bank of China Tower
1929年
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
中山东一路23号
类型 Type
近代建筑/银行
中文原文

中国银行上海分行早期在汉口路原大清银行上海分行营业，1923年迁入德国总会大楼，1934年拆除德国总会兴建新楼。

新楼由中国建筑师陆谦受与公和洋行合作设计，陶桂记（馥记）营造厂承建，主楼采用钢框架结构，副楼采用钢筋混凝土结构，1937年竣工。

这座摩天楼融入了中国民族艺术风格，在大厦的顶端冠以攒尖屋顶，装饰细部大量采用简化和几何化的中国传统建筑图案，檐下有简化仿木构的石斗拱，正立面漏窗采用寿字图案，大门口九级台阶取九九无穷之意，大门上方有孔子周游列国石雕，可惜新中国成立后被铲去。大楼内部装修豪华，具有中国民族风格，下部有两层地下室，安保设计严密，被称为远东第一大库。

在设计之初曾有意在高度上与旁侧的沙逊大厦争胜，可惜后来方案更改，降低了高度，但规模和设施仍堪称一时之冠。该楼目前仍由中国银行上海分行使用。

· · · · ·
English

The Shanghai Branch of Bank of China early operated at the original Shanghai Branch of the Ta-Ching Government Bank on Hankou Road; in 1923 it moved into the German Club building, and in 1934 the German Club was demolished to build a new building.

The new building was co-designed by Chinese architect Lu Qianshou and Palmer & Turner, constructed by Taokuei (Fukee) Construction Factory; the main building adopts a steel frame structure, and the annex adopts a reinforced concrete structure, completed in 1937.

This skyscraper incorporates Chinese national artistic style, with a pyramidal roof at the top of the building, and decorative details extensively using simplified and geometricized traditional Chinese architectural patterns; under the eaves are simplified stone bracket sets imitating wooden structures, the lattice windows on the main facade use the 'shou' (longevity) character pattern, the nine steps at the main gate take the meaning of 'nine-nine endless,' and above the main gate there is a stone carving of Confucius traveling around the states, unfortunately removed after the founding of New China.

The interior of the building is luxuriously decorated, with Chinese national style; the lower part has two basement floors, with strict security design, known as the 'Largest Vault in the Far East.

' At the beginning of the design, there was an intention to compete in height with the adjacent Sassoon House, but unfortunately the plan was later changed to reduce the height; however, its scale and facilities were still considered the best of its time.

The building is still used by the Shanghai Branch of Bank of China today.

建筑要点 / Key Features
中国银行上海分行早期在汉口路原大清银行上海分行营业1923年迁入德国总会大楼1934年拆除德国总会兴建新楼新楼由中国建筑师陆谦受与公和洋行合作设计陶桂记馥记营造厂承建主楼采用钢框架结构副楼采用钢筋混凝土结构1937年竣工这座摩天楼融入了中国民族艺术风格在大厦的顶端冠以攒尖屋顶装饰细部大量采用简化和几何化的中国传统建筑图案檐下有简化仿木构的石斗拱正立面漏窗采用寿字图案大门口九级台阶取九九无穷之意大门上方有孔子周游列国石雕可惜新中国成立后被铲去大楼内部装修豪华具有中国民族风格下部有两层地下室安保设计严密被称为远东第一大库在设计之初曾有意在高度上与旁侧的沙逊大厦争胜可惜后来方案更改降低了高度但规模和设施仍堪称一时之冠该楼目前仍由中国银行上海分行使用
15 英国驻沪领事馆（外滩源壹号、百达翡丽源邸）
Former British Consul General's House in Shanghai (No.1 Waitanyuan, Maison Patek Philippe)
1872年
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
中山东一路33号
类型 Type
近代建筑/领事馆
中文原文

英国驻沪领事馆是外滩为数不多的早期建筑遗存，也是上海外滩建筑群中年代最早的近代建筑。英国领事馆最早设在租用的民房内，1846年英国人租地在上海城外北侧建领事馆，1870年发生火灾，建筑与文件档案一起烧毁。

1872年在原址重建，由格罗斯曼与鲍伊斯（Grossman and Boyce）设计。领事馆办公楼为两层砖木结构，采用外廊式风格，房屋西立面横向分三段，两侧微向外凸出。房屋西面入口有多立克双柱支撑的门头，二层是爱奥尼式的柱廊，东侧面向大片草坪，房屋中部下层设有五间拱形外廊，上层为方廊内阳台。

屋顶原使用中国小青瓦屋面，后改为红色平瓦，原为清水砖外墙面，后用水泥砂浆抹灰。

北侧有1882年建成的领事官邸，也是两层砖木楼房，外廊式风格与办公楼相似，保持着清水砖墙原貌，转角处采用隅石交错装饰，拱廊的柱子采用石质的小棵柯林斯柱，墙体主要用青砖，拱券和局部柱子用红砖装饰。领事官邸与领事馆之间有走廊相连。

新中国成立后上海驻沪领事馆撤离，房产曾由上海市政府机关事务管理局等单位使用，现改为酒店。

· · · · ·
English

The Former British Consulate in Shanghai is one of the few early architectural relics on the Bund, and also the earliest modern building in the Shanghai Bund architectural complex.

The British Consulate was earliest located in a rented private house; in 1846 the British rented land to build the consulate north of outside Shanghai city; in 1870 a fire broke out, burning the building together with documents and archives.

In 1872 it was rebuilt on the original site, designed by Grossman and Boyce.

The consulate office building is a two-story brick-wood structure, adopting a veranda style; the west facade of the building is horizontally divided into three sections, with both sides slightly protruding outward.

The west entrance of the building has a doorhead supported by Doric double columns; the second floor is an Ionic colonnade; the east side faces a large lawn; the lower floor in the middle of the building has five arched verandas, and the upper floor is a square veranda inner balcony.

The roof originally used Chinese small grey tiles, later changed to red flat tiles; originally a plain brick exterior wall, later plastered with cement mortar.

On the north side is the Consul General's residence built in 1882, also a two-story brick-wood building, with a veranda style similar to the office building, maintaining the original plain brick wall appearance; the corners use alternating quoins decoration, the columns of the arched colonnade use small stone Corinthian columns, the walls mainly use grey bricks, and the arches and local columns are decorated with red bricks.

There is a corridor connecting the Consul General's residence and the consulate.

After the founding of New China, the British Consulate in Shanghai withdrew, and the property was once used by units such as the Shanghai Municipal Government Offices Administration, now converted into a hotel.

建筑要点 / Key Features
英国驻沪领事馆是外滩为数不多的早期建筑遗存也是上海外滩建筑群中年代最早的近代建筑英国领事馆最早设在租用的民房内1846年英国人租地在上海城外北侧建领事馆1870年发生火灾建筑与文件档案一起烧毁1872年在原址重建由格罗斯曼与鲍伊斯Grossman and Boyce设计领事馆办公楼为两层砖木结构采用外廊式风格房屋西立面横向分三段两侧微向外凸出房屋西面入口有多立克双柱支撑的门头二层是爱奥尼式的柱廊东侧面向大片草坪房屋中部下层设有五间拱形外廊上层为方廊内阳台屋顶原使用中国小青瓦屋面后改为红色平瓦原为清水砖外墙面后用水泥砂浆抹灰北侧有1882年建成的领事官邸也是两层砖木楼房外廊式风格与办公楼相似保持着清水砖墙原貌转角处采用隅石交错装饰拱廊的柱子采用石质的小棵柯林斯柱墙体主要用青砖拱券和局部柱子用红砖装饰领事官邸与领事馆之间有走廊相连新中国成立后上海驻沪领事馆撤离房产曾由上海市政府机关事务管理局等单位使用现改为酒店
16 百老汇大厦（上海大厦）
Broadway Mansions (Shanghai Mansions Hotel)
1930—1934
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
虹口区北苏州路20号（今上海大厦）
类型 Type
近代建筑/饭店
中文原文

大厦以公和洋行为顾问，由业广地产公司建筑部设计，新仁记营造厂承建，共21层，高77米。大厦建在软土地基的苏州河北岸，因此先打满堂洋松长桩，然后现浇箱型基础；上部建筑采用铝钢框架，自重轻，刚性好，当时很少见。大厦平面为“>—<”形，与一字形相比，不但容积率更高，而且有利于抗风，能增强建筑的结构稳定性。

大厦自第11层开始，逐层向内收进，形成中央高、两侧低的造型，显得挺拔稳重。其中第18层的开敞平台是眺望浦江两岸风景的最佳场所。

· · · · ·
English

The building used Palmer & Turner as consultants, designed by the Architecture Department of Shanghai Land Investment Company, constructed by Xinrenji Construction Factory, with a total of 21 stories and a height of 77 meters.

The building was built on the north bank of Suzhou Creek with soft soil foundation, so full-area long Oregon pine piles were first driven, then a box-type foundation was cast in place; the upper building adopts an aluminum-steel frame, light in weight and good in rigidity, rare at that time.

The building plan is '>—<' shaped; compared with a straight shape, it not only has a higher floor area ratio but also is conducive to wind resistance, enhancing the structural stability of the building.

Starting from the 11th floor, the building recedes inward layer by layer, forming a shape with a high center and low sides, appearing tall and steady.

Among them, the open platform on the 18th floor is the best place to overlook the scenery on both sides of the Huangpu River.

建筑要点 / Key Features
大厦以公和洋行为顾问由业广地产公司建筑部设计新仁记营造厂承建共21层高77米大厦建在软土地基的苏州河北岸因此先打满堂洋松长桩然后现浇箱型基础上部建筑采用铝钢框架自重轻刚性好当时很少见大厦平面为形与一字形相比不但容积率更高而且有利于抗风能增强建筑的结构稳定性大厦自第11层开始逐层向内收进形成中央高两侧低的造型显得挺拔稳重其中第18层的开敞平台是眺望浦江两岸风景的最佳场所
17 上海邮政大楼
Shanghai Post Office Building
1924年
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
虹口区北苏州路276号
类型 Type
近代建筑/邮政
中文原文

上海邮政大楼始建于1922年，是继1915年天津车站邮政大楼，1922年北京天安门邮政大楼之后的第三座邮政大楼。前两座邮政大楼今已不存，上海邮政大楼是保存最完整的早期邮政大楼。

该大楼于1922年由国民政府交通部邮政总局投资建设，英商思九生洋行设计，华商余洪记营造厂承建，选址在苏州河北岸由北苏州路、四川路、天潼路和江西北路围合而成的街区。大楼沿南、东、西侧路边布置，平面呈U形，正门入口在北苏州路与四川北路交叉口，中部空间为邮政车辆停放场地。

大楼采用钢筋混凝土结构，高四层，转角处设钟楼，另有一层地下室，内部装升降传送带、运送邮件袋的螺旋滑梯，以及货运升降梯等当时先进的邮政设施。

大楼底层和地下室为包裹邮政和工作间，入口门厅为大理石螺旋台阶，二楼为面积达1200多平方米的巨型营业厅，厅内排列柚木制成的营业柜台，柜台外用大理石贴面，装有精致的铜栅栏，天顶装有巨型西式宫廷吊灯，富丽堂皇，有远东第一大厅之称。

· · · · ·
English

The Shanghai Post Office Building was first built in 1922, the third post office building after the 1915 Tianjin Station Post Office Building and the 1922 Beijing Tiananmen Post Office Building.

The first two post office buildings no longer exist today, and the Shanghai Post Office Building is the best-preserved early post office building.

The building was invested and constructed by the Postal Administration of the Ministry of Communications of the Nationalist Government in 1922, designed by the British firm Stewardson & Spence, and constructed by the Chinese firm Yuhongji Construction Factory.

The site was selected on the north bank of Suzhou Creek, in the block enclosed by North Suzhou Road, Sichuan Road, Tiantong Road, and North Jiangxi Road.

The building is arranged along the south, east, and west roadside, with a U-shaped plan; the main entrance is at the intersection of North Suzhou Road and North Sichuan Road, and the central space is a parking area for postal vehicles.

The building adopts a reinforced concrete structure, four stories high, with a clock tower at the corner, and another basement floor; inside are installed advanced postal facilities of the time such as lifting conveyor belts, spiral slides for mail bags, and freight elevators.

The ground floor and basement of the building are for parcel post and workrooms; the entrance foyer has a marble spiral staircase; the second floor is a giant business hall with an area of over 1,200 square meters, with teak business counters arranged in the hall, the counters are faced with marble outside, equipped with exquisite copper railings, and the ceiling is equipped with giant Western-style palace chandeliers, magnificent and resplendent, known as the 'First Hall in the Far East.

'

建筑要点 / Key Features
上海邮政大楼始建于1922年是继1915年天津车站邮政大楼1922年北京天安门邮政大楼之后的第三座邮政大楼前两座邮政大楼今已不存上海邮政大楼是保存最完整的早期邮政大楼该大楼于1922年由国民政府交通部邮政总局投资建设英商思九生洋行设计华商余洪记营造厂承建选址在苏州河北岸由北苏州路四川路天潼路和江西北路围合而成的街区大楼沿东南西侧路边布置平面呈U形正门入口在北苏州路与四川北路交叉口中部空间为邮政车辆停放场地大楼采用钢筋混凝土结构高四层转角处设钟楼另有一层地下室内部装升降传送带运送邮件袋的螺旋滑梯以及货运升降梯等当时先进的邮政设施大楼底层和地下室为包裹邮政和工作间入口门厅为大理石螺旋台阶二楼为面积达1200多平方米的巨型营业厅厅内排列柚木制成的营业柜台柜台外用大理石贴面装有精致的铜栅栏天顶装有巨型西式宫廷吊灯富丽堂皇有远东第一大厅之称
18 国际饭店
Park Hotel
民国
级别 Level
第六批全国重点文物保护单位
地址 Address
黄浦区南京西路170号
类型 Type
近代建筑/饭店
中文原文

国际饭店由四行储蓄会于1931年投资兴建，最初名叫四行储蓄会二十二层大厦（The Joint Savings Society Building），后改称国际饭店。大厦由匈牙利建筑师拉斯洛·邬达克（Ladislav Hudec）设计，采用美国装饰艺术摩天楼风格，底部外墙用青岛崂山黑色花岗岩饰面，三层以上贴国产棕褐色泰山面砖。

国际饭店在1983年以前都是上海最高的建筑，地面以上83.8米，它的建成代表着中国近代建筑技术水平达到新的高度。饭店上层建筑为馥记营造厂承建，采用钢框架结构和钢筋混凝土楼板，打桩工程由丹麦康益公司承包，采用密度较高的梅花桩，最深达120英尺，因此今天国际饭店的沉降率很小。

饭店内部配备了当时最先进的设备，如自动灭火设备、自流井装置和大小7座电梯（大的可运送汽车，小的为运送饭菜）。饭店地上22层，地下2层，第一层地下室为保险库，采用厚达30余英寸的（760多毫米）钢筋混凝土墙，上下及四壁均铺设1英寸（24毫米）厚钢板，异常牢固。

相当长一段时间，上海测绘均以国际饭店顶端旗杆中心为零点，建立上海的坐标系，因此国际饭店有上海之心的称号，现在国际饭店底层大厅还留有上海之心的标记。饭店二层设有国际饭店文史展览，可进入参观。

· · · · ·
English

The Park Hotel was invested and built by the Four Banks Savings Society in 1931, originally named 'The Joint Savings Society Building,' later renamed the Park Hotel.

The building was designed by Hungarian architect Ladislav Hudec, adopting the American Art Deco skyscraper style; the bottom exterior wall is faced with black granite from Laoshan, Qingdao, and above the third floor it is clad with domestically produced brown Taishan face bricks.

The Park Hotel was the tallest building in Shanghai before 1983, 83.8 meters above ground; its completion represents a new height in modern Chinese architectural technology.

The upper structure of the hotel was constructed by Fukee Construction Factory, adopting a steel frame structure and reinforced concrete floors; the piling project was contracted by the Danish company Kangyi, using high-density plum-blossom piles with a maximum depth of 120 feet, so today the settlement rate of the Park Hotel is very small.

The hotel interior was equipped with the most advanced equipment of the time, such as automatic fire extinguishing equipment, artesian well devices, and 7 elevators of various sizes (the large one can transport cars, the small one for transporting food).

The hotel has 22 floors above ground and 2 basement floors; the first basement floor is a vault, using a reinforced concrete wall over 30 inches (over 760 mm) thick, with 1-inch (24 mm) thick steel plates laid on the top, bottom, and four walls, extremely solid.

For quite a long time, Shanghai surveying used the center of the flagpole at the top of the Park Hotel as the zero point to establish Shanghai's coordinate system, hence the Park Hotel has the title 'Heart of Shanghai'; now the ground floor lobby of the Park Hotel still retains the 'Heart of Shanghai' mark.

The second floor of the hotel has a Park Hotel cultural and historical exhibition, which can be visited.

建筑要点 / Key Features
国际饭店由四行储蓄会于1931年投资兴建最初名叫四行储蓄会二十二层大厦The Joint Savings Society Building后改称国际饭店大厦由匈牙利建筑师拉斯洛邬达克Ladislav Hudec设计采用美国装饰艺术摩天楼风格底部外墙用青岛崂山黑色花岗岩饰面三层以上贴国产棕褐色泰山面砖国际饭店在1983年以前都是上海最高的建筑地面以上83.8米它的建成代表着中国近代建筑技术水平达到新的高度饭店上层建筑为馥记营造厂承建采用钢框架结构和钢筋混凝土楼板打桩工程由丹麦康益公司承包采用密度较高的梅花桩最深达120英尺因此今天国际饭店的沉降率很小饭店内部配备了当时最先进的设备如自动灭火设备自流井装置和大小7座电梯大的可运送汽车小的为运送饭菜饭店地上22层地下2层第一层地下室为保险库采用厚达30余英寸的760多毫米钢筋混凝土墙上下及四壁均铺设1英寸24毫米厚钢板异常牢固相当长一段时间上海测绘均以国际饭店顶端旗杆中心为零点建立上海的坐标系因此国际饭店有上海之心的称号现在国际饭店底层大厅还留有上海之心的标记饭店二层设有国际饭店文史展览可进入参观
19 大光明剧院
Grand Theater
1933年
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1989年）
地址 Address
静安寺路（今南京西路）和派克路（今黄河路）交叉口
类型 Type
近代建筑/剧院
中文原文

大光明剧院始建于1928年，1931年因放映辱华电影引起风波而停业，1933年被英籍华人卢根收购，并拆除旧屋重建。

新建筑由匈牙利建筑师邬达克设计，采用装饰艺术风格，外立面横竖直线条组合，大量使用玻璃，夜晚灯火通明。大门内部设有天花板与墙壁，都用华丽金色装潢的巨大门厅，通过两道楼梯直通二楼。内部灯光全部采用灯光暗槽，用流线型的灯光设计引导人流进入观众厅，大厅柱子也使用透光的设置。

观众厅有1961座，座位设置宽敞舒适，内部天顶也使用金色天花，配合暗槽灯光，显得富丽堂皇。当时剧院耗资30万元购买了离心式电动冷气机，室内四季温暖如春。剧院室内与室外均设有三个圆形喷水池，喷头配合彩色灯光，呈现绚丽水景，在大门口的喷水池曾因围观群众过多而阻碍交通。如今剧院二楼仍有喷水池大理石池壁与基座遗迹，灯光与设备不存。

目前大光明剧院修复后仍作为电影院使用。

· · · · ·
English

The Grand Theater was first built in 1928; in 1931 it ceased operations due to a controversy caused by screening a Chinese-insulting film; in 1933 it was acquired by British Chinese Lu Gen, who demolished the old building and rebuilt it.

The new building was designed by Hungarian architect Hudec, adopting the Art Deco style, with the exterior facade combining horizontal and vertical straight lines, extensively using glass, brightly lit at night.

Inside the main gate is a huge lobby with ceilings and walls both decorated in gorgeous gold, leading directly to the second floor through two staircases.

The interior lighting all uses recessed light slots, with streamlined lighting design to guide the flow of people into the auditorium; the hall columns also use light-transmitting settings.

The auditorium has 1,961 seats, with spacious and comfortable seating; the interior ceiling also uses gold ceiling,配合 recessed slot lighting, appearing magnificent and resplendent.

At that time the theater spent 300,000 yuan to purchase a centrifugal electric air conditioner, making the interior as warm as spring in all four seasons.

Both inside and outside the theater there are three circular fountains, with nozzles配合 colored lights to present gorgeous water scenery; the fountain at the main gate once obstructed traffic due to too many onlookers.

Today the second floor of the theater still has the marble pool wall and base ruins of the fountain, but the lights and equipment no longer exist.

Currently the Grand Theater, after restoration, is still used as a cinema.

建筑要点 / Key Features
大光明剧院始建于1928年1931年因放映辱华电影引起风波而停业1933年被英籍华人卢根收购并拆除旧屋重建新建筑由匈牙利建筑师邬达克设计采用装饰艺术风格外立面横竖直线条组合大量使用玻璃夜晚灯火通明大门内部设有天花板与墙壁都用华丽金色装潢的巨大门厅通过两道楼梯直通二楼内部灯光全部采用灯光暗槽用流线型的灯光设计引导人流进入观众厅大厅柱子也使用透光的设置观众厅有1961座座位设置宽敞舒适内部天顶也使用金色天花配合暗槽灯光显得富丽堂皇当时剧院耗资30万元购买了离心式电动冷气机室内四季温暖如春剧院室内与室外均设有三个圆形喷水池喷头配合彩色灯光呈现绚丽水景在大门口的喷水池曾因围观群众过多而阻碍交通如今剧院二楼仍有喷水池大理石池壁与基座遗迹灯光与设备不存目前大光明剧院修复后仍作为电影院使用
20 跑马总会（上海美术馆）
Shanghai Race Club (China Art Museum, Shanghai)
1933年
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1989年）
地址 Address
黄浦区南京西路325号
类型 Type
近代建筑/俱乐部
中文原文

1850年麟瑞洋行和仁记洋行大班成立了上海跑马总会，兴建马场并建造俱乐部，后因获利丰厚，拆除旧屋建设新楼。新楼由英商马海洋行设计，余洪记营造厂承建，1933年竣工。

楼高四层，东临跑马场，设巨型看台，西立面中部饰有贯通两层的塔斯干立柱，北部有高8层，53米的钟楼为入口。大楼具有折衷主义特色，外墙以石材和红砖饰面，室内设计明快具有现代感。

楼内一二层与看台相连，三楼有看赛马的包厢，内设各种娱乐设施。新中国成立后跑马总会改为上海博物馆、上海图书馆和上海市体育宫。后图书馆迁走，体育宫拆除，大楼北部扩建为上海美术馆新馆。

· · · · ·
English

In 1850, the taipans of Linrui & Co.and Giles & Co.

established the Shanghai Race Club, building a racecourse and a clubhouse; later, due to substantial profits, the old building was demolished to construct a new building.

The new building was designed by the British firm Moorhead & Halse and constructed by Yuhongji Construction Factory, completed in 1933.

The building is four stories high, facing the racecourse to the east with a giant grandstand; the middle of the west facade is decorated with Tuscan columns贯穿 two stories; the north has an 8-story, 53-meter-high clock tower as the entrance.

The building has eclectic characteristics, with exterior walls faced with stone and red brick, and a bright and modern interior design.

The first and second floors inside the building are connected to the grandstand; the third floor has boxes for watching horse races, with various entertainment facilities inside.

After the founding of New China, the Race Club was converted into the Shanghai Museum, Shanghai Library, and Shanghai Municipal Sports Palace.

Later the library moved away and the sports palace was demolished; the north part of the building was expanded into the new building of the Shanghai Art Museum.

建筑要点 / Key Features
1850年麟瑞洋行和仁记洋行大班成立了上海跑马总会兴建马场并建造俱乐部后因获利丰厚拆除旧屋建设新楼新楼由英商马海洋行设计余洪记营造厂承建1933年竣工楼高四层层东临跑马场设巨型看台西立面中部饰有贯通两层的塔斯干立柱北部有高8层53米的钟楼为入口大楼具有折衷主义特色外墙以石材和红砖饰面室内设计明快具有现代感楼内一二层与看台相连三楼有看赛马的包厢内设各种娱乐设施新中国成立后跑马总会改为上海博物馆上海图书馆和上海市体育宫后图书馆迁走体育宫拆除大楼北部扩建为上海美术馆新馆
21 沐恩堂
Muen Church
1931年
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1993年）
地址 Address
黄浦区西藏中路316号
类型 Type
近代建筑/教堂
中文原文

沐恩堂由美国监理会教士创办，清同治十三年（1874年）监理会在法租界建三一堂，清光绪十三年（1887年）在云南路汉口路建监理会堂，清光绪十六年（1890年）因美国教徒慕尔捐献巨款，监理会将监理会堂改名为慕尔堂，又将三一堂合并。

1929年监理堂将原监理会堂土地转让给扬子饭店，在今西藏中路原中西女中的地段拆除旧屋重建，新教堂由邬达克设计，1931年完工，为当时教堂建筑之冠。

新教堂采用哥特风格，内部大堂支撑结构与门窗均使用尖拱券，外部采用红砖与石材装饰，主体为可容千人的大圣堂，正门西向，有高耸的石质叠涩尖券大门，大门上方十字架下有真理使尔自由六字。内有门厅，可作为接待室，圣堂东侧为圣龛，中厅宽敞，围绕中厅南北西侧均有楼座，两侧开侧高窗，有纤细的石雕窗棂，采用铅条镶嵌的彩绘玻璃窗，彩绘内容为圣经人物故事图案。

教堂院落西北、西南、东南三面均有三层辅楼，分别作为办公室、幼儿园、小学和女子宿舍等。

大堂西南角有高42米的方形钟楼，1936年一位美国教徒捐款在钟楼顶部修建了高4米的霓虹灯十字架，下有马达，可徐徐转动，使得慕尔堂成为当时最时髦的教堂之一。

该教堂时常举办教育、慈善、医疗等社交活动，因此又有东亚最大的社交堂之称，抗战时曾收留难民千人，同时也是美国教会援华总部所在地。日据时期圣堂成为日军马厩，遭到破坏，1945年收回修复，1948年拆除钟楼上部，1958上海基督教在此举行联合礼拜，改名为沐恩堂。

1966年停止宗教活动，1979年9月2日恢复礼拜，1988年修复钟楼。

· · · · ·
English

Muen Church was founded by American Methodist Episcopal missionaries; in the 13th year of Tongzhi of the Qing (1874) the Methodist Episcopal Church built the Trinity Church in the French Concession; in the 13th year of Guangxu (1887) it built the Methodist Church at the intersection of Yunnan Road and Hankou Road; in the 16th year of Guangxu (1890), because American believer Moore donated a large sum of money, the Methodist Episcopal Church renamed the Methodist Church as Moore Memorial Church, and merged Trinity Church into it.

In 1929 the Methodist Church transferred the land of the original Methodist Church to the Yangtze Hotel, and demolished the old building to rebuild on the site of the former McTyeire School on today's Middle Xizang Road; the new church was designed by Hudec and completed in 1931, the crown of church architecture at that time.

The new church adopts the Gothic style; the internal main hall support structure and doors and windows all use pointed arches; the exterior uses red brick and stone decoration; the main body is a great sanctuary that can accommodate a thousand people; the main gate faces west, with a towering stone corbeled pointed arch gate, and below the cross above the gate are the six characters 'Truth makes you free.

' Inside there is a foyer that can serve as a reception room; east of the sanctuary is the altar; the nave is spacious; around the nave on the north, south, and west sides there are galleries, with clerestory windows on both sides, with slender stone-carved window lattice, using lead-came stained glass windows, with painted content being biblical character story patterns.

On the northwest, southwest, and southeast sides of the church courtyard there are three-story auxiliary buildings, respectively serving as offices, kindergartens, primary schools, and women's dormitories etc.

At the southwest corner of the main hall is a 42-meter-high square bell tower; in 1936 an American believer donated money to build a 4-meter-high neon cross on top of the bell tower, with a motor below that can rotate slowly, making Moore Memorial Church one of the most fashionable churches at that time.

The church often held social activities such as education, charity, and medical care, hence it also had the title of the 'Largest Social Church in East Asia'; during the War of Resistance it once sheltered a thousand refugees, and was also the headquarters of the American Church's aid to China.

During the Japanese occupation period, the sanctuary became a Japanese army stable and was damaged; it was recovered and repaired in 1945; the upper part of the bell tower was demolished in 1948; in 1958 Shanghai Christians held united worship here and renamed it Muen Church.

Religious activities ceased in 1966; worship resumed on September 2, 1979; the bell tower was restored in 1988.

建筑要点 / Key Features
沐恩堂由美国监理会教士创办清同治十三年1874年监理会在法租界建三堂清光绪十三年1887年在云南路汉口路建监理会堂清光绪十六年1890年因美国教徒慕尔捐献巨款监理会将监理会堂改名为慕尔堂又将三一堂合并1929年监理堂将原监理会堂土地转让给扬子饭店在今西藏中路原中西女中的地段拆除旧屋重建新教堂由邬达克设计1931年完工为当时教堂建筑之冠新教堂采用哥特风格内部大堂支撑结构与门窗均使用尖拱券外部采用红砖与石材装饰主体为可容千人的大圣堂正门西向有高耸的石质叠涩尖券大门大门上方十字架下有真理使尔自由六字内有门厅可作为接待室圣堂东侧为圣龛中厅宽敞围绕中厅南北西侧均有楼座两侧开侧高窗有纤细的石雕窗棂采用铅条镶嵌的彩绘玻璃窗彩绘内容为圣经人物故事图案教堂院落西北西南东南三面均有三层辅楼分别作为办公室幼儿园小学和女子宿舍等大堂西南角有高42米的方形钟楼1936年一位美国教徒捐款在钟楼顶部修建了高4米的霓虹灯十字架下有马达可徐徐转动使得慕尔堂成为当时最时髦的教堂之一该教堂时常举办教育慈善医疗等社交活动因此又有东亚最大的社交堂之称抗战时曾收留难民千人同时也是美国教会援华总部所在地日据时期圣堂成为日军马厩遭到
22 南京大戏院（上海音乐厅）
Nanking Theater (Shanghai Concert Hall)
1930年
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1989年）
地址 Address
黄浦区延安东路523号
类型 Type
近代建筑/剧院
中文原文

上海音乐厅原名南京大戏院，原位于麦高包禄路（今龙门路）、爱多亚路（今延安东路东、中段）路口西南。1929年由南怡怡电影公司租地兴建，聘请中国建筑师范文照和赵深设计，1930建成。剧院采用新古典主义风格，高4层，钢筋混凝土结构，木屋架。

外立面为灰色面砖，底层和局部用白色水刷石饰面，正面入口上方有四根贯穿两层的爱奥尼式巨柱，柱间为拱券落地长窗，梁柱上方有巨型横条浮雕装饰。剧院门厅有大理石台阶通向二层观众厅，二层壁间用科林斯巨柱与拱券组合装饰。观众厅为钟形，上下两层，音响效果绝佳，内部装冷暖空调设备，设施先进，先后获得美国20世纪福克斯、米高梅公司电影的首映权。

1949年改为北京电影院，仍以播放美国影片为主，1959年为举办第一届上海之春音乐会，改为上海音乐厅。2002年为避让上海地铁8号线，向东南方向整体平移了66.46米，并抬高了3.38米。

· · · · ·
English

Shanghai Concert Hall was originally named Nanking Theater, originally located southwest of the intersection of Rue de Montauban (now Longmen Road) and Avenue Edward VII (now the east and middle section of East Yan'an Road).

In 1929 it was built by the Nanyi Film Company on leased land, hiring Chinese architects Fan Wenzhao and Zhao Shen for design, completed in 1930.

The theater adopts the Neoclassical style, 4 stories high, with reinforced concrete structure and wooden roof trusses.

The exterior facade is grey face brick, with the ground floor and parts finished with white brushed stone; above the main entrance are four Ionic giant columns贯穿 two stories, with arched floor-to-ceiling long windows between columns, and giant horizontal relief decoration above the beams and columns.

The theater foyer has a marble staircase leading to the second-floor auditorium; the second-floor walls are decorated with Corinthian giant columns combined with arches.

The auditorium is bell-shaped, with two levels上下, with excellent acoustic effects; the interior is equipped with heating and cooling air conditioning, with advanced facilities, and successively obtained the premiere rights for films from American 20th Century Fox and MGM.

In 1949 it was renamed Beijing Cinema, still mainly showing American films; in 1959, to host the first Shanghai Spring Music Festival, it was renamed Shanghai Concert Hall.

In 2002, to make way for Shanghai Metro Line 8, it was整体 translated 66.46 meters to the southeast and raised by 3.38 meters.

建筑要点 / Key Features
上海音乐厅原名南京大戏院原位于麦高包禄路今龙门路爱多亚路今延安东路东中段路口西南1929年由南怡怡电影公司租地兴建聘请中国建筑师范文照和赵深设计1930建成剧院采用新古典主义风格高4层钢筋混凝土结构木屋架外立面为灰色面砖底层和局部用白色水刷石饰面正面入口上方有四根贯穿两层的爱奥尼式巨柱柱间为拱券落地长窗梁柱上方有巨型横条浮雕装饰剧院门厅有大理石台阶通向二层观众厅二层壁间用科林斯巨柱与拱券组合装饰观众厅为钟形上下两层音响效果绝佳内部装冷暖空调设备设施先进先后获得美国20世纪福克斯米高梅公司电影的首映权1949年改为北京电影院仍以播放美国影片为主1959年为举办第一届上海之春音乐会改为上海音乐厅2002年为避让上海地铁8号线向东南方向整体平移了66.46米并抬高了3.38米
23 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址
Site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China
1921年
级别 Level
第六批全国重点文物保护单位（2006年）
地址 Address
黄浦区兴业路76号
类型 Type
近代建筑/革命旧址
门票 Ticket
免费参观
开放时间 Hours
9:00 — 17:00，16:00停止入馆
中文原文

中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址在卢湾区黄陂南路，是中国共产党的诞生地，现为纪念馆。

会址为两排9栋二层楼高的石库门里弄建筑，坐北朝南，砖木结构，建于1920年夏秋间，左右紧邻的四幢房屋同时建成，保持了20世纪20年代上海石库门民居的风貌。

此处原为法租界望志路106号，是李达的兄长李书城、李汉俊的住宅。其中南面一排5幢房屋沿兴业路（原望志路），会址即在西首两幢。北面一排4幢在黄陂南路（原贝勒路）树德里弄内，均按当年外貌原状修复。1921年7月23日，中国共产党在此举行了第一次全国代表大会。会议进行数日，在7月30日晚举行第六次会议时，法租界巡捕房密探突然闯入，会议被迫中断。

与会代表迅速分头离开，会址不久被包围并受到搜查，因无证据，警告后离开。这次冲击虽然没有带来重大损失，但会议不能再在原址进行，最后一次会议改在浙江嘉兴南湖的一艘游船上召开。会址所在地附近保留有大片石库门建筑群，目前已被改造为上海新天地，成为上海最具知名度的景区之一。

· · · · ·
English

The Site of the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China is on South Huangpi Road in Luwan District, the birthplace of the Communist Party of China, now a memorial hall.

The site consists of two rows of 9 two-story Shikumen lane buildings, facing south, brick-wood structure, built in the summer and autumn of 1920; the four adjacent houses on the left and right were built simultaneously, maintaining the style of Shanghai Shikumen residences in the 1920s.

This place was originally No.106 Wangzhi Road in the French Concession, the residence of Li Shucheng and Li Hanjun, elder brothers of Li Da.

Among them, the south row of 5 houses is along Xingye Road (formerly Wangzhi Road), and the site is the first two houses from the west.

The north row of 4 houses is in the Shudeli alley on South Huangpi Road (formerly Rue Bayle), all restored to their original appearance of that year.

On July 23, 1921, the Communist Party of China held its First National Congress here.

The meeting proceeded for several days; on the evening of July 30, during the sixth session, a detective from the French Concession police suddenly broke in, and the meeting was forced to interrupt.

The participating representatives quickly left separately; the site was soon surrounded and searched, but due to lack of evidence, they left after a warning.

Although this disruption did not cause major losses, the meeting could no longer be held at the original site, and the last session was changed to a pleasure boat on Nanhu Lake in Jiaxing, Zhejiang.

A large area of Shikumen architectural complex is preserved near the site, which has now been transformed into Xintiandi Shanghai, becoming one of the most famous scenic spots in Shanghai.

建筑要点 / Key Features
中国共产党第一次全国代表大会会址在卢湾区黄陂南路是中国共产党的诞生地现为纪念馆会址为两排9栋二层楼高的石库门里弄建筑坐北朝南砖木结构建于1920年夏秋间左右紧邻的四幢房屋同时建成保持了20世纪20年代上海石库门民居的风貌此处原为法租界望志路106号是李达的兄长李书城李汉俊的住宅其中南面一排5幢房屋沿兴业路原望志路会址即在西首两幢北面一排4幢在黄陂南路原贝勒路树德里弄内均按当年外貌原状修复1921年7月23日中国共产党在此举行了第一次全国代表大会会议进行数日在7月30日晚举行第六次会议时法租界巡捕房密探突然闯入会议被迫中断与会代表迅速分头离开会址不久被包围并受到搜查因无证据警告后离开这次冲击虽然没有带来重大损失但会议不能再在原址进行最后一次会议改在浙江嘉兴南湖的一艘游船上召开会址所在地附近保留有大片石库门建筑群目前已被改造为上海新天地成为上海最具知名度的景区之一
24 马勒住宅
Moller Villa
民国
级别 Level
第六批全国重点文物保护单位（2006年）
地址 Address
静安区陕西南路30号
类型 Type
近代建筑/住宅
中文原文

马勒住宅位于陕西南路，是瑞典籍英国商人马勒一家的住宅。马勒住宅的建造者埃里克·马勒（Eric Moller）的父亲1862年到达上海，创建了赉赐洋行，经营航运业。埃里克·马勒所购住宅地块原为开平矿务局大班的住宅，20世纪20年代马勒购入住宅，并于1927年对住宅实施改造。

改造设计将原大班住宅围入建筑中心，从东南西北四个方向进行加建，完全改变了原有建筑的外形。新扩建而成的马勒住宅名为仙境（Fairy land），外表呈现北欧木制传统建筑特征，屋顶层叠错落，尖塔高耸，宛如童话城堡。建筑高三层，立面采用多层屋檐，檐下排列大小相间的三角山花，山花间露出木架结构，屋顶上竖三个高耸的尖顶塔楼。墙面用耐火砖纵横砌出芦席纹饰面和檐口，并加入多彩的陶瓷装饰，塔顶用鱼鳞瓦或铅皮屋面。

住宅内部装修豪华，马勒家族经营航运生意，住宅装饰多模仿船式样，室内楼梯如船楼梯，楼梯口设有轮船上的圆形舷窗。外有露台，面向花园，园中有适合户外聚会的草坪，边缘有溪流穿过，掩映在有自然风致的树木花丛中，木质栈道沿溪流铺设出小路，路边装饰着具有东方风情的雕像饰品。花园入口处有一匹青铜马铸像，为马勒爱马遗像。马勒住宅在新中国成立后曾归中国共产主义青年团上海市委员会和上海市青年联合会等多家单位使用。

2002年改造为衡山马勒别墅酒店，游人可自由参观。

· · · · ·
English

Moller Villa is located on South Shaanxi Road, the residence of the Moller family, Swedish-British merchants.

The builder of Moller Villa, Eric Moller's father arrived in Shanghai in 1862 and founded the Moller & Co., engaged in the shipping industry.

The residential plot purchased by Eric Moller was originally the residence of the taipan of the Chinese Engineering and Mining Company; in the 1920s Moller purchased the residence and carried out renovation in 1927.

The renovation design enclosed the original taipan residence in the center of the building, with additions from the four directions of east, south, west, and north, completely changing the original appearance of the building.

The newly expanded Moller Villa was named 'Fairy land,' with an exterior presenting the characteristics of traditional Nordic wooden architecture, with layered and staggered roofs and towering spires, like a fairy tale castle.

The building is three stories high, with the facade adopting multi-layered eaves; under the eaves are arranged triangular gables of alternating sizes, with wooden frame structure exposed between gables, and three towering spired towers erected on the roof.

The walls use refractory bricks laid vertically and horizontally to form a reed-mat pattern facing and eaves, with colorful ceramic decorations added; the tower tops use fish-scale tiles or lead roofing.

The interior of the residence is luxuriously decorated; the Moller family was engaged in the shipping business, so the residence decorations mostly imitate ship styles, with the interior staircase like a ship staircase and a round porthole from a ship at the staircase entrance.

Outside there is a terrace facing the garden; in the garden there is a lawn suitable for outdoor gatherings, with a stream passing through the edge, shaded by naturally charming trees and flowers; wooden plank roads pave paths along the stream, with roadside decorations of Eastern-style statues and ornaments.

At the garden entrance there is a bronze horse statue, a portrait of Moller's beloved horse.

After the founding of New China, Moller Villa was once used by multiple units such as the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the Communist Youth League of China and the Shanghai Youth Federation.

In 2002 it was converted into the Hengshan Moller Villa Hotel, which visitors can freely visit.

建筑要点 / Key Features
马勒住宅位于陕西南路是瑞典籍英国商人马勒一家的住宅马勒住宅的建造者埃里克马勒Eric Moller的父亲1862年到达上海创建了赉赐洋行经营航运业埃里克马勒所购住宅地块原为开平矿务局大班的住宅20世纪20年代马勒购入住宅并于1927年对住宅实施改造改造设计将原大班住宅围入建筑中心从东南西北四个方向进行加建完全改变了原有建筑的外形新扩建而成的马勒住宅名为仙境Fairy land外表呈现北欧木制传统建筑特征屋顶层叠错落尖塔高耸宛如童话城堡建筑高三层立面采用多层屋檐檐下排列大小相间的三角山花山花间露出木架结构屋顶上竖三个高耸的尖顶塔楼墙面用耐火砖纵横砌出芦席纹饰面和檐口并加入多彩的陶瓷装饰塔顶用鱼鳞瓦或铅皮屋面住宅内部装修豪华马勒家族经营航运生意住宅装饰多模仿船式样室内楼梯如船楼梯楼梯口设有轮船上的圆形舷窗外有露台面向花园园中有适合户外聚会的草坪边缘有溪流穿过掩映在有自然风致的树木花丛中木质栈道沿溪流铺设出小路路边装饰着具有东方风情的雕像饰品花园入口处有一匹青铜马铸像为马勒爱马遗像马勒住宅在新中国成立后曾归中国共产主义青年团上海市委员会和上海市青年联合会等多家单位使用2002年改造为衡山马勒
25 上海宋庆龄故居
Former Residence of Soong Chingling in Shanghai
1948—1981
级别 Level
第五批全国重点文物保护单位（2001年）
地址 Address
徐汇区淮海中路1843号
类型 Type
近代建筑/故居
门票 Ticket
20元
开放时间 Hours
9:00 — 16:30
中文原文

宋庆龄故居在淮海中路，原为希腊船商的住宅，自1948年起宋庆龄长期在此居住生活。故居小院内有汽车库和喂养鸽子的鸽舍，主楼在院落中央，白墙红瓦，两层砖木结构，西洋风格。入门底层为过厅、客厅、餐厅和书房，二楼为卧室、办公室和陪护卧室。

楼内布置均保持宋庆龄在此居住时的原状，家具与饰品也为原物。屋里房间均设有壁炉，因此屋顶两侧突出两个烟囱，南向屋面开三个圆形老虎窗。二层南侧有宽敞的阳台，同时成为下层门廊，南向面对宽阔的长方形草坪。草坪面积有2200多平方米，四周围绕20多棵有百年树龄的香樟树。

院落西侧有砖木结构的两层小楼，现开辟为文物馆，展览与宋庆龄相关的照片与文物，院落中设有宋庆龄汉白玉坐像。

· · · · ·
English

Soong Chingling's Former Residence is on Middle Huaihai Road, originally the residence of a Greek ship merchant; since 1948 Soong Chingling lived here for a long time.

In the small courtyard of the former residence there is a garage and a pigeon loft for feeding pigeons; the main building is in the center of the courtyard, with white walls and red tiles, a two-story brick-wood structure in Western style.

Entering the gate, the ground floor is the foyer, living room, dining room, and study; the second floor is the bedroom, office, and accompanying bedroom.

The layout inside the building maintains the original state when Soong Chingling lived here, and the furniture and ornaments are also original.

The rooms in the house are all equipped with fireplaces, so two chimneys protrude from both sides of the roof, and three round dormer windows open on the south-facing roof.

The south side of the second floor has a spacious balcony, which also serves as the porch of the lower floor, facing a broad rectangular lawn to the south.

The lawn has an area of over 2,200 square meters, surrounded by more than 20 camphor trees over a hundred years old.

On the west side of the courtyard there is a two-story brick-wood small building, now opened as a cultural relic museum exhibiting photos and cultural relics related to Soong Chingling; in the courtyard there is a white marble seated statue of Soong Chingling.

建筑要点 / Key Features
宋庆龄故居在淮海中路原为希腊船商的住宅自1948年起宋庆龄长期在此居住生活故居小院内有汽车库和喂养鸽子的鸽舍主楼在院落中央白墙红瓦两层砖木结构西洋风格入门底层为过厅客厅餐厅和书房二楼为卧室办公室和陪护卧室楼内布置均保持宋庆龄在此居住时的原状家具与饰品也为原物屋里房间均设有壁炉因此屋顶两侧突出两个烟囱南向屋面开三个圆形老虎窗二层南侧有宽敞的阳台同时成为下层门廊南向面对宽阔的长方形草坪草坪面积有2200多平方米四周围绕20多棵有百年树龄的香樟树院落西侧有砖木结构的两层小楼现开辟为文物馆展览与宋庆龄相关的照片与文物院落中设有宋庆龄汉白玉坐像
26 南洋公学（上海交通大学徐汇校区）
Nanyang Public School (Xuhui Campus of Shanghai Jiao Tong University)
1896年起
级别 Level
上海市优秀历史建筑
地址 Address
徐汇区华山路1954号
类型 Type
近代建筑/学校
中文原文

南洋公学（上海交通大学徐汇校区）今为上海市优秀历史建筑。清光绪二十二年（1896年）盛宣怀在上海徐家创办南洋公学，崇尚中学为体，西学为用。早期学校借用民房上课，开设师范院，同时在静安寺以西选择校址，开始建设。

在校园基地周围开凿护城河，将主体育场布置于基地中央，在北侧建设主要教学楼，即中院和上院，在东侧建造教职员宿舍和校长住宅，学生宿舍设在教学楼顶层，南侧规划为小学部。早期建筑的图纸由学校监院美国人福开森亲自绘制。辛亥革命后学校改称南洋大学，隶属交通部，又改为交通部上海工业专门学校。

1921年12月，交通部所属四所学校合并为交通大学，属国立性质。随着校址不断扩大，建筑逐渐增多，1926年已建成校舍30栋，主要包括上院、中院和南院，还建成了图书馆、体育馆等，另有实验室、工厂、学生宿舍和教职工宿舍数十栋。

20世纪30年代运动场改建为花园，各类建筑均有增建。抗战时期学校未能及时内迁，日军占领上海后师生迁至法租界上课，校舍被日本同文书院侵占，抗战胜利后学校迁回原址。

目前徐汇校区尚存有13栋1949年以前建造的建筑，最精华的部分集中在中央草坪周围，主要有中院（1898年建）、老图书馆（1919年建）、体育馆（1925年建）、总办公厅（1933年建）、校门（1935年建）、工程馆（1931年建）和新上院（1953年建）等。

中院在中央草坪北，是校内最早的建筑，建成于1899年，由监院福开森亲自设计并督造，为三层西洋外廊式建筑，青砖清水砖墙，红砖装饰。三楼中央阳台外侧墙面上镶嵌石板，镌刻着南洋公学中院六字。它集教学、办公、食宿于一体，一楼设有食堂和三个化学实验室。二楼全部为教室，三楼作为教师、学生宿舍。

老图书馆在草坪东，始建于1917年，由留美毕业生、土木工程学院教师胡士熙监工。1919年落成，1920年3月正式开馆。楼为哥特式风格，三层钢筋混凝土结构，外表用红色面砖，装饰和线脚繁多，入口处采用六根白色复合柱式。

馆内设有杂志阅览室一间、普通阅览室两间、研究室一间（专供指定参考书及三四年级学生图书之用）、自修室两间和陈列室一间。体育馆在草坪以西，总办公厅以南，建成于1925年，钢筋水泥结构，建筑面积2957平方米。馆内共三层，底层有小型游泳池、台球房、浴室和卫生设备。中层有健身房、室内篮球场，南面有小型舞台，可供演出及集会用。

三层为室内跑道，亦可作观赏球赛的看台。总办公厅（容闳堂）在草坪西侧，体育馆以北，始建于1932年，由庄俊设计。钢骨水泥结构，高三层，有大小62间房，仿西方古典主义风格，底层处理为基座，二层、三层开通高两层的圆拱窗。此处一直是学校的行政中枢，历届校领导均在此办公。如今的容闳堂是学校党委、校部机关的办公地点，校长办公室设在二楼。

校门在校园的东南方位，和中院一起始建于1898年，为中国牌坊式木质建筑。正门前本有河浜，河上建有木桥，名校门桥。1926年30周年校庆之际，同学捐资建造了一座钢筋水泥桥取代木桥。

1934年，校友捐资重造校门，为明清宫殿式样，三开间，绿琉璃歇山顶，门口右方挂着白底黑字的交通大学校名铭牌。

工程馆在新上院以北，建成于1931年，由邬达克设计，现代装饰艺术风格。工程馆为钢筋混凝土结构，二层楼，平面呈口字形，外墙饰以钢钎状的装饰肋，采取竖线条划分，富有动感。

底层设锅炉房、机械、水力、金工、材料、电气和标本等各种试验室，上层设教室、绘图室、演讲厅、仪器室、模型室和教授休息室等，堪称当时上海最现代化的实验室和工程教学楼。新上院正南面对大草地，东与中院相邻。其基址为1900年建的老上院。老上院由监院美国人福开森设计，为英伦文艺复兴风格的建筑，三层砖木楼房，上有钟楼。

1953年老上院因失修被拆除，由上海市建工局设计室设计新上院，变成四层楼房，现代装饰艺术风格，钢筋混凝土结构。前面一、二层为实验室，三层四层为教室，后部有五间阶梯大教室和一间大型活动室。

· · · · ·
English

Nanyang Public School (Xuhui Campus of Shanghai Jiao Tong University) is now a Shanghai Excellent Historical Building.

In the 22nd year of Guangxu of the Qing (1896), Sheng Xuanhuai founded Nanyang Public School in Xujiahui, Shanghai, advocating 'Chinese learning as the foundation, Western learning for practical use.

' In the early days, the school borrowed private houses for classes and opened a normal school; at the same time, a site was selected west of Jing'an Temple to begin construction.

A moat was dug around the campus base, the main stadium was placed in the center of the base, main teaching buildings (the Middle Court and Upper Court) were built on the north side, faculty dormitories and the president's residence on the east side, student dormitories on the top floor of the teaching building, and the south side was planned as the primary school department.

The drawings of the early buildings were personally drawn by the school's supervisor, the American John Calvin Ferguson.

After the Xinhai Revolution, the school was renamed Nanyang University, under the Ministry of Communications, then renamed the Shanghai Industrial Specialized School of the Ministry of Communications.

In December 1921, four schools under the Ministry of Communications merged into Chiao Tung University, of national nature.

As the campus continued to expand, buildings gradually increased; by 1926, 30 school buildings had been completed, mainly including the Upper Court, Middle Court, and South Court, as well as a library and gymnasium, plus dozens of laboratories, factories, student dormitories, and faculty dormitories.

In the 1930s the sports field was converted into a garden, with various buildings added.

During the War of Resistance, the school failed to relocate inland in time; after the Japanese army occupied Shanghai, teachers and students moved to the French Concession for classes, and the school buildings were occupied by the Japanese Tung Wen College; after the victory of the War of Resistance, the school moved back to the original site.

Currently, the Xuhui Campus still has 13 buildings built before 1949, with the most essential part concentrated around the central lawn, mainly including the Middle Court (built 1898), Old Library (built 1919), Gymnasium (built 1925), General Office (built 1933), School Gate (built 1935), Engineering Building (built 1931), and New Upper Court (built 1953) etc.

The Middle Court, north of the central lawn, is the earliest building on campus, completed in 1899, personally designed and supervised by Supervisor Ferguson, a three-story Western veranda-style building with plain grey brick walls and red brick decoration.

On the outer wall of the central balcony on the third floor, a stone slab is inlaid, engraved with the six characters 'Nanyang Public School Middle Court.

' It integrates teaching, office, board, and lodging; the first floor has a cafeteria and three chemistry laboratories.

The second floor is entirely classrooms, and the third floor serves as teacher and student dormitories.

The Old Library, east of the lawn, was first built in 1917, supervised by Hu Shixi, a returned American graduate and teacher at the School of Civil Engineering.

Completed in 1919, it officially opened in March 1920.

The building is in Gothic style, three-story reinforced concrete structure, with red face bricks on the exterior, numerous decorations and moldings, and six white composite columns at the entrance.

The library has one magazine reading room, two general reading rooms, one research room (for designated reference books and books for third and fourth-year students), two study rooms, and one exhibition room.

The Gymnasium, west of the lawn and south of the General Office, was completed in 1925, reinforced concrete structure, with a building area of 2,957 square meters.

The gymnasium has three floors; the ground floor has a small swimming pool, billiard room, bathroom, and sanitary facilities.

The middle floor has a gymnasium and indoor basketball court, with a small stage on the south side for performances and gatherings.

The third floor is an indoor running track, which can also serve as a stand for watching ball games.

The General Office (Yung Wing Hall), west of the lawn and north of the gymnasium, was first built in 1932, designed by Zhuang Jun.

Steel-reinforced concrete structure, three stories high, with 62 rooms of various sizes, imitating Western classical style, with the ground floor treated as a base, and the second and third floors opening to two-story-high arched windows.

This place has always been the administrative center of the school, with successive school leaders working here.

Today Yung Wing Hall is the office location of the school Party Committee and school authorities, with the president's office on the second floor.

The School Gate, in the southeast of the campus, was first built together with the Middle Court in 1898, a Chinese paifang-style wooden building.

Originally there was a river in front of the main gate, with a wooden bridge built over it, called the School Gate Bridge.

On the occasion of the 30th anniversary in 1926, students donated to build a reinforced concrete bridge to replace the wooden bridge.

In 1934, alumni donated to rebuild the school gate in Ming-Qing palace style, three bays, with green glazed hip-and-gable roof, and a white-background black-character nameplate of 'Chiao Tung University' hanging on the right side of the gate.

The Engineering Building, north of the New Upper Court, was completed in 1931, designed by Hudec, in modern Art Deco style.

The Engineering Building is a reinforced concrete structure, two stories, with a square-shaped plan, exterior walls decorated with steel-pin-like decorative ribs, adopting vertical line division, full of dynamism.

The ground floor has various laboratories such as boiler room, machinery, hydraulics, metalworking, materials, electrical, and specimens; the upper floor has classrooms, drawing rooms, lecture halls, instrument rooms, model rooms, and faculty lounges etc.

, arguably the most modern laboratory and engineering teaching building in Shanghai at that time.

The New Upper Court faces the large lawn directly south and is adjacent to the Middle Court to the east.Its site was the Old Upper Court built in 1900.

The Old Upper Court was designed by Supervisor Ferguson, an English Renaissance-style building, a three-story brick-wood building with a clock tower on top.

In 1953 the Old Upper Court was demolished due to disrepair; the New Upper Court was designed by the Design Office of the Shanghai Construction Engineering Bureau, becoming a four-story building in modern Art Deco style, reinforced concrete structure.

The front first and second floors are laboratories, the third and fourth floors are classrooms, and the rear has five large lecture halls and one large activity room.

建筑要点 / Key Features
南洋公学今为上海市优秀历史建筑清光绪二十二年1896年盛宣怀在上海徐家创办南洋公学崇尚中学为体西学为用早期学校借用民房上课开设师范院同时在静安寺以西选择校址开始建设在校园基地周围开凿护城河将主体育场布置于基地中央在北侧建设主要教学楼即中院和上院在东侧建造教职员宿舍和校长住宅学生宿舍设在教学楼顶层南侧规划为小学部早期建筑的图纸由学校监院美国人福开森亲自绘制辛亥革命后学校改称南洋大学隶属交通部又改为交通部上海工业专门学校1921年12月交通部所属四所学校合并为交通大学属国立性质随着校址不断扩大建筑逐渐增多1926年已建成校舍30栋主要包括上院中院和南院还建成了图书馆体育馆等另有实验室工厂学生宿舍和教职工宿舍数十栋20世纪30年代运动场改建为花园各类建筑均有增建抗战时期学校未能及时内迁日军占领上海后师生迁至法租界上课校舍被日本同文书院侵占抗战胜利后学校迁回原址目前徐汇校区尚存有13栋1949年以前建造的建筑最精华的部分集中在中央草坪周围主要有中院1898年建老图书馆1919年建体育馆1925年建总办公厅1933年建校门1935年建工程馆1931年建新上院1953年建等中院在中央草坪北是校内最
27 徐家汇天主教堂
Xujiahui Catholic Church
1910年
级别 Level
第七批全国重点文物保护单位（2013年）
地址 Address
徐汇区蒲西路158号
类型 Type
近代建筑/教堂
中文原文

徐家汇天主教堂在徐家汇蒲西路。原为徐光启的农庄别墅。

清道光二十年（1840年）法国耶稣会士在此传教，清咸丰元年（1851年）建成新堂，由西班牙籍修士弗兰克（Ferrer Jean）设计，希腊式风格，能容400人，称圣依纳爵堂，奉耶稣会创始人圣依纳爵为主保，俗称徐家汇天主堂。

后又陆续建造大小修道院、圣母院、育婴堂、徐汇公学和藏书楼等，上海教区也设于此。清光绪三十二年（1906年）在旧堂东部新建大堂，宣统二年（1910年）建成，由英国建筑师道达尔（Mr. Dodwall）设计，法商上海建筑公司（Shanghai Building Company）承建。

新建教堂成为上海市区最大的天主堂，为砖木结构，用红砖砌筑，青石勒脚，法国哥特式风格，大门朝东，尖券向内叠涩，两侧有高57米的钟塔尖顶，中央为玫瑰花窗。

堂内为拉丁十字平面，中厅高三层，两侧高两层，有64根金山石雕凿的束柱，地坪铺方砖，中央道路铺花瓷砖，两侧安装有图案神像的彩绘玻璃窗，侧廊外侧为一排小祈祷室，两翼端部也设有玫瑰窗。后部为八字布局，中央为主祭坛，有侧廊延伸的回廊，大祭坛为1919年复活节从巴黎运来。1960年在教堂内举行了祝圣主教大典，定为主教座堂。

文革期间教堂受到破坏，钟楼尖顶被拆毁，彩色玻璃被砸碎，成为上海果品杂货公司仓库。1982年修复，1994年修复教堂前广场，现在仍是中国教堂中最华丽的一座。

· · · · ·
English

Xujiahui Catholic Church is on Puxi Road in Xujiahui.It was originally Xu Guangqi's farm villa.

In the 20th year of Daoguang of the Qing (1840), French Jesuits preached here; in the 1st year of Xianfeng (1851) a new church was completed, designed by Spanish friar Ferrer Jean, in Greek style, capable of accommodating 400 people, called St.

Ignatius Church, with St.Ignatius, founder of the Jesuits, as patron saint, commonly known as Xujiahui Catholic Church.

Later, major and minor seminaries, the Convent of Our Lady, the foundling hospital, Xuhui Public School, and the library building etc.

were successively built, and the Shanghai Diocese was also established here.

In the 32nd year of Guangxu (1906), a new great church was built east of the old church, completed in the 2nd year of Xuantong (1910), designed by British architect Mr.

Dodwall, constructed by the French firm Shanghai Building Company.

The newly built church became the largest Catholic church in urban Shanghai, of brick-wood structure, built with red bricks, with bluestone plinth, in French Gothic style; the main gate faces east, with pointed arches corbeled inward, and 57-meter-high bell tower spires on both sides, with a rose window in the center.

Inside the church is a Latin cross plan; the nave is three stories high, the sides two stories high, with 64 bundled columns carved from Jinshan stone; the floor is paved with square bricks, the central path with patterned tiles; both sides are installed with stained glass windows with patterned deities; the outside of the side aisles is a row of small chapels; the ends of both wings also have rose windows.

The rear is in a splayed layout, with the main altar in the center and a cloister extending from the side aisles; the great altar was brought from Paris on Easter 1919.

In 1960, the episcopal consecration ceremony was held in the church, and it was designated as the cathedral.

During the Cultural Revolution, the church was damaged, the bell tower spires were demolished, the stained glass was smashed, and it became a warehouse of the Shanghai Fruit and Grocery Company.

It was restored in 1982, and the square in front of the church was restored in 1994; it remains the most magnificent church in China today.

建筑要点 / Key Features
徐家汇天主教堂在徐家汇蒲西路原为徐光启的农庄别墅清道光二十年1840年法国耶稣会士在此传教清咸丰元年1851年建成新堂由西班牙籍修士弗兰克Ferrer Jean设计希腊式风格能容400人称圣依纳爵堂奉耶稣会创始人圣依纳爵为主保俗称徐家汇天主堂后又陆续建造大小修道院圣母院育婴堂徐汇公学和藏书楼等上海教区也设于此清光绪三十二年1906年在旧堂东部新建大堂宣统二年1910年建成由英国建筑师道达尔Mr Dodwall设计法商上海建筑公司Shanghai Building Company承建新建教堂成为上海市区最大的天主堂为砖木结构用红砖砌筑青石勒脚法国哥特式风格大门朝东尖券向内叠涩两侧有高57米的钟塔尖顶中央为玫瑰花窗堂内为拉丁十字平面中厅高三层两侧高两层有64根金山石雕凿的束柱地坪铺方砖中央道路铺花瓷砖两侧安装有图案神像的彩绘玻璃窗侧廊外侧为一排小祈祷室两翼端部也设有玫瑰窗后部为八字布局中央为主祭坛有侧廊延伸的回廊大祭坛为1919年复活节从巴黎运来1960年在教堂内举行了祝圣主教大典定为主教座堂文革期间教堂受到破坏钟楼尖顶被拆毁彩色玻璃被砸碎成为上海果品杂货公司仓库1982年修复1994年修
28 龙华塔
Longhua Pagoda
宋
级别 Level
第六批全国重点文物保护单位（2006年）
地址 Address
徐汇区龙华路2853号
类型 Type
古建筑/塔
中文原文

龙华塔在龙华寺门前，上海西南郊徐汇区的黄浦江西岸。

相传塔为三国时孙权所造，唐乾符二年（875年）毁于黄巢兵乱，今塔建于北宋太平兴国二年（977年），此后历代均有修缮，1953年和1982年重修恢复宋塔旧貌。

修缮时在檐角发现宋式木檐，砖拱上留有宋代绘制的花纹，塔脚下还发现宋代瓦当。

1984年大修，更换了塔顶铁刹，拆除重建顶端两层，修补更换了顶部10米左右的塔心柱，并对六层以下塔身进行修葺，1985年竣工，不再开放登临，仅可瞻仰外观。塔为八角七层，总高40.64米，砖木楼阁式，内为方室。底层较高，以上各层面积与高度层层递减。

每层四面开壶门，各层相闪。方室裙板下壁隐出砖刻斗拱，均为宋式。各层有楼板、扶梯，底层外加围廊，以上各层出腰檐，檐下悬铜铃。

各层叠涩出平座，承带围栏的外廊，栏杆亦为宋式。塔心木立在第六层的横木上，高18米，上有8米高的铁质塔刹。

龙华寺在龙华塔北部，1977年列为上海市保，门票10元，开放时间7:00—16:30（农历初一、十五为5:00—16:30）。

龙华寺据传与龙华塔同时创建，也有记载称建于唐武则天垂拱三年（687年），初名龙华教寺，唐末毁于兵燹，北宋太平兴国二年（977年）重建。

北宋治平三年（1066年）改名空相寺，后来多次重建，明嘉靖三十二年（1553年）敕赐万寿慈华禅寺，嘉靖四十一年（1562年）重建大殿，恢复龙华教寺旧称，清咸丰十年（1860年）毁于太平天国兵燹，光绪年间重建，现存建筑多为晚清建筑。

龙华寺遵循伽蓝七堂形制，有新老两座山门，老山门在寺庙东南，原为龙华镇入口，毁于日军轰炸，现仅存一对门柱和一双石狮。门柱建于明正德十一年（1516年），石狮也是明代原物。

新山门为五开间三重檐大牌楼。门内为弥勒殿，佛教传说弥勒在龙华树下成佛，因称龙华寺。弥勒殿后为天王殿，左右有钟鼓楼，龙华晚钟曾为沪城八景之一。

天王殿北为大雄宝殿，重檐歇山顶，殿后为三圣殿、方丈室和藏经楼。

· · · · ·
English

Longhua Pagoda is in front of the gate of Longhua Temple, on the west bank of the Huangpu River in Xuhui District, the southwestern suburb of Shanghai.

According to legend, the pagoda was built by Sun Quan during the Three Kingdoms period; it was destroyed by Huang Chao's military turmoil in the 2nd year of Qianfu of the Tang (875); the present pagoda was built in the 2nd year of Taiping Xingguo of the Northern Song (977), and has been repaired in successive dynasties thereafter; it was renovated in 1953 and 1982 to restore the old appearance of the Song pagoda.

During the renovation, Song-style wooden eaves were found at the eave corners, with Song-dynasty painted patterns on the brick arches, and Song-dynasty tile ends were also found at the foot of the pagoda.

A major repair was carried out in 1984: the iron finial at the top of the pagoda was replaced, the top two floors were demolished and rebuilt, the central pillar of about 10 meters at the top was repaired and replaced, and the pagoda body below the sixth floor was renovated; completed in 1985, it is no longer open for climbing, only for viewing the exterior.

The pagoda is octagonal with seven stories, with a total height of 40.64 meters, of brick-wood pavilion style, with a square chamber inside.

The ground floor is higher, and the area and height of each upper story decrease layer by layer.Each story has pot doors on four sides, alternating between stories.

Under the skirt panels of the square chamber, brick-carved bracket sets are recessed into the wall, all in Song style.

Each story has floor slabs and stairs; the ground floor has an additional surrounding corridor, and each upper story has projecting eaves with copper bells hanging under the eaves.

Each story has corbeled out flat seats supporting an outer corridor with railings; the railings are also in Song style.

The central wooden pillar stands on the crossbeam of the sixth story, 18 meters high, with an 8-meter-high iron finial on top.

Longhua Temple is north of Longhua Pagoda, listed as a Shanghai municipal heritage site in 1977, with an admission fee of 10 yuan, open from 7:00 to 16:30 (5:00 to 16:30 on the first and fifteenth days of the lunar month).

According to legend, Longhua Temple was founded at the same time as Longhua Pagoda; there are also records saying it was built in the 3rd year of Chuigong of Empress Wu Zetian of the Tang (687), originally named Longhua Teaching Temple; it was destroyed by war at the end of the Tang, and rebuilt in the 2nd year of Taiping Xingguo of the Northern Song (977).

In the 3rd year of Zhiping of the Northern Song (1066) it was renamed Kongxiang Temple; later rebuilt multiple times; in the 32nd year of Jiajing of the Ming (1553) it was imperially granted the name Wanshou Cihua Chan Temple; in the 41st year of Jiajing (1562) the main hall was rebuilt, restoring the old name of Longhua Teaching Temple; in the 10th year of Xianfeng of the Qing (1860) it was destroyed by the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom war, and rebuilt during the Guangxu reign; the existing buildings are mostly late Qing architecture.

Longhua Temple follows the 'seven halls of the sangharama' layout, with two new and old mountain gates; the old mountain gate is southeast of the temple, originally the entrance of Longhua Town, destroyed by Japanese bombing, now only a pair of gate pillars and a pair of stone lions remain.

The gate pillars were built in the 11th year of Zhengde of the Ming (1516), and the stone lions are also original Ming objects.

The new mountain gate is a five-bay three-eave grand paifang.

Inside the gate is the Maitreya Hall; according to Buddhist legend, Maitreya attained Buddhahood under the Longhua tree, hence the name Longhua Temple.

Behind the Maitreya Hall is the Hall of Heavenly Kings, with bell and drum towers on the left and right; 'Longhua Evening Bell' was once one of the Eight Scenes of Shanghai City.

North of the Hall of Heavenly Kings is the Mahavira Hall, with double-eave hip-and-gable roof; behind the hall are the Hall of Three Sages, the abbot's quarters, and the scripture library.
