龙华塔在龙华寺门前上海西南郊徐汇区的黄浦江西岸相传塔为三国时孙权所造唐乾符二年875年毁于黄巢兵乱今塔建于北宋太平兴国二年977年此后历代均有修缮1953年和1982年重修恢复宋塔旧貌修缮时在檐角发现宋式木檐砖拱上留有宋代绘制的花纹塔脚下还发现宋代瓦当1984年大修更换了塔顶铁刹拆除重建顶端两层修补更换了顶部10米左右的塔心柱并对六层以下塔身进行修葺1985年竣工不再开放登临仅可瞻仰外观塔为八角七层总高40.64米砖木楼阁式内为方室底层较高以上各层面积与高度层层递减每层四面开壶门各层相闪方室裙板下壁隐出砖刻斗拱均为宋式各层有楼板扶梯底层外加围廊以上各层出腰檐檐下悬铜铃各层叠涩出平座承带围栏的外廊栏杆亦为宋式塔心木立在第六层的横木上高18米上有8米高的铁质塔刹龙华寺在龙华塔北部1977年列为上海市保门票10元开放时间7001630农历初一十五为5001630龙华寺据传与龙华塔同时创建也有记载称建于唐武则天垂拱三年687年初名龙华教寺唐末毁于兵燹北宋太平兴国二年977年重建北宋治平三年1066年改名空相寺后来多次重建明嘉靖三十二年1553年敕赐万寿慈华禅寺嘉靖四十一年1562年重建大殿恢复
29 圣约翰大学旧址（华东政法大学）
Site of Saint John's University (East China University of Political Science and Law)
1879年起
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（2014年）
地址 Address
长宁区苏州河湾南侧万航渡路1575号
类型 Type
近代建筑/学校
中文原文

圣约翰大学西、北、东三面环水，创建于清光绪五年（1879年），前身是圣约翰书院，由美国圣公会上海主教施约瑟将虹口雅培书院和度恩书院合并而成。当时以两书院房产为抵押，在梵王渡购地建造校园。

1890年开设大学课程，1905年正式改名圣约翰大学，1906年依美国哥伦比亚大学模式成立文、理、医、神四学院，后添设工学院和研究院。圣约翰大学在美国华盛顿注册，毕业生可直接升入美国大学研究生院。

后来学校购入苏州河对岸地产，两校区通过校园桥相连，到1936年抗战前，学校已扩至300亩，建有13座教学楼，32座宿舍和教师住宅，另有礼拜堂、实验室、图书馆等，建筑皆为中西合璧式样，西式屋身加中式屋顶。

抗战期间师生迁入公共租界，与沪江大学、东吴大学、之江大学四校组成上海联合基督教大学，1940年迁回原址，1947年才向中国政府注册。1950年正式宣布脱离美国圣公会，1952年院系调整时被拆分并入华东师范大学、复旦大学、同济大学等高校。校园归华东政法大学使用。

怀施堂（现韬奋楼）：其基址原为1879年建校时所建四合院，1894年用原隅石奠基，以示新旧继续不绝之意，为纪念学校创始人施约瑟取此名，是学校早期最大的综合楼，1895年建成。建筑坐北向南，为两层砖木结构，内外皆有外廊，青砖砌筑，红砖装饰线脚。

南部正中有3层高的钟楼，内设美国马萨诸塞州波士顿铸造的大钟。该楼的建筑图纸皆在美国绘就，保存着中国四合院式的建筑特点，屋顶铺中国蝴蝶瓦，原设计翼角皆为曲线，1959年大修时改为直线，仅檐角起翘。

钟楼上原为重檐孟顶，现改为单檐庑殿顶，山面朝前。原楼下层为课堂、食堂和图书馆，上层为学生宿舍，现为教学楼。新中国成立后为纪念1921年毕业生邹韬奋，改称韬奋楼，又称41号楼。

格致楼：在怀施堂东，建楼时曾称格致室，后改称旧科学楼、办公楼、42号楼。原址为1879年建院时所购住宅，供施约瑟办公与居住，1898年拆旧建新，由英商通和洋行设计，1899年建成，三层砖木结构，西侧墙面与怀施堂相仿，东南角为凸出的半圆形城堡塔楼，底层有拱券外廊。

曾为华东政法学院办公楼，后改为学生宿舍。

· · · · ·
English

Saint John's University is surrounded by water on the west, north, and east sides, founded in the 5th year of Guangxu of the Qing (1879), its predecessor being St.

John's College, formed by the merger of the Episcopal Academy and Du'en Academy in Hongkou by Bishop Schereschewsky of the American Episcopal Church in Shanghai.

At that time, using the properties of the two academies as collateral, land was purchased at Fanwangdu to build the campus.

University courses were offered in 1890; in 1905 it was officially renamed Saint John's University; in 1906, following the model of Columbia University in the United States, four colleges of Arts, Science, Medicine, and Theology were established, later adding the College of Engineering and the Graduate School.

Saint John's University was registered in Washington, USA, and graduates could directly enter graduate schools of American universities.

Later the school purchased property on the opposite bank of Suzhou Creek, and the two campuses were connected by a campus bridge; by 1936, before the War of Resistance, the school had expanded to 300 mu, with 13 teaching buildings, 32 dormitories and faculty residences, plus chapels, laboratories, libraries etc.

, all buildings in a Chinese-Western combined style, with Western-style building bodies and Chinese-style roofs.

During the War of Resistance, teachers and students moved into the International Settlement, forming the Shanghai Associated Christian University with three other schools: University of Shanghai, Soochow University, and Hangchow University; they moved back to the original site in 1940, and only registered with the Chinese government in 1947.

In 1950 it formally announced its separation from the American Episcopal Church; in the 1952 departmental reorganization it was split and merged into East China Normal University, Fudan University, Tongji University and other universities.

The campus was assigned to East China University of Political Science and Law.

Huishi Hall (now Taofen Building): its site was originally a siheyuan built when the school was founded in 1879; in 1894 the original cornerstones were used for the foundation, to symbolize the continuity of old and new; named in memory of the school's founder Schereschewsky, it was the largest comprehensive building in the early days of the school, completed in 1895.

The building faces south, a two-story brick-wood structure, with verandas both inside and outside, built with grey bricks and red brick decorative moldings.

In the center of the south is a 3-story high clock tower, containing a large clock cast in Boston, Massachusetts, USA.

The architectural drawings of this building were all drawn in the United States, preserving the architectural characteristics of a Chinese siheyuan; the roof is laid with Chinese butterfly tiles; the original design had curved wing corners, which were changed to straight lines during a major repair in 1959, with only the eave corners upturned.

The clock tower originally had a double-eave Mongolian-style roof, now changed to a single-eave hip roof with the gable facing forward.

Originally the lower floor of the building was classrooms, cafeteria, and library, and the upper floor was student dormitories; now it is a teaching building.

After the founding of New China, in memory of 1921 graduate Zou Taofen, it was renamed Taofen Building, also known as Building 41.

Gezhi Building: east of Huishi Hall; when built it was called Gezhi Room, later renamed Old Science Building, Office Building, Building 42.

Its original site was a residence purchased when the college was founded in 1879, for Schereschewsky's office and residence; in 1898 the old building was demolished to build a new one, designed by the British firm Atkinson & Dallas, completed in 1899, a three-story brick-wood structure; the west wall is similar to Huishi Hall; the southeast corner is a protruding semicircular castle tower; the ground floor has arched verandas.

It was once the office building of East China University of Political Science and Law, later converted into student dormitories.

建筑要点 / Key Features
圣约翰大学西北东三面环水创建于清光绪五年1879年前身是圣约翰书院由美国圣公会上海主教施约瑟将虹口雅培书院和度恩书院合并而成当时以两书院房产为抵押在梵王渡购地建造校园1890年开设大学课程1905年正式改名圣约翰大学1906年依美国哥伦比亚大学模式成立文理医神四学院后添设工学院和研究院圣约翰大学在美国华盛顿注册毕业生可直接升入美国大学研究生院后来学校购入苏州河对岸地产两校区通过校园桥相连到1936年抗战前学校已扩至300亩建有13座教学楼32座宿舍和教师住宅另有礼拜堂实验室图书馆等建筑皆为中西合璧式样西式屋身加中式屋顶抗战期间师生迁入公共租界与沪江大学东吴大学之江大学四校组成上海联合基督教大学1940年迁回原址1947年才向中国政府注册1950年正式宣布脱离美国圣公会1952年院系调整时被拆分并入华东师范大学复旦大学同济大学等高校校园归华东政法大学使用怀施堂现韬奋楼其基址原为1879年建校时所建四合院1894年用原隅石奠基以示新旧继续不绝之意为纪念学校创始人施约瑟取此名是学校早期最大的综合楼1895年建成建筑坐北向南为两层砖木结构内外皆有外廊青砖砌筑红砖装饰线脚南部正中有3层高的钟楼内
30 真如寺大殿
Main Hall of Zhenru Temple
元
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
普陀区兰溪路399号
类型 Type
古建筑/寺庙大殿
中文原文

真如寺在普陀区真如镇北段，原名万寿寺，俗称大寺。南宋嘉定年间改院为寺，元延祐七年（1320年）搬迁于此，成为一方巨刹，附近市集称真如镇。

元至顺三年（1332年）建韦驮殿（金刚殿），明洪武年间（1368—1398）重修，清代又有增建，规模宏大，曾有正殿、大悲阁、文昌阁、十王殿、观音殿、山门牌坊等。

太平天国时期寺庙被毁，仅余正殿、东西配殿和近代重建的天王殿。近年复建了佛塔等建筑。

正殿始建于元延祐七年（1320年），单檐歇山顶，面阔、进深均为三间，平面呈正方形，是宋元以来小型佛堂常用的形式。

现殿内保存着大量元代构件。1963年进行落架重修，在木构件榫卯隐蔽处发现记有构件名称、砍制手法的墨字，经考证为初建时工匠所写。名称大部分与《营造法式》相符，而与《清营造则例》不符，但也有介于两者之间者，可见其过渡性。

真如寺大殿前槽空间颇为宽敞，设有草架，此结构北方少见，多见于江南民居，为江南民居溯源提供例证。

· · · · ·
English

Zhenru Temple is in the northern section of Zhenru Town, Putuo District, originally named Wanshou Temple, commonly called the Great Temple.

During the Jiading reign of the Southern Song, the convent was changed to a temple; in the 7th year of Yanyou of the Yuan (1320) it was moved here, becoming a major temple, and the nearby market town was called Zhenru Town.

In the 3rd year of Zhishun (1332), the Skanda Hall (Vajra Hall) was built; during the Hongwu reign of the Ming (1368-1398) it was renovated; in the Qing there were further additions, with a grand scale, once having a main hall, Dabei (Great Compassion) Pavilion, Wenchang (Literary Prosperity) Pavilion, Ten Kings Hall, Guanyin Hall, mountain gate paifang etc.

During the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom period the temple was destroyed, leaving only the main hall, east and west side halls, and a modernly rebuilt Hall of Heavenly Kings.

In recent years, buildings such as a pagoda have been restored.

The main hall was first built in the 7th year of Yanyou of the Yuan (1320), with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, both facade and depth of three bays, with a square plan, a common form for small Buddhist halls since the Song and Yuan dynasties.

The hall now preserves a large number of Yuan-dynasty components.

During a dismantling and restoration in 1963, ink inscriptions recording component names and cutting methods were found in the concealed mortise-and-tenon joints of the wooden components, verified to have been written by the craftsmen during initial construction.

Most of the names correspond to the 'Yingzao Fashi' (State Building Standards), while not corresponding to the 'Qing Yingzao Zeli' (Qing Building Regulations), but some are between the two, showing its transitional nature.

The front cao space of the Zhenru Temple main hall is quite spacious, with a rough frame (caojia) set up; this structure is rare in the north and more common in Jiangnan residences, providing evidence for tracing the origins of Jiangnan residences.

建筑要点 / Key Features
真如寺在普陀区真如镇北段原名万寿寺俗称大寺南宋嘉定年间改院为寺元延祐七年1320年搬迁于此成为一方巨刹附近市集称真如镇元至顺三年1332年建韦驮殿金刚殿明洪武年间13681398重修清代又有增建规模宏大曾有正殿大悲阁文昌阁十王殿观音殿山门牌坊等太平天国时期寺庙被毁仅余正殿东西配殿和近代重建的天王殿近年复建了佛塔等建筑正殿始建于元延祐七年1320年单檐歇山顶面阔进深均为三间平面呈正方形是宋元以来小型佛堂常用的形式现殿内保存着大量元代构件1963年进行落架重修在木构件榫卯隐蔽处发现记有构件名称砍制手法的墨字经考证为初建时工匠所写名称大部分与营造法式相符而与清营造则例不符但也有介于两者之间者可见其过渡性真如寺大殿前槽空间颇为宽敞设有草架此结构北方少见多见于江南民居为江南民居溯源提供例证
31 江湾体育场
Jiangwan Stadium
1935年
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1989年）
地址 Address
杨浦区国和路346号
类型 Type
近代建筑/体育场
中文原文

江湾体育场原名上海市体育场，位于江湾大上海计划市中心区。为迎接1935年在上海召开的第六届全国运动会，国民党上海市政府发行公债350万元，指定100万元为专款，筹建大型体育场。

1934年奠基，由董大酉和刘鸿典主持设计，成泰营造厂承建，1935年交付使用。占地20000平方米，由运动场、体育馆和游泳池三个主要部分组成。1937年上海沦陷，体育场成为日军军火库，后又成为国民党军火库。

1946年弹药库爆炸，南部大看台全部炸毁，西侧司令台削去两层。1948年修补，1951年修复了游泳池，1952年修复田径场看台、司令台、体育馆等，1954年竣工。近年曾多次修葺。

田径场大看台为体育场主体，钢筋混凝土结构，环绕场地长达千米，东西两侧设司令台，形式相似。大门高三层20米，人造石铸成。形式似简化的四柱三间牌坊，有三间屋檐和人造石仿制斗拱，下开三券拱门，体量巨大，类似堡垒，其左右顶部置古铜色大鼎各一。

由三拱门进入大厅，内有六座拱门。进入内厅两侧为贵宾接待室和运动员休息室，二层为首长休息室和外宾接见室。通过内回廊可达主席台，设专座接待中外贵宾。大看台为钢筋混凝土结构，共两层，高11米，有22级台阶，座位4万人，立位2万人。

底层设一周6米宽回廊，利用看台底部空间设置商店、休息室、公厕和贮藏室等，并以120个拱门组成外廊，可遮风避雨，形态轻盈。4万观众皆由回廊周围34个入口进入看台，就近寻找座位。比赛结束，只需5分钟即可全部离场。

中央田径场是参照国际比赛规则的要求设计的，南北长330米，东西长175米，中间为大型足球场，设半圆形500米跑道一条，跑道两侧设跳部，弯道为掷部与跳高区，跑道北部为网球场，南部为武术场。

体育馆在田径场东北侧，坐东朝西，长82米，宽41米，南部入口为三券拱门，风格与田径场入口相似，类似堡垒。主体场馆为钢拱结构屋顶，顶棚呈圆弧形，弧曲线半径为30米，采用高射式采光。穹顶上装双层玻璃排窗10扇。

看台宽11米，有13级，3500个座位，1500个立位，可容观众5000名。中央比赛场地长40米，宽23米，铺设双层木地板，可供篮球、排球和体操比赛使用。

游泳池为刘鸿典设计（董大酉审定），在体育场南，坐南朝北，入口与体育场风格相似，仅开一大拱券门，四周有红砖拱券外廊。泳池原为露天式，周围看台有5000个座位，钢筋混凝土结构。长52米，宽20米，为当时标准比赛池，池底呈匙形。跳水区设跳水台、跳水板。池内设八条泳道。

池水采用过滤设备循环，现已改造为室内泳池。

· · · · ·
English

Jiangwan Stadium, originally named Shanghai Municipal Stadium, is located in the city center area of the 'Greater Shanghai Plan' in Jiangwan.

To welcome the 6th National Games held in Shanghai in 1935, the Kuomintang Shanghai Municipal Government issued 3.

5 million yuan in bonds, designating 1 million yuan as a special fund to build a large stadium.

The foundation was laid in 1934, designed under the leadership of Dong Dayou and Liu Hongdian, constructed by Chengtai Construction Factory, and delivered for use in 1935.

Covering an area of 20,000 square meters, it consists of three main parts: the sports field, gymnasium, and swimming pool.

In 1937 Shanghai fell, and the stadium became a Japanese military arsenal, later a Kuomintang arsenal.

In 1946 an ammunition depot exploded, completely blowing up the south grandstand and removing two stories from the west command tower.

Repairs were made in 1948; the swimming pool was restored in 1951; the track field grandstand, command tower, gymnasium etc.were restored in 1952, completed in 1954.

It has been renovated multiple times in recent years.

The track field grandstand is the main body of the stadium, of reinforced concrete structure, surrounding the field for up to a kilometer, with command towers on the east and west sides, similar in form.

The main gate is three stories high and 20 meters, cast in artificial stone.

Its form resembles a simplified four-column three-bay paifang, with three-bay eaves and artificial stone imitation bracket sets, with three arched gates below, massive in volume, resembling a fortress, with ancient bronze-colored large ding vessels placed on the left and right tops respectively.

Entering the hall through the three arched gates, there are six arched gates inside.

Entering the inner hall, both sides are VIP reception rooms and athlete rest rooms; the second floor is the leaders' rest room and foreign guest reception room.

Through the inner cloister one can reach the rostrum, with special seats for receiving Chinese and foreign VIPs.

The grandstand is of reinforced concrete structure, two stories total, 11 meters high, with 22 steps, 40,000 seats and 20,000 standing positions.

The ground floor has a 6-meter-wide cloister around it, using the space under the grandstand to set up shops, rest rooms, public toilets, and storage rooms etc.

, with 120 arched gates forming an outer corridor that can shelter from wind and rain, with a light form.

All 40,000 spectators enter the grandstand through 34 entrances around the cloister, finding seats nearby.After the competition, all can leave within only 5 minutes.

The central track field was designed according to international competition rules, 330 meters long north-south and 175 meters long east-west, with a large football field in the center, a semicircular 500-meter running track, jumping areas on both sides of the track, throwing and high-jump areas on the curves, tennis courts north of the track, and a martial arts field south of the track.

The gymnasium is northeast of the track field, facing west, 82 meters long and 41 meters wide, with a three-arch gate at the south entrance, similar in style to the track field entrance, resembling a fortress.

The main venue has a steel-arch structure roof, with the ceiling in a circular arc shape, the arc curve radius being 30 meters, adopting high-angle lighting.

The dome is equipped with 10 double-glazed row windows.The grandstand is 11 meters wide, with 13 steps, 3,500 seats and 1,500 standing positions, accommodating 5,000 spectators.

The central competition field is 40 meters long and 23 meters wide, paved with double-layer wooden floors, usable for basketball, volleyball, and gymnastics competitions.

The swimming pool was designed by Liu Hongdian (reviewed by Dong Dayou), south of the stadium, facing north, with an entrance similar in style to the stadium, with only one large arched gate, surrounded by red-brick arched outer corridors.

The pool was originally open-air, with 5,000 seats in the surrounding grandstand, of reinforced concrete structure.

52 meters long and 20 meters wide, it was a standard competition pool at the time, with a spoon-shaped pool bottom.The diving area has diving platforms and springboards.

Eight swimming lanes are set inside the pool.The pool water uses filtration equipment for circulation, and it has now been converted into an indoor pool.

建筑要点 / Key Features

32 旧上海特别市政府
Former Shanghai Special Municipal Government Building
1933年
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1989年）
地址 Address
杨浦区清源环路650号上海体育学院内
类型 Type
近代建筑/政府大楼
中文原文

旧上海特别市政府由董大酉设计，朱森记营造厂承建，1931年奠基，1933年建成。

上海特别市政府成立于1927年7月，当时上海市中心大部分地区为租界，市政府偏在枫林桥地区（近徐家汇），为改变现状，1929年当局提出《大上海计划》，打算搬迁市政府，绕开租界和旧市中心，在上海东北部建设新的行政区、商业区、住宅区等。

1929年开始征集作品，共有65人应征，递交设计19份，均不合用，最后选出前三等奖，由董大酉参照获奖设计，提出六种方案供选用。市政府大楼为钢筋混凝土结构，采用仿清代宫殿式样。底层处理为宽阔的汉白玉台基，前有台阶直通二层门厅。

楼身总高四层，处理为七开间大殿形式，屋顶覆绿色琉璃瓦，中部为单檐歇山顶，两侧伸出庑殿顶屋檐。檐下设混凝土仿制的红柱、雕梁，上承彩绘斗拱，柱间有雀替。

一楼可从台基下进入，楼内有彩绘仿木结构的梁柱天花，屋顶悬挂宫灯，地上有水磨石拼出的中国地图。一层包括传达室、警卫室、收发室、会计处、保险库、大食堂及办公室等，楼内有两处宽大扶梯和两座电梯，可直达四楼。第二层为大礼堂、图书室及会议室等，大礼堂由南侧台阶直达。第三层中部为市长及高级职员办公室，两翼为各科办公室。第四层为屋顶层，设休息室、储藏室、档案室及电话机房等。

内部设施完善，配置通信设备，有电梯、抽水马桶、消防设备等，大楼各室装有防暑扇119只，并有暖气管道，冬暖夏凉。

· · · · ·
English

The Former Shanghai Special Municipal Government Building was designed by Dong Dayou and constructed by Zhusenji Construction Factory, with the foundation laid in 1931 and completed in 1933.

The Shanghai Special Municipal Government was established in July 1927; at that time most of the Shanghai city center was concessions, and the municipal government was located in the Fenglinqiao area (near Xujiahui).

To change this situation, in 1929 the authorities proposed the 'Greater Shanghai Plan,' intending to relocate the municipal government, bypassing the concessions and old city center, to build new administrative, commercial, and residential districts in northeastern Shanghai.

In 1929 a design competition began, with 65 people applying and 19 designs submitted, none of which were suitable; finally the top three prizes were selected, and Dong Dayou proposed six schemes for selection based on the winning designs.

The municipal government building is of reinforced concrete structure, adopting an imitation Qing-dynasty palace style.

The ground floor is treated as a broad white marble platform, with steps leading directly to the second-floor entrance hall.

The building body is four stories high total, treated as a seven-bay great hall form, with the roof covered in green glazed tiles; the center is a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, with hip roofs extending from both sides.

Under the eaves are concrete imitation red columns and carved beams, supporting painted bracket sets, with sparrow brackets between columns.

The first floor can be entered from under the platform; inside the building are painted imitation wooden structure beams, columns, and ceilings, with palace lanterns hanging from the roof, and a Chinese map made of terrazzo on the floor.

The first floor includes the reception room, guard room, mail room, accounting office, vault, large cafeteria, and offices etc.

; there are two wide staircases and two elevators in the building, which can reach the fourth floor directly.The second floor is the grand auditorium, library, and meeting rooms etc.

; the grand auditorium is directly accessible from the south steps.The center of the third floor is the mayor's and senior staff's offices, with the two wings being various department offices.

The fourth floor is the roof level, with rest rooms, storage rooms, archives, and telephone equipment rooms etc.

The interior facilities are complete, with communication equipment, elevators, flush toilets, fire-fighting equipment etc.

; each room in the building is equipped with 119 cooling fans, and there are heating pipes, warm in winter and cool in summer.

建筑要点 / Key Features
旧上海特别市政府由董大酉设计朱森记营造厂承建1931年奠基1933年建成上海特别市政府成立于1927年7月当时上海市中心大部分地区为租界市政府偏在枫林桥地区近徐家汇为改变现状1929年当局提出大上海计划打算搬迁市政府绕开租界和旧市中心在上海东北部建设新的行政区商业区住宅区等1929年开始征集作品共有65人应征递交设计19份均不合用最后选出前三等奖由董大酉参照获奖设计提出六种方案供选用市政府大楼为钢筋混凝土结构采用仿清代宫殿式样底层处理为宽阔的汉白玉台基前有台阶直通二层门厅楼身总高四层处理为七开间大殿形式屋顶覆绿色琉璃瓦中部为单檐歇山顶两侧伸出庑殿顶屋檐檐下设混凝土仿制的红柱雕梁上承彩绘斗拱柱间有雀替一楼可从台基下进入楼内有彩绘仿木结构的梁柱天花屋顶悬挂宫灯地上有水磨石拼出的中国地图一层包括传达室警卫室收发室会计处保险库大食堂及办公室等楼内有两处宽大扶梯和两座电梯可直达四楼第二层为大礼堂图书室及会议室等大礼堂由南侧台阶直达第三层中部为市长及高级职员办公室两翼为各科办公室第四层为屋顶层设休息室储藏室档案室及电话机房等内部设施完善配置通信设备有电梯抽水马桶消防设备等大楼各室装有防暑扇119只
33 旧上海市图书馆
Former Shanghai City Library
1935年
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（2014年）
地址 Address
长海路174号第二军医大学附属长海医院
类型 Type
近代建筑/图书馆
中文原文

旧上海市图书馆与旧上海市博物馆为姊妹楼，十分相似。由董大酉设计，张裕泰合记营造厂承建，1934年始建，1935年竣工。大楼坐东向西，建筑面积1900平方米，钢筋混凝土结构，造型仿北京城鼓楼。

下部两侧处理为基座，上部建重檐歇山黄琉璃顶小楼。与博物馆不同的是，上部城楼檐下有仿木柱梁，为五开间大殿。博物馆入口券门上没有挑出的阳台雨棚。两翼原为平屋顶，二层不设窗，现已改为坡屋顶，二层开窗。进入大楼底层为门厅，内有彩绘的仿木构装修，尽头为双跑大楼梯直通二层。

一楼原设衣帽间、售品室，大厅两旁为走廊，通向两翼的办公室、研究室和储藏室。南翼凸出为图书室，内有100个座位，北翼为300座的演讲厅。二层原为历史、艺术陈列厅，两侧为书画陈列厅，上盖玻璃顶棚。上层陈列室原采用天窗采光，不开窗，用冷暖通风设备调节室内空气。

· · · · ·
English

The Former Shanghai City Library and the Former Shanghai Municipal Museum are sister buildings, very similar.

Designed by Dong Dayou and constructed by Zhangyutai Heji Construction Factory, construction began in 1934 and was completed in 1935.

The building faces west, with a building area of 1,900 square meters, of reinforced concrete structure, modeled after the Beijing Drum Tower.

The lower two sides are treated as a base, with a double-eave hip-and-gable yellow glazed-tile small building on top.

Different from the museum, under the eaves of the upper tower there are imitation wooden columns and beams, forming a five-bay great hall.

There is no projecting balcony canopy over the arched entrance gate of the museum.

The two wings originally had flat roofs with no windows on the second floor, which have now been changed to pitched roofs with windows on the second floor.

Entering the building, the ground floor is the entrance hall, with painted imitation wooden structure decoration inside; at the end is a double-flight grand staircase leading directly to the second floor.

The first floor originally had a cloakroom and sales room, with corridors on both sides of the hall leading to the offices, research rooms, and storage rooms of the two wings.

The south wing protrudes as a reading room with 100 seats inside, and the north wing is a 300-seat lecture hall.

The second floor was originally the history and art exhibition hall, with calligraphy and painting exhibition halls on both sides, covered by a glass ceiling.

The upper exhibition rooms originally used skylight lighting without windows, using heating and cooling ventilation equipment to regulate indoor air.

建筑要点 / Key Features
旧上海市图书馆与旧上海市博物馆为姊妹楼十分相似由董大酉设计张裕泰合记营造厂承建1934年始建1935年竣工大楼坐东向西建筑面积1900平方米钢筋混凝土结构造型仿北京城鼓楼下部两侧处理为基座上部建重檐歇山黄琉璃顶小楼与图书馆不同的是上部城楼檐下有仿木柱梁为五开间大殿博物馆入口券门上没有挑出的阳台雨棚两翼原为平屋顶二层不设窗现已改为坡屋顶二层开窗进入大楼底层为门厅内有彩绘的仿木构装修尽头为双跑大楼梯直通二层一楼原设衣帽间售品室大厅两旁为走廊通向两翼的办公室研究室和储藏室南翼凸出为图书室内有100个座位北翼为300座的演讲厅二层原为历史艺术陈列厅两侧为书画陈列厅上盖玻璃顶棚上层陈列室原采用天窗采光不开窗用冷暖通风设备调节室内空气

35 秋霞圃
Qiuxia Garden
明—清
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1984年）
地址 Address
嘉定区东大街314号
类型 Type
古建筑/园林
门票 Ticket
10元
开放时间 Hours
8:00 — 16:30
中文原文

明正德、嘉靖年间，工部尚书龚弘（1450—1526）在宅后建造园林，时称龚氏园。

清顺治二年（1645年）嘉定惨遭三次屠杀，龚氏后裔参加抗清斗争，城破后以身殉节，龚家败落，宅园归徽商汪氏，大加拓建，改名秋霞圃，有桃花潭、松风岭、莺语堤、寒香室、百五台、岁寒径、层云石、数雨斋、题青渡和洒雪廊共十景。

清雍正四年（1726年）汪氏将秋霞圃捐给城隍庙，清乾隆二十四年（1759年）又合并东侧建于明万历年间的沈氏园，一起作为城隍庙的后花园。太平天国时期园中建筑全部被毁，清光绪年间陆续重建。

今秋霞圃包括一庙三园四个景区：东南角为城隍庙景区，其东北侧为沈氏园（凝霞阁景区），西侧为秋霞圃（桃花潭景区），最北端还有始建于明万历年间的金氏园（清镜堂景区），总面积约45亩。

园门位于东南角，入门北端是城隍庙大殿，包括前殿和后殿，通过纵廊联结成工字殿。由前殿西侧向北为亦是轩、数雨斋等一系列建筑庭院。北部主院是沈氏园旧址，主厅凝霞阁位于院北，阁前小院采用旱院水做手法，借铺地幻出水意；阁北隔着水池遥对金氏园的三隐堂。金氏园建筑不多，以山林池塘为主，颇具野趣。

出院西屏山堂为秋霞圃，围绕中部的桃花潭布置，北岸为主厅山光潭影馆，前出平台，隔池欣赏南岸的假山。假山用湖石叠成，为明代遗构，临池嶙峋如石壁，下部出贴水石矶小径；山间植藤萝古木，荫翳幽深，颇具真山意境。

桃花潭东西横长，池岸曲折，沿岸设碧光亭、丛桂轩和舟而不游轩等，与池北正堂、池东屏山堂互成对景。溪水将假山、陆地环绕分隔，再以涉趣桥、三曲桥相连，增添游趣。在丛桂轩南侧立有三星石，是三座明代太湖石，秀润多姿，象征福、禄、寿三星。

秋霞圃主景区面积不大，但布局紧凑精巧，假山苍古天然，建筑位置合宜，为珍贵的明代园林遗存，具有较高的历史和艺术价值。

· · · · ·
English

During the Zhengde and Jiajing reigns of the Ming, Gong Hong (1450-1526), Minister of Works, built a garden behind his residence, then called the Gong Family Garden.

In the 2nd year of Shunzhi of the Qing (1645), Jiading suffered three massacres; descendants of the Gong family participated in the anti-Qing struggle and died for their cause after the city fell, the Gong family declined, and the residence and garden passed to the Huizhou merchant Wang family, who greatly expanded it and renamed it Qiuxia Garden (Autumn Glow Garden), with ten scenes: Peach Blossom Pool, Pine Wind Ridge, Oriole Song Causeway, Cold Fragrance Chamber, Hundred-Five Terrace, Winter Cold Path, Layered Cloud Stone, Rain Counting Studio, Treading Green Ferry, and Snow-Sprinkling Corridor.

In the 4th year of Yongzheng (1726), the Wang family donated Qiuxia Garden to the City God Temple; in the 24th year of Qianlong (1759), the Shen Family Garden built in the Wanli reign of the Ming on the east side was also merged, together serving as the back garden of the City God Temple.

During the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom period, all buildings in the garden were destroyed, and they were gradually rebuilt during the Guangxu reign of the Qing.

Today Qiuxia Garden includes four scenic areas of one temple and three gardens: the southeast corner is the City God Temple scenic area, its northeast side is the Shen Family Garden (Ningxia Pavilion scenic area), the west side is Qiuxia Garden (Peach Blossom Pool scenic area), and at the northernmost end is the Jin Family Garden (Qingjing Hall scenic area) first built in the Wanli reign of the Ming, with a total area of about 45 mu.

The garden gate is at the southeast corner; north of the entrance is the City God Temple main hall, including a front hall and back hall, connected by a longitudinal corridor to form an I-shaped hall.

Northward from the west side of the front hall are a series of building courtyards such as Yishi Pavilion and Rain Counting Studio.

The northern main courtyard is the former site of the Shen Family Garden; the main hall Ningxia Pavilion is located north of the courtyard, and the small courtyard in front of the pavilion adopts a 'dry courtyard water-making' technique, using paving to create the illusion of water; north of the pavilion, across a pool, faces the Sanyin Hall of the Jin Family Garden.

The Jin Family Garden has few buildings, focusing on mountains, forests, and ponds, quite wild in charm.

Exiting west to Pingshan Hall is Qiuxia Garden, arranged around the central Peach Blossom Pool; the north bank is the main hall Shanguang Tanying Hall (Mountain Light and Pool Shadow Hall), with a platform projecting forward, appreciating the rockery on the south bank across the pool.

The rockery is piled with lake stones, a Ming-dynasty relic, rising ruggedly like a stone cliff by the pool, with water-hugging stone islets and paths at the lower part; vines and ancient trees are planted among the mountains, shaded and deep, quite like a real mountain.

The Peach Blossom Pool extends east-west, with winding banks; along the banks are set Biguang Pavilion, Conggui (Cassia Cluster) Pavilion, and Zhou'erbuyou (Boat-but-not-sailing) Pavilion etc.

, forming mutual scenes with the main hall on the north bank and Pingshan Hall on the east bank.

Streams surround and separate the rockery and land, connected by Shequ Bridge and Three-Curve Bridge, adding touring charm.

South of Conggui Pavilion stand the Three Star Stones, three Ming-dynasty Taihu stones, graceful and varied, symbolizing the three stars of Fortune, Prosperity, and Longevity.

The main scenic area of Qiuxia Garden is not large, but its layout is compact and exquisite, the rockery is ancient and natural, and the building positions are appropriate; it is a precious Ming-dynasty garden relic with high historical and artistic value.

建筑要点 / Key Features
明正德嘉靖年间工部尚书龚弘14501526在宅后建造园林时称龚氏园清顺治二年1645年嘉定惨遭三次屠杀龚氏后裔参加抗清斗争城破后以身殉节龚家败落宅园归徽商汪氏大加拓建改名秋霞圃有桃花潭松风岭莺语堤寒香室百五台岁寒径层云石数雨斋题青渡和洒雪廊共十景清雍正四年1726年汪氏将秋霞圃捐给城隍庙清乾隆二十四年1759年又合并东侧建于明万历年间的沈氏园一起作为城隍庙的后花园太平天国时期园中建筑全部被毁清光绪年间陆续重建今秋霞圃包括一庙三园四个景区东南角为城隍庙景区其东北侧为沈氏园凝霞阁景区西侧为秋霞圃桃花潭景区最北端还有始建于明万历年间的金氏园清镜堂景区总面积约45亩园门位于东南角入门北端是城隍庙大殿包括前殿和后殿通过纵廊联结成工字殿由前殿西侧向北为亦是轩数雨斋等一系列建筑庭院北部主院是沈氏园旧址主厅凝霞阁位于院北阁前小院采用旱院水做手法借铺地幻出水意阁北隔着水池遥对金氏园的三隐堂金氏园建筑不多以山林池塘为主颇具野趣出院西屏山堂为秋霞圃围绕中部的桃花潭布置北岸为主厅山光潭影馆前出平台隔池欣赏南岸的假山假山用湖石叠成为明代遗构临池嶙峋如石壁下部出贴水石矶小径山间植藤萝古木荫翳幽深颇具真山意境桃花潭
36 法华塔
Fahua Pagoda
明
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（2002年）
地址 Address
嘉定区南大街349号
类型 Type
古建筑/塔
中文原文

法华塔在嘉定镇中心，又名金沙塔，始建于南宋开禧年间（1205—1207），当时此地名为练祁市，十年后嘉定设县，以此塔为中心建城，十字大街横亘塔下，为嘉定古城的标志性建筑，有金沙夕照胜景。

元至大元年（1308年）重修，至明代损坏仅剩一层，明万历三十六年（1608年）重建，1919年又损坏，1924年重修时将底层围廊、腰檐、平座和第七层塔顶拆除，改为水泥钢骨结构，虽古意全失，但在城市史上仍有价值。

1994年塔身严重倾斜，进行纠偏，同时清除了1924年添加的混凝土，恢复砖木结构外观，1996年竣工。塔为四面七层楼阁式砖塔，高40.8米，各层砖壁中设石级可登临。塔下有练祁塘，可观塔影。

1996年修缮时对法华塔地宫进行发掘清理，在地下塔心室发现了明代和元代两个地宫，清理出宋、元、明代文物近百件。

· · · · ·
English

Fahua Pagoda is in the center of Jiading Town, also named Jinsha (Golden Sand) Pagoda, first built during the Kaixi reign of the Southern Song (1205-1207), when this place was called Lianqi City; ten years later Jiading was established as a county, and the city was built with this pagoda as the center, with cross-shaped main streets extending under the pagoda; it is the landmark building of ancient Jiading city, with the scenic view of 'Golden Sand Sunset.

' It was renovated in the 1st year of Zhida of the Yuan (1308), and by the Ming it was damaged with only one story remaining; it was rebuilt in the 36th year of Wanli of the Ming (1608), damaged again in 1919; during a renovation in 1924, the ground-floor surrounding corridor, waist eaves, flat seats, and the seventh-story top were demolished and changed to a cement steel-frame structure; although it lost all ancient charm, it still has value in urban history.

In 1994 the pagoda body was severely tilted and was straightened; at the same time the concrete added in 1924 was removed, restoring the brick-wood structure appearance, completed in 1996.

The pagoda is a four-sided seven-story pavilion-style brick pagoda, 40.8 meters high, with stone steps set in the brick walls of each story for climbing.

Under the pagoda is Lianqi Pond, where the pagoda shadow can be viewed.

During the 1996 renovation, the underground palace of Fahua Pagoda was excavated and cleared; two underground palaces of the Ming and Yuan dynasties were discovered in the underground pagoda chamber, and nearly a hundred cultural relics from the Song, Yuan, and Ming dynasties were cleared out.

建筑要点 / Key Features
法华塔在嘉定镇中心又名金沙塔始建于南宋开禧年间12051207当时此地名为练祁市十年后嘉定设县以此塔为中心建城十字大街横亘塔下为嘉定古城的标志性建筑有金沙夕照胜景元至大元年1308年重修至明代损坏仅剩一层明万历三十六年1608年重建1919年又损坏1924年重修时将底层围廊腰檐平座和第七层塔顶拆除改为水泥钢骨结构虽古意全失但在城市史上仍有价值1994年塔身严重倾斜进行纠偏同时清除了1924年添加的混凝土恢复砖木结构外观1996年竣工塔为四面七层楼阁式砖塔高40.8米各层砖壁中设石级可登临塔下有练祁塘可观塔影1996年修缮时对法华塔地宫进行发掘清理在地下塔心室发现了明代和元代两个地宫清理出宋元明代文物近百件
37 嘉定孔庙
Temple of Confucius in Jiading
明—清
级别 Level
第七批全国重点文物保护单位（2013年）
地址 Address
嘉定区南大街183号
类型 Type
古建筑/孔庙
门票 Ticket
免费
开放时间 Hours
8:00 — 16:30
中文原文

嘉定孔庙位于嘉定古城中部，西临南大街，南襟汇龙潭，是江南地区乃至全国保存最完整的庙学建筑群之一，现为嘉定博物馆和上海中国科举博物馆。

嘉定孔庙又称学宫，为县学，创建于宋嘉定十二年至十四年（1219—1221），宋淳祐九年（1249年）筑泮池、建兴贤坊，咸淳元年（1265年）建泮池桥。

元代嘉定升州，遂为州学。元天顺年间筑应奎山以障孔庙前佛寺，元至正十三年（1353年）建棂星门，至正十四年（1354年）建育才坊。明代嘉定复为县，仍为县学。

明正德元年（1506年）建仰高坊，正德十四年（1520年）建牌坊石栏，万历十八年（1590年）在应奎山下凿汇龙潭。

清雍正初年建书院。旧有殿廷乔柏、黉署疏梅、丈石凝晖、双桐揽照、启震虹梁、聚奎穹阁、映奎山色、汇龙潭影八景。从宋淳祐九年（1249年）至清末，重修、增建、重建多达七十余次。

现存建筑多为清光绪年间重建，但主体仍保留明代风格。1961年嘉定县博物馆迁址嘉定孔庙，2006年成立上海中国科举博物馆。嘉定孔庙由文庙、学宫和书院三部分组成，全国少见，在同级孔庙中有吴中第一之称。

文庙包括大成殿、东西两庑、大成门及左右角门和名宦、土地、乡贤、忠孝祠，石筑泮池及泮池桥三座，棂星门，仰高、兴贤、育才三坊及连接三坊的石栏。学宫包括明伦堂，礼门、尊经阁、崇圣祠和儒学门等建筑。

书院包括讲堂、教学相长堂和仪门。

· · · · ·
English

Jiading Confucian Temple is located in the center of ancient Jiading city, facing South Street to the west and bordering Huitan Pool to the south; it is one of the most completely preserved temple-school architectural complexes in the Jiangnan region and even the whole country, now serving as the Jiading Museum and the Shanghai China Imperial Examination Museum.

Jiading Confucian Temple, also called the School Palace, was a county school, founded from the 12th to 14th year of Jiading of the Song (1219-1221); in the 9th year of Chunyou (1249) the Pan Pool was built and the Xingxian (Promoting Worthies) Paifang was erected; in the 1st year of Xianchun (1265) the Pan Pool Bridge was built.

In the Yuan, Jiading was promoted to a prefecture, so it became a prefecture school.

During the Tianshun reign of the Yuan, Yingkui Mountain was built to block the Buddhist temple in front of the Confucian Temple; in the 13th year of Zhizheng (1353) the Lingxing Gate was built; in the 14th year of Zhizheng (1354) the Yucai (Nurturing Talent) Paifang was built.

In the Ming, Jiading reverted to a county, still as a county school.

In the 1st year of Zhengde (1506) the Yanggao (Revering the High) Paifang was built; in the 14th year of Zhengde (1520) the paifang stone railings were built; in the 18th year of Wanli (1590) Huitan Pool was dug at the foot of Yingkui Mountain.

In the early Yongzheng reign of the Qing, an academy was built.

It formerly had eight scenes: Hall Courtyard Tall Cypresses, School Sparse Plums, Ten-foot Stone Condensing Light, Twin Paulownias Catching Light, Qizhen Rainbow Beam, Jukui Dome Pavilion, Yingkui Mountain Color, and Huitan Pool Shadow.

From the 9th year of Chunyou of the Song (1249) to the end of the Qing, there were over seventy renovations, additions, and reconstructions.

The existing buildings were mostly rebuilt during the Guangxu reign of the Qing, but the main body still retains the Ming style.

In 1961 the Jiading County Museum moved to Jiading Confucian Temple; in 2006 the Shanghai China Imperial Examination Museum was established.

Jiading Confucian Temple consists of three parts: the Confucian Temple, the School Palace, and the Academy, rare nationwide, and has the title 'First in Wuzhong' among Confucian temples of the same level.

The Confucian Temple includes the Dacheng (Great Achievement) Hall, east and west side halls, Dacheng Gate and left and right corner gates, and the temples of Famous Officials, Earth God, Local Worthies, and Loyalty and Filial Piety; the stone-built Pan Pool and three Pan Pool bridges; the Lingxing Gate; the three paifangs of Yanggao, Xingxian, and Yucai, and the stone railings connecting the three paifangs.

The School Palace includes the Minglun (Understanding Ethics) Hall, the Ritual Gate, Zunjing (Revering Classics) Pavilion, Chongsheng (Worshipping Sages) Shrine, and the Confucian School Gate etc.

The Academy includes the Lecture Hall, the Teaching-Learning Mutual Growth Hall, and the Ceremonial Gate.

建筑要点 / Key Features
嘉定孔庙位于嘉定古城中部西临南大街南襟汇龙潭是江南地区乃至全国保存最完整的庙学建筑群之一现为嘉定博物馆和上海中国科举博物馆嘉定孔庙又称学宫为县学创建于宋嘉定十二年至十四年12191221宋淳祐九年1249年筑泮池建兴贤坊咸淳元年1265年建泮池桥元代嘉定升州遂为州学元天顺年间筑应奎山以障孔庙前佛寺元至正十三年1353年建棂星门至正十四年1354年建育才坊明代嘉定复为县仍为县学明正德元年1506年建仰高坊正德十四年1520年建牌坊石栏万历十八年1590年在应奎山下凿汇龙潭清雍正初年建书院旧有殿廷乔柏黉署疏梅丈石凝晖双桐揽照启震虹梁聚奎穹阁映奎山色汇龙潭影八景从宋淳祐九年1249年至清末重修建重建多达七十余次现存建筑多为清光绪年间重建但主体仍保留明代风格1961年嘉定县博物馆迁址嘉定孔庙2006年成立上海中国科举博物馆嘉定孔庙由文庙学宫和书院三部分组成全国少见在同级孔庙中有吴中第一之称文庙包括大成殿东西两庑大成门及左右角门和名宦土地乡贤忠孝祠石筑泮池及泮池桥三座棂星门仰高兴贤育才三坊及连接三坊的石栏学宫包括明伦堂礼门尊经阁崇圣祠和儒学门等建筑书院包括讲堂教学相长堂和仪门
38 南翔寺砖塔
Brick Pagoda of Nanxiang Temple
五代
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（1980年）
地址 Address
南翔镇人民街与解放街交叉口
类型 Type
古建筑/塔
中文原文

南翔寺砖塔共有两座，东西对峙，俗称南翔双塔。寺始建于南朝梁天监年间（502—519），初名白鹤南翔寺，唐开成年间（836—840）扩建。清乾隆三十一年（1766年）寺毁于火灾，仅留寺前双塔。

双塔原立于南翔寺山门内东西两侧，始建于五代至北宋初年（907—1127），是上海现存最古老的佛塔。

双塔历经千年未曾大修，到近代已风化残损，出檐、塔刹、相轮已失，1982年根据尚存构件设计修复。由于塔建造年代久远，周围地坪上升，塔身一层已降入地下，1986年在周围清出塔池，置栏保护。

双塔高11米，八角七层，全为砖砌，外表仿木楼阁式，实心不能登临。底层为素青石基座，高43厘米，各边宽88厘米。塔身逐层收分，各层四向开火焰券壶门，间隔直棂窗，层层相闪。

各层出叠涩平座，略成仰莲状，呈现唐宋时期建筑风格，上部石勾栏板雕刻精美。各层角柱为圆洞式空心砖柱，内包木柱，下有木榫插在砖砌卯口内，在砖塔中甚为少见。

砖柱顶端有卷杀，上施砖枋，枋上有砖仿木的五铺作单杪单昂斗拱，柱间施补间铺作一朵，腰檐下有砖砌角梁和檐椽等，甚为精巧。

双塔形制类似杭州闸口白塔和灵隐寺大雄殿前双石塔，是研究唐宋建筑的珍贵实例。

· · · · ·
English

There are two brick pagodas of Nanxiang Temple, facing each other east and west, commonly called the Nanxiang Twin Pagodas.

The temple was first built during the Tianjian reign of the Liang Dynasty of the Southern Dynasties (502-519), originally named Baihe (White Crane) Nanxiang Temple, and expanded during the Kaicheng reign of the Tang (836-840).

In the 31st year of Qianlong of the Qing (1766), the temple was destroyed by fire, leaving only the twin pagodas in front of the temple.

The twin pagodas originally stood on the east and west sides inside the mountain gate of Nanxiang Temple, first built from the Five Dynasties to the early Northern Song (907-1127), and are the oldest surviving Buddhist pagodas in Shanghai.

The twin pagodas have not undergone major repairs for a thousand years; by modern times they were weathered and damaged, with projecting eaves, pagoda finials, and wheel discs lost; in 1982 they were designed and restored based on the surviving components.

Due to the long age of the pagodas and the rise of the surrounding ground level, the first story of the pagoda body had sunk into the ground; in 1986 a pagoda pool was cleared around them and railings installed for protection.

The twin pagodas are 11 meters high, octagonal with seven stories, entirely brick-built, with an exterior imitating wooden pavilion style, solid and not climbable.

The ground floor is a plain bluestone base, 43 cm high, 88 cm wide on each side.

The pagoda body tapers layer by layer; each story opens flame-arched pot doors on four sides, alternating with lattice windows, alternating between stories.

Each story has corbeled flat seats, slightly in the shape of upward-facing lotus, presenting the architectural style of the Tang and Song periods; the upper stone railing panels are exquisitely carved.

The corner columns of each story are round-hole hollow brick columns, enclosing wooden columns inside, with wooden tenons inserted into brick-made mortises below, quite rare among brick pagodas.

The top of the brick columns has entasis, with brick architraves above; on the architraves are brick imitation wooden five-set single-bracket single-ang bracket sets, with one intermediate bracket set between columns; under the waist eaves are brick-made corner beams and eave rafters etc.

, quite exquisite.

The form of the twin pagodas is similar to the White Pagoda at Zhakou in Hangzhou and the twin stone pagodas in front of the Mahavira Hall of Lingyin Temple, and is a precious example for studying Tang and Song architecture.

建筑要点 / Key Features
南翔寺砖塔共有两座东西对峙俗称南翔双塔寺始建于南朝梁天监年间502519初名白鹤南翔寺唐开成年间836840扩建清乾隆三十一年1766年寺毁于火灾仅留寺前双塔双塔原立于南翔寺山门内东西两侧始建于五代至北宋初年9071127是上海现存最古老的佛塔双塔历经千年未曾大修到近代已风化残损出檐塔刹相轮已失1982年根据尚存构件设计修复由于塔建造年代久远周围地坪上升塔身一层已降入地下1986年在周围清出塔池置栏保护双塔高11米八角七层全为砖砌外表仿木楼阁式实心不能登临底层为素青石基座高43厘米各边宽88厘米塔身逐层收分各层四向开火焰券壶门间隔直棂窗层层相闪各层出叠涩平座略成仰莲状呈现唐宋时期建筑风格上部石勾栏板雕刻精美各层角柱为圆洞式空心砖柱内包木柱下有木榫插在砖砌卯口内在砖塔中甚为少见砖柱顶端有卷杀上施砖枋枋上有砖仿木的五铺作单杪单昂斗拱柱间施补间铺作一朵腰檐下有砖砌角梁和檐椽等甚为精巧双塔形制类似杭州闸口白塔和灵隐寺大雄殿前双石塔是研究唐宋建筑的珍贵实例
39 南翔古猗园
Guyi Garden in Nanxiang
明—清
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（2014年）
地址 Address
南翔镇沪宜公路218号
类型 Type
古建筑/园林
门票 Ticket
12元
开放时间 Hours
6:00 — 18:00
中文原文

古猗园原名猗园，明嘉靖、万历年间当地人闵士籍聘请刻竹名家朱三松主持建造，园名取《诗经》瞻彼淇奥，绿竹猗猗之意。清乾隆十一年（1746年）园归洞庭山人叶锦，大加拓建后改称古猗园。

乾隆五十三年（1789年）地方士绅集资购下捐给城隍庙作为灵苑，晚清在园中增建厅堂酒楼，成为祀神和休闲场所。抗日战争时期园林被日军占据，破坏严重，新中国成立后多次修复扩建，成为一座近百亩的大型公园。

古猗园原以戏鹅池为中心，环池布置建筑：池北为不系舟画舫，池西为逸野堂，池南为浮筠阁，池东为梅花厅，互相成为对景，是古园遗存的精华部分。水池周围有后来移至园中的一对唐经幢和一座宋代石塔等重要文物。

唐经幢原在南翔寺大殿前，东西对峙，建于唐咸通八年（867年）和乾符二年（875年），北宋太平兴国五年（980年）重修，元元统二年（1334年）重修大殿时重镌经文并更易残损石构件。

两幢高7米，二十余级，平面六边形，有基座、托座、束腰和檐盖等，塔身镌刻陀罗尼经，各级有佛像、力士和莲瓣等，历代均有修补。

宋代石塔名为普同塔，为南宋嘉定十五年（1222年）甘子荆建，明万历二十六年（1598年）重修。

塔为四面七层，高3米，塔身两级镌刻佛像，塔尖有俯仰莲塔檐，上立宝瓶状塔刹。

· · · · ·
English

Guyi Garden was originally named Yi Garden; during the Jiajing and Wanli reigns of the Ming, local Min Shiji hired bamboo-carving master Zhu Sansong to preside over its construction; the garden name takes the meaning from the Book of Songs: Look at that Qi River bend, green bamboo luxuriant.

In the 11th year of Qianlong of the Qing (1746), the garden passed to Ye Jin from Dongting Mountain, who greatly expanded it and renamed it Guyi Garden.

In the 53rd year of Qianlong (1789), local gentry raised funds to purchase it and donate it to the City God Temple as a spiritual garden; in the late Qing, halls and restaurants were added to the garden, becoming a place for deity worship and leisure.

During the War of Resistance against Japan, the garden was occupied by the Japanese army and severely damaged; after the founding of New China, it was restored and expanded multiple times, becoming a large park of nearly a hundred mu.

Guyi Garden originally centered on the Xi'e Goose-Playing Pool, with buildings arranged around the pool: north of the pool is the Buxizhou Unmoored Boat painted boat, west of the pool is the Yiye Leisurely Wilderness Hall, south of the pool is the Fuyun Floating Bamboo Pavilion, and east of the pool is the Meihua Plum Blossom Hall, forming mutual scenes with each other; this is the essence of the surviving ancient garden.

Around the pool are important cultural relics later moved into the garden, including a pair of Tang-dynasty sutra pillars and a Song-dynasty stone pagoda.

The Tang sutra pillars were originally in front of the main hall of Nanxiang Temple, facing each other east and west, built in the 8th year of Xiantong of the Tang (867) and the 2nd year of Qianfu (875); rebuilt in the 5th year of Taiping Xingguo of the Northern Song (980); when the main hall was rebuilt in the 2nd year of Yuantong of the Yuan (1334), the scriptures were re-engraved and damaged stone components were replaced.

The two pillars are 7 meters high, with over twenty levels, hexagonal in plan, with bases, supporting seats, waists, and eave covers etc.

; the pillar bodies are engraved with the Dharani Sutra, with Buddha statues, warrior figures, and lotus petals at each level, and have been repaired in successive dynasties.

The Song-dynasty stone pagoda is named Putong Pagoda, built by Gan Zijing in the 15th year of Jiading of the Southern Song (1222), and rebuilt in the 26th year of Wanli of the Ming (1598).

The pagoda is four-sided with seven stories, 3 meters high; the two levels of the pagoda body are engraved with Buddha statues; the pagoda tip has upward and downward lotus eave corners, with a vase-shaped finial on top.

建筑要点 / Key Features
古猗园原名猗园明嘉靖万历年间当地人闵士籍聘请刻竹名家朱三松主持建造园名取诗经瞻彼淇奥绿竹猗猗之意清乾隆十一年1746年园归洞庭山人叶锦大加拓建后改称古猗园乾隆五十三年1789年地方士绅集资购下捐给城隍庙作为灵苑晚清在园中增建厅堂酒楼成为祀神和休闲场所抗日战争时期园林被日军占据破坏严重新中国成立后多次修复扩建成为一座近百亩的大型公园古猗园原以戏鹅池为中心环池布置建筑池北为不系舟画舫池西为逸野堂池南为浮筠阁池东为梅花厅互相成为对景是古园遗存的精华部分水池周围有后来移至园中的一对唐经幢和一座宋代石塔等重要文物唐经幢原在南翔寺大殿前东西对峙建于唐咸通八年867年和乾符二年875年北宋太平兴国五年980年重修元元统二年1334年重修大殿时重镌经文并更易残损石构件两幢高7米二十余级平面六边形有基座托座束腰和檐盖等塔身镌刻陀罗尼经各级有佛像力士和莲瓣等历代均有修补宋代石塔名为普同塔为南宋嘉定十五年1222年甘子荆建明万历二十六年1598年重修塔为四面七层高3米塔身两级镌刻佛像塔尖有俯仰莲塔檐上立宝瓶状塔刹
40 兴圣教寺塔
Xingsheng Temple Pagoda
北宋
级别 Level
第四批全国重点文物保护单位（1996年）
地址 Address
松江区中山东路235号
类型 Type
古建筑/塔
中文原文

兴圣教寺塔俗称方塔，位于松江区东南方塔园内。兴圣教寺建于五代后汉乾祐二年（949年），时称兴国长寿寺，宋代改称兴圣教寺。

北宋熙宁、元祐年间（1068—1094）建塔，元代多次修葺，元末寺毁于兵燹，仅存塔和钟楼。

明洪武三年（1370年）在寺南废墟上建松江府城隍庙，寺僧在塔周围建围墙、忏堂，称兴圣塔院。清乾隆年间重建塔身至九层，清道光二十四年（1844年）大修，更换塔刹。

20世纪30年代忏堂与城隍庙毁于战火，仅余方塔。20世纪60年代勘察发现塔身内外177朵斗拱中保留的宋代构件有111朵，椽檐枋、过梁更换的不多，三层还留有宋代佛像壁画，是江南古塔中保存原构件较多的一座。

1973年至1977年进行复原大修，保留未损坏的宋元明清构件，修补复原损坏残缺的构件，替换了腐蚀的塔心木，重装塔刹、相轮，恢复扶梯、楼板平座、腰檐和寻杖式栏杆，重建了围廊。

塔为楼阁式砖木结构，四面九级，高42.5米，各层高度递减。塔身四面辟壶门，每面以砖砌出倚柱，柱上挑出梁枋与斗拱，承接塔檐。塔心中空，塔壁向内出叠涩承楼板，各层设木质楼板，楼梯陡峭。

各层施腰檐，二层以上壶门外有平座，外廊狭窄，围以宋式寻杖栏杆。塔顶加铁质覆盆和塔刹，套在塔心木上。塔心木长13米，立在八层楼板上方。

塔下有地宫，内有石函、铜佛等宝藏。空筒形方塔盛行于唐，宋代较少采用，此塔高宽比为7:1，轮廓呈柔和的曲线，体型秀美，是典型的宋代风格。

塔南有一座明代照壁，为明洪武三年（1370年）所建松江府城隍庙的遗物，抗战期间庙宇遭毁，仅存照壁。

塔北有一座天后宫大殿，原在上海河南路桥北，建于清光绪九年（1883年），是天后宫仅存的建筑。因原地逼仄，迁建于此。

· · · · ·
English

Xingsheng Temple Pagoda, commonly called the Square Pagoda, is located in the Square Pagoda Garden in the southeast of Songjiang District.

Xingsheng Temple was built in the 2nd year of Qianyou of the Later Han of the Five Dynasties (949), then called Xingguo Changsheng Temple, renamed Xingsheng Temple in the Song.

The pagoda was built during the Xining and Yuanyu reigns of the Northern Song (1068-1094), renovated multiple times in the Yuan; at the end of the Yuan the temple was destroyed by war, leaving only the pagoda and bell tower.

In the 3rd year of Hongwu of the Ming (1370), the Songjiang Prefecture City God Temple was built on the ruins south of the temple; temple monks built walls and repentance halls around the pagoda, called the Xingsheng Pagoda Courtyard.

During the Qianlong reign of the Qing, the pagoda body was rebuilt to nine stories; in the 24th year of Daoguang (1844) a major repair was carried out, replacing the pagoda finial.

In the 1930s, the repentance hall and City God Temple were destroyed by war, leaving only the Square Pagoda.

A survey in the 1960s found that among the 177 bracket sets inside and outside the pagoda body, 111 retained Song-dynasty components; few rafters, eave architraves, and lintels were replaced; the third story still retains Song-dynasty Buddha murals; it is one of the ancient pagodas in Jiangnan that preserves more original components.

From 1973 to 1977, a major restoration was carried out, preserving undamaged Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing components, repairing and restoring damaged and incomplete components, replacing the corroded central pagoda wood, reinstalling the finial and wheel discs, restoring stairs, floor slab flat seats, waist eaves, and staff-style railings, and rebuilding the surrounding corridor.

The pagoda is a pavilion-style brick-wood structure, four-sided with nine levels, 42.5 meters high, with each story height decreasing.

The pagoda body has pot doors on all four sides; each side has engaged columns built of brick, with beams and bracket sets projecting from the columns to support the pagoda eaves.

The pagoda center is hollow; the pagoda wall projects corbels inward to support floor slabs; each story has wooden floor slabs, with steep stairs.

Each story has waist eaves; above the second story, outside the pot doors there are flat seats, with narrow outer corridors surrounded by Song-style staff railings.

The top of the pagoda has an iron basin cover and finial, fitted over the central pagoda wood.

The central pagoda wood is 13 meters long, standing above the eighth-story floor slab.

Under the pagoda is an underground palace, containing stone boxes, copper Buddha statues and other treasures.

Hollow-cylinder square pagodas were prevalent in the Tang and less commonly used in the Song; this pagoda has a height-to-width ratio of 7:1, with a softly curved outline and an elegant form, a typical Song style.

South of the pagoda is a Ming-dynasty screen wall, a relic of the Songjiang Prefecture City God Temple built in the 3rd year of Hongwu of the Ming (1370); during the War of Resistance the temple was destroyed, leaving only the screen wall.

North of the pagoda is a Tianhou Empress of Heaven Palace main hall, originally north of Henan Road Bridge in Shanghai, built in the 9th year of Guangxu of the Qing (1883), the only surviving building of the Tianhou Palace.

Due to the cramped original site, it was relocated here.

41 唐经幢
Sutra Pillar of Tang
唐
级别 Level
第三批全国重点文物保护单位（1988年）
地址 Address
松江区西司弄43号（松江中山小学内）
类型 Type
古建筑/经幢
门票 Ticket
免费开放
中文原文

松江唐经幢位于松江区西司弄中山小学内，可凭身份证登记进入参观。经幢气势雄大，雕刻繁丽，据明代《松江府志》记载：石幢，在华亭县前，相传地有涌泉，云是海眼。大中十三年立幢镇之。

可知经幢建于唐大中十三年（859年），是上海已知现存最古老的地面建筑。幢身共八面，分为21层，残高9.3米，主体雕刻《佛顶尊胜陀罗尼经》，从正西面开始为序文，每面十行，第二面第六行起刻经文，第八面最后六行为建幢铭记。

石幢自下而上依次为卷涛海水纹底座、蟠龙束腰、佛山卷云底座、蹲狮浮雕束腰、唐草纹仰莲座和菩萨浮雕束腰，叠涩上有石勾栏，幢身上刻有捐献人姓名和捐献品名数量。幢身之上为狮首华盖，每角设衔环狮首，上有联珠束腰和卷云纹托座，托座四面间隔雕刻四天王力士。

其上有八角腰檐和蟠龙圆柱，底座上刻《郡主礼佛图》，圆柱上刻十六个人物，有佛陀菩萨端坐莲台，郡主侍女恭敬侍奉。上盖八角攒尖腰檐和无花纹棱形平盖。

经幢底层曾掩埋地下，幢身东北倾斜，1962年整修时拆卸重置，在各层凹槽内发现建造时放入的唐代铜钱，在底部数层边缘缝隙中发现宋代铜钱，为后人塞入，可知此经幢宋代曾重修，仍保持唐代原状。

· · · · ·
English

The Songjiang Tang Sutra Pillar is located inside Zhongshan Primary School on Xisi Lane, Songjiang District, and can be visited by registering with an ID card.

The sutra pillar is imposing in momentum and richly carved; according to the Songjiang Prefecture Gazetteer of the Ming: The stone pillar is in front of Huating County; legend says there was a bubbling spring here, said to be a sea eye.

In the 13th year of Dazhong, a pillar was erected to subdue it.

This shows the sutra pillar was built in the 13th year of Dazhong of the Tang (859), and is the oldest known surviving above-ground building in Shanghai.

The pillar body has eight sides, divided into 21 levels, with a remaining height of 9.

3 meters; the main body is carved with the Buddha's Top Victorious Dharani Sutra, starting from the due west side with the preface, ten lines per side; from the sixth line of the second side the sutra text is engraved, and the last six lines of the eighth side are the inscription of the pillar's construction.

From bottom to top, the stone pillar is: rolling-wave sea-pattern base, coiled-dragon waist, Buddha-mountain cloud-scroll base, crouching-lion relief waist, Tang-grass-pattern upward-lotus seat, and Bodhisattva relief waist; above the corbels are stone railings; the pillar body is engraved with the names of donors and the names and quantities of donated items.

Above the pillar body is a lion-head canopy, with ring-holding lion heads at each corner, above which are a beaded waist and cloud-scroll supporting seat; the four sides of the supporting seat are alternately carved with the Four Heavenly Kings and warrior figures.

Above it are an octagonal waist eave and a coiled-dragon cylinder; the base is carved with the Princess Worshipping Buddha scene, and the cylinder is carved with sixteen figures, including Buddha and Bodhisattvas sitting upright on lotus platforms, with princesses and maids serving reverently.

The top cover is an octagonal pyramidal waist eave and a patternless prismatic flat cover.

The bottom layer of the sutra pillar was once buried underground, and the pillar body tilted northeast; during a renovation in 1962 it was disassembled and reset; Tang-dynasty copper coins placed during construction were found in the grooves of each layer, and Song-dynasty copper coins inserted by later people were found in the edge gaps of the bottom several layers, indicating that this sutra pillar was once repaired in the Song but still maintains its original Tang condition.

建筑要点 / Key Features
松江唐经幢位于松江区西司弄中山小学内可凭身份证登记进入参观经幢气势雄大雕刻繁丽据明代松江府志记载石幢在华亭县前相传地有涌泉云是海眼大中十三年立幢镇之可知经幢建于唐大中十三年859年是上海已知现存最古老的地面建筑幢身共八面分为21层残高9.3米主体雕刻佛顶尊胜陀罗尼经从正西面开始为序文每面十行第二面第六行起刻经文第八面最后六行为建幢铭记石幢自下而上依次为卷涛海水纹底座蟠龙束腰佛山卷云底座蹲狮浮雕束腰唐草纹仰莲座和菩萨浮雕束腰叠涩上有石勾栏幢身上刻有捐献人姓名和捐献品名数量幢身之上为狮首华盖每角设衔环狮首上有联珠束腰和卷云纹托座托座四面间隔雕刻四天王力士其上有八角腰檐和蟠龙圆柱底座上刻郡主礼佛图圆柱上刻十六个人物有佛陀菩萨端坐莲台郡主侍女恭敬侍奉上盖八角攒尖腰檐和无花纹棱形平盖经幢底层曾掩埋地下幢身东北倾斜1962年整修时拆卸重置在各层凹槽内发现建造时放入的唐代铜钱在底部数层边缘缝隙中发现宋代铜钱为后人塞入可知此经幢宋代曾重修仍保持唐代原状
42 醉白池
Zuibaichi Garden
清
级别 Level
上海市文物保护单位（2014年）
地址 Address
松江区人民南路64号
类型 Type
古建筑/园林
门票 Ticket
12元
开放时间 Hours
7:00 — 17:00
中文原文

醉白池前身可追溯至宋代进士朱之纯的谷阳园，晚明时期书画宗师董其昌在此建造四面厅、疑航等，广邀文人墨客宴饮雅集。清顺治年间园归水利专家顾大申，顾氏工诗文、善书画，为松江画派重要传人，他对旧园重加葺治，因仰慕白居易《池上篇》的风雅生活，取名醉白池。

清乾隆年间园归娄县人顾思照，改筑为今日格局。清嘉庆二年（1797年）曾在园中设育婴堂，新中国成立后全面修复，并向西侧扩出外园作为公共园林。今醉白池西北、东北各有一处入口，西部为现代公园，开池筑屋，绕有古意；东部为醉白池旧园。

旧园以醉白池为中心，这是一座南北狭长的长方形水池，与曲折的池岸不同，颇具古风。主厅池上草堂位于北侧，稍稍后退跨在溪流之上，前方掩以石砌拱桥。环池四周皆有亭榭，东北为四面厅，东岸长廊串起小湖亭和大湖亭，西南角悬出六角亭，皆可倚栏小坐，欣赏池中游鱼、花木倒影。池南廊壁上开圆洞门，通向碑刻画廊，内立董其昌雕像。池上草堂和四面厅北部是另一园区，北部为土山，广植林木；南部为曲池，点缀芰荷。

池山之间建乐天轩，前以平桥连接两岸，东南临池设疑舫旱船，构成一处清幽雅致的庭院，与醉白池北的疏朗简洁形成对比。在这两处主园之外，西侧有雪海堂方池小院，东南角为三进原来的住宅，南侧有近年新建的赏鹿园，以及不少石刻碑碣，都值得一赏。

· · · · ·
English

The predecessor of Zuibaichi Drunken White Pool Garden can be traced back to the Guyang Garden of Song-dynasty jinshi Zhu Zhichun; in the late Ming, calligraphy and painting master Dong Qichang built the Siamian Four-Sided Hall and Yihang Suspicious Boat here, widely inviting literati and scholars for banquets and elegant gatherings.

During the Shunzhi reign of the Qing, the garden passed to water conservancy expert Gu Dashen; Gu was skilled in poetry and prose, excelled in calligraphy and painting, and was an important successor of the Songjiang School of Painting; he renovated the old garden, and because he admired the elegant life described in Bai Juyi's Poem on the Pool, named it Zuibaichi Drunken White Pool.

During the Qianlong reign of the Qing, the garden passed to Gu Sizhao from Lou County, who rebuilt it into today's layout.

In the 2nd year of Jiaqing (1797), a foundling hospital was once established in the garden; after the founding of New China, it was fully restored and expanded westward with an outer garden as a public park.

Today Zuibaichi has an entrance each at the northwest and northeast; the western part is a modern park, with pools dug and buildings built, full of ancient charm; the eastern part is the old Zuibaichi Garden.

The old garden centers on Zuibaichi Drunken White Pool, a long and narrow rectangular pool from north to south, different from winding pool banks, quite ancient in style.

The main hall, Chishang Caotang Thatched Hall Above the Pool, is located on the north side, slightly set back and spanning over a stream, with a stone arch bridge in front.

Around the pool are pavilions and towers on all sides; the northeast is the Siamian Hall; the long corridor on the east bank connects the Xiaohu Small Lake Pavilion and Dahu Great Lake Pavilion; a hexagonal pavilion projects from the southwest corner; all are places to sit by the railing and appreciate the fish swimming in the pool and the reflections of flowers and trees.

On the south pool corridor wall, a round-arched door opens to the stele carving gallery, with a statue of Dong Qichang inside.

North of the Chishang Caotang and Siamian Hall is another garden area: the north is an earthen hill densely planted with trees; the south is a winding pool dotted with water chestnuts and lotus.

Between the pool and hill stands Letian Xuan Joyful Heaven Pavilion, with a flat bridge connecting the two banks in front; southeast by the pool is the Yihang land-boat, forming a quiet and elegant courtyard, contrasting with the sparse and simple north of Zuibaichi.

Beyond these two main gardens, on the west side is the Xuehai Sea of Snow Hall square-pool small courtyard; the southeast corner is the original three-courtyard residence; the south has the newly built Shanglu Deer-Appreciating Garden in recent years, as well as many stone carvings and steles, all worth appreciating.

建筑要点 / Key Features
醉白池前身可追溯至宋代进士朱之纯的谷阳园晚明时期书画宗师董其昌在此建造四面厅疑航等广邀文人墨客宴饮雅集清顺治年间园归水利专家顾大申顾氏工诗文善书画为松江画派重要传人他对旧园重加葺治因仰慕白居易池上篇的风雅生活取名醉白池清乾隆年间园归娄县人顾思照改筑为今日格局清嘉庆二年1797年曾在园中设育婴堂新中国成立后全面修复并向西侧扩出外园作为公共园林今醉白池西北东北各有一处入口西部为现代公园开池筑屋绕有古意东部为醉白池旧园旧园以醉白池为中心这是一座南北狭长的长方形水池与曲折的池岸不同颇具古风主厅池上草堂位于北侧稍稍后退跨在溪流之前前方掩以石砌拱桥环池四周皆有亭榭东北为四面厅东岸长廊串起小湖亭和大湖亭西南角悬出六角亭皆可倚栏小坐欣赏池中游鱼花木倒影池南廊壁上开圆洞门通向碑刻画廊内立董其昌雕像池上草堂和四面厅北部是另一园区北部为土山广植林木南部为曲池点缀芰荷池山之间建乐天轩前以平桥连接两岸东南临池设疑舫旱船构成一处清幽雅致的庭院与醉白池北的疏朗简洁形成对比在这两处主园之外西侧有雪海堂方池小院东南角为三进原来的住宅南侧有近年新建的赏鹿园以及不少石刻碑碣都值得一赏
